izzyondroid:com.android.gpstest.osmdroid.name: GPSTest
izzyondroid:com.android.gpstest.osmdroid.summary: The #1 open-source GNSS/GPS app on Android. No ads, no trackers, just data.
izzyondroid:com.android.gpstest.osmdroid.description:
No ads, and no trackers - GPSTest displays real-time information for GNSS and SBAS satellites in view of your device. A vital open-source testing tool for platform engineers, developers, and power users, GPSTest can also assist in understanding why your GPS/GNSS isn't working.
 Supports dual-frequency* GNSS for:
 GPS (USA Navstar) (L1, L2, L3, L4, L5)
 Galileo (European Union) (E1, E5, E5a, E5b, E6)
 GLONASS (Russia) (L1, L2, L3, L5)
 QZSS (Japan) (L1, L2, L5, L6)
 BeiDou/COMPASS (China) (B1I, B2a, B2b, B3I)
 IRNSS/NavIC (India) (L1, L5, S)
 Various satellite-based augmentation systems SBAS (e.g., GAGAN, Anik F1, Galaxy 15, Inmarsat 3-F2, Inmarsat 4-F3, SES-5) (L1, L5)
 *Dual-frequency GNSS requires device hardware support and Android 8.0 Oreo or higher. More at https://medium.com/@sjbarbeau/dual-frequency-gnss-on-android-devices-152b8826e1c.
 The "Accuracy" feature lets you measure the error in your device's position against your actual location (entered by you). Other apps show you the estimated accuracy, which is generated by your device. GPSTest lets you to compare this estimated accuracy to actual accuracy!
 Menu options:
 Inject Time Data - Injects Time assistance data for GPS into the platform, using information from a Network Time Protocol (NTP) server
 Inject PSDS Data - Injects Predicted Satellite Data Service (PSDS) assistance data for GNSS into the platform, using information from a PSDS server. Note that some devices don't use PSDS for assistance data - if this is your device, you'll see a message saying "Platform does not support injecting PSDS data". PSDS is the generic term for products like XTRA assistance data .
 Clear Assist Data - Clears all assistance data used for GNSS, including NTP and XTRA data (Note: if you select this option to fix broken GNSS on your device, for GPS to work again you may need to ‘Inject Time’ and ‘Inject PSDS’ data. You may also see a large delay until your device acquires a fix again, so please use this feature with caution.)
 Settings - Switch between light and dark themes, change map tile type, auto-start GPS on startup, minimum time and distance between GPS updates, keep screen on.
 Beta versions: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.android.gpstest
 Open-source on Github: https://github.com/barbeau/gpstest
 FAQ: https://github.com/barbeau/gpstest/wiki/Frequently-Asked-Questions-(FAQ)
 GPSTest discussion forum: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/gpstest_android
 Nostalgic for old releases? Download old versions here: https://github.com/barbeau/gpstest/releases
 Also available on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.android.gpstest

fdroid:com.hanan_bhatti.cobalt.name: Cobalt
fdroid:com.hanan_bhatti.cobalt.summary: Universal offline-first note capture and personal knowledge archive
fdroid:com.hanan_bhatti.cobalt.description:
Cobalt is an offline-first personal archive and capture app for Android. It stores links, notes, images, audio clips, code snippets, and movie, TV, anime and manga lists locally without requiring a Cobalt account. Local note storage supports shared history, recoverable drafts and saved Undo/Redo.
Capture Methods:
- Android Share Target: Save text, URLs, images, and videos directly from other apps via the system share sheet.
- Floating Overlay: Access a screen-edge panel to write quick notes, capture links, or trigger OCR without leaving your current app.
- Screen Region OCR: Capture a screenshot or crop a region on screen using MediaProjection to extract text and links.
- Quick Settings Tile: Launch OCR capture directly from the system Quick Settings panel.
- Voice Notes: Record audio memos with real-time waveform display, stored locally on device.
- Home Screen Widgets: View recent captures or trigger capture actions from your home screen.
Organization & Viewing:
- Supported Item Types: Links (with metadata previews), Markdown text notes, Photos/Images, Video clips, Code snippets, Audio recordings, and Movies/Anime.
- Folders & Archive: Organize items into custom folders or archive them to remove them from the main feed while keeping them stored.
- Search & Filters: Search across titles, content, extracted OCR text, and URLs, with filter chips for each media type.
- Media Hub: Track movies, TV, anime and manga with local ratings, watch/read statuses, bookmarks and cached episode details. Configure TMDB, Trakt and custom Jikan v4 endpoints in Media & Providers.
- Notes & Storage: Continuous Markdown editing, tables, search/replace, local font controls, recoverable drafts, saved versions, Trash and reviewed cleanup that protects unsaved writing.
- Sharing: Styled note, link, image and movie cards with smaller text, readable excerpts and continuation markers, image/Markdown export and bounded clipboard copy.
- Local Organization: Smart folder ranking, fuzzy search, capture activity and adaptive review reminders.
Network & Privacy Disclosures:
Cobalt stores all data locally on your device. It does not include analytics, tracking SDKs, or Cobalt-owned cloud synchronization. Certain optional features connect to external APIs:
- AI Screen OCR & Transcription: Sends selected image regions or voice notes to Google's Gemini API for processing. This requires you to provide your own Gemini API key in Settings.
- Movie & Anime Data: Queries The Movie Database (TMDb) and Jikan (MyAnimeList) for media details and poster images. TMDb searches require your own TMDb API key.
- Trailers: Embedded playback of YouTube trailers on media detail screens.
- Trakt: Optional browser or device-code sign-in and user-authorized watch tracking. Initial, manual, eligible app-start and daily background sync can contact Trakt; category switches pause their respective imports and uploads.
- Updates: GitHub release checks are opt-in in Release & Updates.
- Links and remote media: Metadata and images can contact saved URL hosts.
- Feedback: Choose to export/share a bug report or open a pre-filled GitHub/email submission. The optional experience survey uses 1–10 sliders and opens your email app with plain-text answers; you decide whether to send them.
Biometric locking, encrypted notes and complete app backup/restore are not currently provided. The experimental Web Companion is disabled in release builds and unavailable to users.
Automatic Android backup and device transfer are disabled. Uninstalling Cobalt can permanently remove local data.

fdroid:com.jbgsoft.ambio.name: Ambio: Focus Timer & Sounds
fdroid:com.jbgsoft.ambio.summary: Blend up to 3 of 12 ambient sounds into a focus soundscape you build yourself
fdroid:com.jbgsoft.ambio.description:
Ambio turns focus time into an environment you build yourself. Pick up to three ambient sounds, set how loud each one sits in the mix, and the whole app answers — colour, light and motion follow what you made.
THE MIXER
Twelve sounds, three at a time, each with its own level. Rain over a distant café. Fireplace under wind. Ocean with crickets at dusk. Every blend is yours to balance, and Ambio remembers it for next time.
- Rain, Fireplace, Café, Forest
- Birds, Crickets, Ocean, Stream
- Cave, Wind, White Noise, Brown Noise
IT LOOKS LIKE IT SOUNDS
The background is a living gradient blended from every sound in your mix — cool blues for rain, warm amber for fireplace, deep green for forest. Particles drift behind the timer and answer the whole mix, not just one sound. Prefer stillness? Turn the effects off.
FOCUS TIMER
Pomodoro presets at 25 or 50 minutes, or set your own focus and break lengths. A gentle chime closes the session without pulling you out of it. Made for studying, writing, coding, or anything that needs sustained attention.
SESSION PLANS
Need more than one round? The Plan preset lets you line up focus and break steps in any order, loop them or end there. A success chime marks the end of the plan.
A MIX FOR BREAKS
Rest to a different sound. Turn on sound during breaks and pick a second mix that plays only while you rest — the focus mix returns when the break ends.
AMBIENT MODE
Not timing anything? Switch to ambient mode and let the mix run. For reading, meditation, winding down, or sleep — a sleep timer stops the mix for you once you have drifted off.
SEE WHERE YOUR FOCUS WENT
A session history keeps track of the hours you actually put in.
BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
On tablets, the mixer sits permanently beside the timer — two panes, no switching back and forth.
HELLO, HOLA, BONJOUR, こんにちは
Ambio speaks your language now — the whole app, not just this page. On Android 13+ you can set its language on its own, without touching the rest of your phone.
PRIVACY FIRST
Ambio respects your time AND your data:
- Works completely offline
- No account required
- No ads, ever
- No tracking or analytics
- No data leaves your device
- Open source (MIT License)
BACKGROUND PLAYBACK
Start a session and put the phone down. Ambio keeps playing with full media controls — pause, resume or stop from the notification shade, the lock screen, or the Quick Settings tile.
BUILT FOR MODERN ANDROID
- Material Design 3
- Adaptive icons with Android 13+ monochrome support
- Efficient battery usage
- Small app size
WHO IS AMBIO FOR?
- Students preparing for exams
- Remote workers needing focus
- Writers battling distractions
- Developers in the zone
- Anyone who wants peaceful productivity
All ambient sounds are CC0 licensed (public domain). The app itself is open source under the MIT License.
Download Ambio and build the quiet you work best in.

fdroid:com.pennywiseai.tracker.name: PennyWise: SMS Expense Tracker
fdroid:com.pennywiseai.tracker.summary: Auto-track UPI & bank SMS. Private expense tracker and budget app, no sign-up.
fdroid:com.pennywiseai.tracker.description:
Your bank already texts you every transaction. PennyWise reads those SMS on your phone and turns them into an automatic expense tracker — no manual entry, no sign-up, nothing uploaded.
★ Why PennyWise asks for SMS permission
Reading bank SMS is how the app works — it is the entire product. Everything happens on your device: no server ever receives a message, there is no account to create, and the complete source code is public (AGPL-3.0) so anyone can verify exactly what it does. Would rather not grant it? You can still add transactions by hand or import a PDF statement.
★ Automatic expense tracking
• Every UPI payment, card swipe, ATM withdrawal and bank transfer becomes a categorized transaction
• 172 banks and payment services across 26 countries, with multi-currency support
• Works with any UPI app — it reads your bank's SMS, not the app
• A clean, searchable spending timeline that stays up to date on its own
★ Budgets and insights
• Set monthly budgets per category and watch progress as you spend
• Spending trends, category breakdowns and month-on-month comparisons
• Automatic subscription detection — finds the recurring payments you forgot about
• Smart rules to auto-categorize transactions your way
★ On-device AI assistant
Ask "what did I spend on food last month?" and get a real answer. The AI model (Qwen 2.5) runs locally on your phone — no API calls, no cloud, works offline.
★ Private by design
• No account, no login, no email required
• No ads, no trackers, no analytics on your financial data
• Nothing leaves your device
• Open source (AGPL-3.0) — read the code yourself
★ Free, with an optional Pro upgrade
PennyWise is free to use. An optional Pro license adds unlimited custom rules, PDF statement imports, CSV export, duplicate-account merge and scheduled daily backups — and directly supports a solo developer building PennyWise independently. Already have a license key? Enter it under Settings → PennyWise Pro.
A money manager, budget planner and spending tracker in one — for people who hate typing in expenses.

fdroid:com.trisven.safenotes.name: Safe Notes - Encrypted Notepad
fdroid:com.trisven.safenotes.description:
★ Safe Notes is an open-source project that aims to provide an encrypted, private note manager. 
★ Employs rigorously tested AES-256 encryption standards to encrypt your notes.
★ Incognito Keyboard
★ Brute-force protection
★ Protection against data snooping via adb
★ Android background snapshot protection
★ Inactivity guard
★ Automated encrypted backup
★ Arctic Nord style dark and light theme
★ Customization for colorful notes
★ Seamless migration to new device. Use the backup to move your data from one device to another device.
★ Safe Notes provides ultimate security - you don't have to trust us, or any other third party because everything is done locally on your phone.
★ Contrary to the ongoing frenzy of "move everything to cloud" we believe in "localization of user data" giving you the control of your data and not some third-party cloud service provider.
★ Completely anonymous, no inbound and outbound requests.
--- How it works ---
★ Safe Notes encrypt each note with a unique AES-256 symmetric key derived from your passphrase and randomly generated salt.
★ If an attacker tries to brute-force your encrypted notes it will take "Trillions Upon Trillions years" in contrast, the universe has only existed for 15 billion years. (You must use strong and long passphrase).
★ AES-256 is symmetric key encryption that is quantum-resistant, i.e. it isn't vulnerable to quantum computers.
★ Everything is stored locally on the user's device.
★ Your passphrase is never stored on the device, it gets purged as soon as you exit the app.
★ We can't decrypt your notes even if we wanted to. That gives you the ultimate security, but it also means that a lost passphrase can never be recovered.
★ Safe Notes is an open-source, not-for-profit project.

Simple Random Stock is for fun and educational purposes only. This application should not be viewed as financial advice or stock recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any security or investment. Investors should be cautious about any and all stock recommendations. Please consult with a professional financial adviser before making any financial decisions.

Record lectures and search the transcript weeks later. Scan textbooks and business cards, handwrite and sketch with Apple Pencil, use OCR to find text inside photos and handwritten notes, so nothing you captured becomes unfindable. A long note becomes an AI mind map before an exam.

Yes. @mention people to collaborate in real time, or publish a public note or video by link.

apple-macos:6752286208.description:
AnyLLM is a chat app that puts you in control: talk to AI through cloud or fully local providers, with no API keys to manage. Use free cloud models at no cost, run models on your own hardware, or subscribe for credits to unlock premium models.
PRIVACY & SECURITY
• Local AI needs no account—use Ollama or LM Studio without signing up, and your data never leaves your network
• Sign in with Apple, Google, or email to use cloud models; your chats and settings sync to your account so they're available on all your devices
• Cloud access is configured automatically—no API keys to copy or manage
• Clear or delete chats anytime; you control your data
MULTIPLE MODELS, ONE APP
• Cloud Models — browse and use many AI models, including free ones; access is set up for your account automatically
• Ollama — run models locally on your computer; connect via your Ollama server URL
• LM Studio — run models locally with LM Studio; connect via your LM Studio server
• Switch providers and models anytime from the menu
VOICE IN, VOICE OUT
• Voice input — speak your messages; speech is converted to text (edit before sending)
• Optional “Send” by voice or auto-send after silence for hands-free use
• Text-to-speech — hear responses read aloud as they’re generated
• Choose system TTS, in-app speech, or premium cloud voices; adjust voice and speed to your preference
MORE FEATURES
• Light, dark, or system theme; customizable fonts and sizes
• Full chat history; start new chats or reopen past ones on any of your devices
• Send images where your chosen model supports it, and create images with image-generation models
• Works on phone, tablet, and desktop
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS OF USE (EULA)
We use the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA), accessible here:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
AnyLLM is free to use with free cloud models and your own local models. Paid models, image generation and premium cloud voices use credits, which come with a subscription plan. Your plan and credits belong to your account and are shared across all your devices.
Available plans:
• Lite Plan (USD 4.99, 1 Month)
• Pro Plan (USD 14.99, 1 Month)
Credit packs (one-time purchase, available with an active plan):
• Credit Pack (USD 4.99)
• Credit Pack (USD 19.99)
Note: Plan costs may vary by location.
Note: Plans auto-renew after expiry. To change or cancel, do so at least 1 day before expiry.
Note: Unused plan credits expire at the end of each month. Credit pack credits never expire.

 Use the built-in code editor to directly edit files without switching tools.
 While editing code, use diff split view, syntax highlighting and search files.

 Use multiple profiles for work and personal projects.

 GitKraken Glo Boards Features:
 Reduce context switching, and use Glo Boards to help your dev team track tasks and issues
 from inside the GitKraken Git Client.
 Also access Glo inside VS Code, Atom, a browser or from our iPhone or Android apps.

flathub:com.discordapp.Discord.name: Discord
flathub:com.discordapp.Discord.description:
Discord is a free all in one messaging, voice, and video client thats available on your computer
 and phone.
 Whether you’re part of a school club, gaming group, worldwide art community, or just a handful
 of friends that want to spend time together, Discord makes it easy to talk every day and hang out
 more often.
 Talk to your friends with messaging, voice, and video in a "Direct Message" (1 other person),
 group chat (up to 10 people), or a multi-channel server (practically infinite maximum members).
 Discord servers are organized into topic-based channels where you can collaborate, share,
 and just talk about your day without clogging up a group chat.
 Grab a seat in a voice channel when you’re free. Friends in your server can see you’re around
 and instantly pop in to talk without having to call.
 Get a community of any size running with moderation tools and custom member access. Give
 members special powers, set up private channels, and more.
 Low-latency voice and video feels like you’re in the same room. Wave hello over video, watch
 friends stream their games, or gather up and have a drawing session with screen share.
 Available on Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and your web browser.
 Discord is written in Javascript, React, Elixir, and Rust. The desktop application uses the
 electron framework.
 The flatpak version runs in a sandbox to provide better safety and privacy for users. However,
 this sandboxing prevents the following features from working out of the box: Game Activity, Unrestricted
 File Access, Rich Presence. Check the README in the Github repo for details.

flathub:com.github.ryanakca.slingshot.name: Slingshot
flathub:com.github.ryanakca.slingshot.description:
Slingshot is a two dimensional, turn based simulation-strategy game set in the gravity fields of several planets. It is a highly addictive game, and never the same from round to round due to its randomly generated playing fields.
 It is a deceptively simple game, the goal is to shoot the other spacecraft through the field of planets, but their gravity makes it tricky. The effects of the gravity mean that although it's easy to learn how to play, and to enjoy playing, it could take a lifetime to thoroughly master.
 In order to hit your opponent, you can rotate you ship to aim in any direction, and you can change the power with which your projectile is launched - the initial speed at which it flies.
 Slingshot is free software as defined by the [WWW]Free Software Foundation, it is released under the [WWW]GNU General Public License. This means you are free to download, copy, modify, redistribute, disassemble, analyse or sell Slingshot under the terms of the aforementioned license. Enjoy!

flathub:net.openra.OpenRA.description:
OpenRA is a project that recreates and modernizes the classic Command & Conquer real time strategy games. We have developed a flexible open source game engine (the OpenRA engine) that provides a common platform for rebuilding and reimagining classic 2D and 2.5D RTS games (the OpenRA mods).
 The OpenRA mods include new features and gameplay improvements that bring them into the modern era:
 A choice between “right click” and classic “left click” control schemes
 Overhauled sidebar interfaces for managing production
 Support for game replays and an observer interface designed for streaming games online
 The “fog of war” that obscures the battlefield outside your units' line of sight
 Civilian structures that can be captured to provide benefits
 Units gain experience as they fight and improve when they earn new ranks
 OpenRA is 100% free, and comes bundled with three distinct mods. When you run a mod for the first time the game can automatically download the original game assets, or you can use the original game disks.

flathub:net.tabletopclub.TabletopClub.name: Tabletop Club

flathub:net.tabletopclub.TabletopClub.description:
In Tabletop Club, you are given a box of toys to play with, and it's up to you what you do with them! Sure, you can play board games, but why not make a house made of dice, then frisbee it with a poker chip? Draw on the table while waiting for your opponent to make a move in chess, or flip the table into deep space after losing an all-in bet? The table is your oyster!
 You can play online with friends in the click of a button, no login or sign-up required! Simply host a game, and share the room code with your friends. You can also play singleplayer, with no internet connection required.
 Do you have a D&D campaign in mind? Want to command an army in Warhammer? Or is there another board game you want to play? Luckily, the game uses a modular and easy-to-use asset pack system that makes it really quick to import your images, models, music, and more!
 The game is completely free to play, and the source code is available on GitHub!
 You can also help contribute to the game! From submitting code and assets, to suggesting ideas, translating the project, or even finding bugs, there's a lot of ways that you can help make the game better and more accessible.

fedora-packages:argyllcms/argyllcms.name: argyllcms
fedora-packages:argyllcms/argyllcms.description: The Argyll color management system supports accurate ICC profile creation for acquisition devices, CMYK printers, film recorders and calibration and profiling of displays. Spectral sample data is supported, allowing a selection of illuminants observer types, and paper fluorescent whitener additive compensation. Profiles can also incorporate source specific gamut mappings for perceptual and saturation intents. Gamut mapping and profile linking uses the CIECAM02 appearance model, a unique gamut mapping algorithm, and a wide selection of rendering intents. It also includes code for the fastest portable 8 bit raster color conversion engine available anywhere, as well as support for fast, fully accurate 16 bit conversion. Device color gamuts can also be viewed and compared using a VRML viewer.

fedora-packages:artwiz-aleczapka-fonts/a.name: artwiz-aleczapka-fkp-fonts
fedora-packages:artwiz-aleczapka-fonts/a.description: Artwiz is a family of very small futuristic fonts, with varying styles of typefaces designed at a single pixel size. The minimal nature of the fonts makes them popular with users of lightweight window managers. These fonts have been updated by Alec Zapka to be compatible with modern software and support an extended character set. This package contains the fkp font in three encodings, English, German, and Swedish.

fedora-packages:atop/atop.description: An advanced interactive monitor for Linux-systems to view the load on system-level and process-level. The command atop has some major advantages compared to other performance-monitors: - Resource consumption by all processes - Utilization of all relevant resources - Permanent logging of resource utilization - Highlight critical resources - Watch activity only - Watch deviations only - Accumulated process activity per user - Accumulated process activity per program

fedora-packages:coin-or-Ipopt/coin-or-Ip.name: coin-or-Ipopt
fedora-packages:coin-or-Ipopt/coin-or-Ip.description: Ipopt (Interior Point OPTimizer, pronounced eye-pea-Opt) is a software package for large-scale nonlinear optimization. It is designed to find (local) solutions of mathematical optimization problems of the form min f(x) x in R^n s.t. g_L <= g(x) <= g_U x_L <= x <= x_U where f(x): R^n --> R is the objective function, and g(x): R^n --> R^m are the constraint functions. The vectors g_L and g_U denote the lower and upper bounds on the constraints, and the vectors x_L and x_U are the bounds on the variables x. The functions f(x) and g(x) can be non-linear and non-convex, but should be twice continuously differentiable. Note that equality constraints can be formulated in the above formulation by setting the corresponding components of g_L and g_U to the same value.

firefox-addons:5613.name: Image Block
firefox-addons:5613.summary: Image Block adds a toggle button that conditionally blocks/allows loading of images on webpages. Blocking images results in faster browsing, especially helpful on handheld devices or slower connections.
firefox-addons:5613.description:
Updated to work with newer versions! This version had to be completely re-written as the new APIs are much more restrictive. 
Description of earlier version below -
This addon first showed up in 2007 for Firefox version 1.5. Since then its has tried to support all Firefox versions (absolute legacy support), even if it meant compromising on some features (e.g. toolbar button, which is finally movable now). The last thing I wanted was for a user to change there installation just for Image Block to work. 
Another key issue that everyone kept pointing (other than the immovable button) was images not being blocked on certain sites (e.g. Google Image search). This was done on purpose, as these images are embedded in data, "blocking" them was not possible. They could only be "hidden", which would not help in faster browsing or less data use. However, I have finally added this (I'm still not fully convinced if this is the way to go).
Then there were (are) the endless demands of black-lists, white-lists, conditional blocking, flash, tab specific, auto reload, blocking content other than images... so on and so forth. Well, I don't plan to do any of that. The whole idea is to keep it simple, so that everyone can use it... even my mom! Its easy to make tons of buttons and give every feature possible to the user, but making everything work with a single button sets the user free. Most human beings like simple tools! 
Last version was released for Firefox 3.5, it worked till now without any changes to code.
Below is the original description (last edited in 2010!)
Image Block adds a toggle button that conditionally blocks/allows loading of images on webpages. The toggle button is added to the navigation toolbar (extreme right) by default. Blocking images results in faster browsing, especially helpful on handheld devices or slower connections like GSM/GPRS/EDGE dial-up etc. 
Recently in a review one user (thanks dellvin!) pointed out that Image Block is quite useful when you visit websites which show dirty and adult advertisements, while also containing useful information. If you are not sure of what you are about to see on a webpage, just block images to avoid possible embarrassment.
It can also be used at work where your boss doesn't allow you to surf the web or social networking websites!! They look very different (hard to see which site you are viewing) with image blocking on.
- Version 2.1 fixes a couple of bugs, adds tooltip and french language ( thanks to Vincent Caron for this update).
- Version 2.0 fixes compatibility issues with Firefox 3.5, it also adds the button to the navigation toolbar by default.
Very simple image blocking extension, hopefully useful! 
This is my the first extension, I always try to "Keep It Simple, Stupid"

bluejetty:00066330:ios.description:
Stormbound: PVP Card Battle - Where deck building for Collectible Cards and Strategic gameplay collide in unique PVP Turn-based Tactical battles.
Embark on an epic journey in Stormbound, where the clash of four kingdoms unfolds in a strategic battle for dominance. Craft and build a powerful deck, engage in real-time PVP card battles against players worldwide!
Ultimate Card Battle: Watch Your Deck Shine
Dive into the thrill of collecting dozens of cards to craft your powerful deck! Experience the magic as each card transforms the board into the battle on a battlefield! Strategically play your cards to outsmart your opponent in this tactical card battle.
Dominate the board 
Discover the powers of four mighty kingdoms, each with its own cool advantages and playstyles. Uncover the strengths that set them apart, and shape your effective strategy accordingly to dominate the board. 
Real-time PVP Card Battle

Customize your profile

Battle your way to the top league
Battle for seasonal ranking and great rewards, try your best in confronting diverse challenges across various card battle game modes. Upgrade your cards, master your deck building skills and tactics to conquer the battle and get to the top league. 
Seasonal Events 
Enjoy seasonal battle events and unlock special rewards, enriching your collection of cards, decks and resources. Use your collection of cards to build strategic decks tailored for seasonal battles. Claim victory in challenging battles where the worlds of strategy and collectible cards collide in tactical gameplay!

bluejetty:00024395:ios.description:
Marvelous coloring book for girls especially for little princesses - sweet baby girls!
60 cute drawings are ready for coloring by your girls! All girls love to color princesses, unicorns, cats, mermaids, fairies, beauty and dress or cosmetic items. All of those can be found in this coloring game for girls.
Coloring pages for girls was always a good way to build up drawing and painting skills and develop kids creativity and fantasy. Pictures in this coloring book is made for girls primary but it doesn't mean that boys can't download it and fall in love with coloring cats!
Besides a lot of cool coloring pages with princesses, unicorns mermaids and so on you will have a lot of cool coloring tools which includes brush, feltpen, pencil, pattern coloring and fill tool to color a contour in 1 touch.
All tools are unlocked for everyone so your baby girl can play coloring game with unlimited fantasy. Also you will have color palette with 110 (!) colors for all purposes, simple and glitter. All colors are also opened by default so that you or your girl kid while coloring just need to tap desired one.
Beautiful coloring pages in this girls coloring book are well structured:
- Princesses coloring pages. Amazing little princesses will impress any baby girl!
- Unicorns coloring pages. A pack of nice drawn unicorns!
- Cats and Dogs coloring pages. Cats with kittens and dogs with puppies!
- Mermaids coloring pages. Nice mermaids underwater and on stones looking at night sky...
- Fairies coloring pages. Sweet small fairies will not leave your girl kid indifferent. Just look at them!
- Beauty coloring pages. Fashion, cosmetics, dress and items that girls do really love in here.
If you found more amazing and cute coloring pages for girls somewhere please let us know via email!
Features of this girl coloring book are:
- Best coloring pages for little girls you ever seen
- Magic brush tool that brings your drawing looks real brush work(check screenshots)
- Easy and clean design for kids coloring
- Zoom and pan for detailed coloring
- Nice ambient music and sound effects
- A lot various girls coloring books: princess, unicorns, cats & dogs, mermaids, dress and beauty
In case you are looking coloring book for a boy then you can check our other apps to find coloring book for boys and girls.

bluejetty:00083566:ios.description:
Never have enough time to finish a movie anymore? Tired of paying for subscriptions that you don’t use? Watch HappyShort - Every Second is a Drama.
HappyShort - designed for vertical screen viewing, the ultimate app for lovers of short, snappy dramas. With each episode lasting just one thrilling minute, it is easy for you to watch on the go. You'll be hooked on the latest tales from the world, such as modern CEOs, time-travel, comedy, vengeance, thrillers, and more. Whatever trending genre you're looking for, HappyShort has got you covered. Choose from our TV mini series library packed with endless addictive movie shorts added daily, from romantic encounters with billionaires and heart-wrenching tragedies to epic comeback stories and more—you won't ever be short on short movie entertainment!
Indulge in a Tapestry of Genres
With HappyShort, you'll relish an assortment of genres spanning drama, romance, suspense, and thrilling mysteries. Embark on time-travel adventures, unravel enigmatic cases, or get swept away in the fantasy of romance with a pretend billionaire. Our collection of stories is as vast as your imagination!
Lose Yourself in Miniature Dramas
In just minutes, you'll be completely absorbed in these enthralling short narratives, igniting your passion for drama like never before.
Unveiling Exclusive Selection
HappyShort proudly presents a meticulously curated assortment of short plays. Each episode is carefully crafted, brimming with creativity, emotion, and depth, designed to transport you effortlessly into a multitude of imaginative realms.
Here's What Awaits You on HappyShort:
- An Array of Genres
From inspirational comebacks to enigmatic time-travel adventures, from the allure of ancient tales to modern love stories, HappyShort caters to every drama preference you desire.
- Tailored Recommendations
Our smart recommendation system ensures you easily find shows tailored to your tastes.
- Effortless Viewing Experience
With each short drama lasting just minutes, you can seamlessly enjoy them during your commute, breaks, or moments of leisure.
- Exclusive Original Content
Engage with bite-sized, drama-packed original shows that will keep you coming back for more. The entertainment never stops!
- Always Fresh
Stay up-to-date with real-time updates, ensuring a steady stream of the hottest short dramas and movies. Discover new favorites every week!
- Your One-Stop Platform
HappyShort simplifies your viewing journey by providing a unified platform, eliminating the inconvenience of switching between sources.
- Visual Brilliance
Delight in high-definition visuals that capture every detail, creating an immersive feast for your eyes.
Experience the future of short movie entertainment, one minute at a time — download HappyShort now!
Notice:
If you subscribe through Apple, the payment will be deducted from your App Store account upon purchase confirmation.
Subscription privileges: While your subscription is active, you can watch all tv mini series for free.
Your subscription will take effect within 24 hours after purchase, depending on the status of your order in the Apple Store. The subscription is valid for 7 days.
Auto-Renewal: Your subscription will automatically renew. You will be charged within 24 hours before the start of each subscription period until you cancel your subscription.
Cancellation: On iOS devices, you can cancel your subscription at least 24 hours before the next renewal date by going to Settings > iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > View Apple ID > Subscriptions > HappyShort.
The subscription is billed weekly. The actual price may vary by region.
Privacy Policy: https://api.tqshort.com/info_ios/privacy-policy-241010-nmkk.html
User agreement: http://api.tqshort.com/tqvideo-oss/hai-user.html

Unlock a better financial future with Ava – an easy and effective way to build positive credit history, which may help improve your credit score over time.* A prime (700+) score may be attainable. Join us and make an impact on your credit journey.
Why Ava, you ask?
Quick Results: 74% of members who subscribed to Ava within 7 days saw a credit score increase within the first two weeks of joining.** Among those members, some saw increases of 40+ points within three months.** 
Still not convinced? There's more.
Easy Setup: Get started in less than 5 minutes.
Transparent Pricing: Starting at just $5/month for the annual plan, Ava offers a simple, affordable route to better credit history.
With Ava, you can expect:
- No hidden fees
- 0% interest
- Instant account set up with no credit check
- 0 deposit/collateral required
Included in our simple pricing are:
AVA CREDIT BUILDER CARD:
The Ava Credit Builder Card allows you to pay for over 60 online subscriptions and bills (like Netflix and Verizon) while also lowering your credit utilization.***
SAVE & BUILD CREDIT ACCOUNT:
The Save & Build Credit Account is a secured loan that helps you save money while adding an additional credit line to your report. Start with just $25/month, make on-time payments for 12 months, and get back $300. Zero interest. Origination fee in some states.**** 
A pattern of positive payment history may help strengthen your credit profile over time.
FREE MONTHLY CREDIT REPORT
Stay on top of your credit score with free credit reports in the app. Discover insights and suggestions in your report that make it easy to understand credit factors, like credit utilization and percentage of on-time payments.
DEDICATED CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Need help? Our dedicated support team is here to help. Contact us at support@meetava.com.
Ava is not a bank, Ava is a technology company that partners with technology service provider of banking related services Priority Technology Holdings, Inc., as well as Pier Lending LLC NMLS 2451164 in certain states to provide the Secured Loan Account . The Ava Credit Builder Mastercard® is issued by Patriot Bank, N.A., pursuant to a license from Mastercard® International Incorporated.
* With Ava's Credit Builder Card and Save & Build Account you add two new tradelines to your credit report that helps with your credit mix (10%) and credit history (15%). With each payment made on time you help build your payment history (35%). The Credit Builder Card's credit limit helps with your credit utilization (30%). https://www.experian.com/blogs/ask-experian/credit-education/score-basics/what-affects-your-credit-scores/
** Data is for the period Jan 1, 2023 - Dec 31, 2023, and describes average outcome for members who subscribed to Ava, activated the Ava Card and were furnished to the bureaus within 7 days, and did not cancel their membership within 7 days of signing up. A credit score increase is not guaranteed.
***Approval is guaranteed when you connect a valid bank account and pass identity verification. We report on-time payments to all three credit bureaus within about 48 hours. Maintaining low utilization and consistent on-time payments may help improve your credit score over time. 
****In the following states, Ava’s Save & Build Credit Account origination fee is $12, paid as $1 per month: Georgia, Ohio, Louisiana, Indiana, Missouri, Wisconsin, Florida, Hawaii, Texas, New York, Illinois, North Carolina, Michigan, New Jersey, Virginia, Alabama, South Carolina, Tennessee, Arizona.

bluejetty:00151434:ios.description:
Bank of Baker is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Bank of Baker:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back

View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Bank of Baker app, you must be enrolled as a Bank of Baker digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00060849:ios.description:
Alon Dictaphone is a professional voice recorder with every feature included. Record meetings, lectures, interviews, dictation and everyday notes in top quality, edit them, turn speech into text and send recordings wherever you need them.
EVERYTHING INCLUDED, ONE PRICE
• One-time purchase: no subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads
• Every feature below is unlocked from the first launch, with free updates
• Already use our free Dictaphone app? Installing Alon Dictaphone on the same device unlocks every feature there too. Your recordings stay right where they are.
RECORD IN PRO QUALITY
• MP3 or WAV up to 48 kHz / 320 kbps, including 32-bit WAV
• Unlimited recording length, in the background and with the screen locked
• Stereo with the built-in microphones (iOS 14+), or pick an external, wired or Bluetooth mic
• Microphone gain and voice-activated recording that skips silence
• Listen through headphones while you record
• Record from your Apple Watch, or use it as a remote control
• Start in one tap: on launch, from Control Center, the widget or the Action Button
• Stop timers, pauses automatically for incoming calls
TRANSCRIBE AND FIND WHAT MATTERS
• Transcribe: turn recordings into text, with timestamps
• Bookmarks with text notes or photos: jump straight to key moments
• Play routes: tick the bookmarks you want and play only those parts, in your order, on a loop. Ideal for learning, music practice and rehearsals
• Playback speed from 0.5x to 4x, volume and balance control
• Categories to organize recordings, with a Deleted bin to put them back
• Sort by name, date, length, size or type, with file names that sort by date
• Search your recordings: swipe down the list with two fingers
EDIT WITHOUT A COMPUTER
• Append, overwrite, insert, trim, cut and join recordings
SHARE AND BACK UP
• Email, Dropbox (with auto-sync), Google Drive, OneDrive, Box, Evernote, SoundCloud, YouTube, SharePoint, FTP/WebDAV, Wi-Fi transfer, AirDrop and Open In
• Sync recordings, bookmarks and settings with iCloud
• Copy recordings to your Mac or PC with Finder or iTunes
• Import audio from other apps
• Select many recordings to send, move or delete at once
PRIVATE AND ACCESSIBLE

bluejetty:00131144:ios.description:
Pixel Pro Tennis is a unique and addicting arcade tennis game, that combines realistic gesture controls with authentic physics and beautiful pixel-art. 
Use the unique and simple touch controls to hit everything from a lob, to a slice, to a gloriously satisfying top-spin winner. 
Complete a quick match on grass, clay or hard court in just with a few minutes. 
Or start a Career, and take your player around the world and into the Grand Slams. Choose your tournaments, upgrade your skills and tweak your tactics for your next opponent. Play through over 40 gorgeously pixelated arenas, each carefully crafted with unique playing conditions and payoffs. Watch the tour news as you try to achieve your career dreams. Earn ranking points and rise up the world rankings, unlocking different tours until you reach the Grand Slams and hit the top spot.  Finish a tournament high enough to earn winnings and skill points, that you can use to upgrade everything from your serve power to court speed. Alternatively, use your skill points to play more tournaments each season.
Challenge friends over Game Center, with achievements and leaderboards for all the courses.
FEATURES:
Realistic gesture based controls
Over 40 unique tournaments
Over 250 unique opponents
Addictive, fun gameplay
Beautiful pixel-art
Skill upgrades
Quick play
Career mode
Tour news feed
Career dream achievements
Game Centre leaderboards, achievements and challenges
Custom number of sets per match
Multiple difficulty settings

bluejetty:00017603:ios.developer: Bank of Cyprus Public Company Ltd
bluejetty:00017603:ios.summary:
Our app is designed to make your everyday banking easier and faster and perform your queries and transactions securely at a touch of a finger
BENEFITS & FEATURES
• Login using your User ID and the 6-digit Passcode or using biometrics (ava
bluejetty:00017603:ios.description:
Our app is designed to make your everyday banking easier and faster and perform your queries and transactions securely at a touch of a finger
BENEFITS & FEATURES
• Login using your User ID and the 6-digit Passcode or using biometrics (available on compatible devices as an alternative)
• Check your balances using the convenient “Home” page, where connected accounts are separated per account type (current accounts/saving accounts/cards/loans)
• View a snapshot of your finances and get useful insights such as your net worth and scheduled payments
• View your Account Details for connected accounts i.e Interest Rates, IBAN (with an option to share), Hold Amounts, Uncleared Cheques etc .
• Check your account’s Transaction History with a convenient filter option to minimize the results and trace a specific transaction
• Transfer funds between your accounts or to any Bank of Cyprus customer. For your convenience, you may use your predefined templates
• Carry out fast and easy QuickPay mobile payments to Bank of Cyprus customers, up to €250 per day, using the beneficiary’s mobile number or account/card number. Also available for payments that exceed the €250 daily limit, with the use of a Digipass. (only for individuals)
• Set your favourite Quickpay contacts and have them available for selection with just one tap
• Transfer funds to other local banks or abroad (SEPA & SWIFT) either to new or to account auto-saved beneficiaries
• Connect accounts held with Banking institutions and view information about those accounts (for supported banks only)
• Open eFixed Deposit (in euro and other currencies) and eNotice accounts
• Apply for an eCredit Card
• If you are a business subscriber with predefined multiple signatures (schema), Approve/Decline your Pending Transactions
• Update your contact information (phone numbers, email). Digipass OTP is required
• Get images of cheques you issued or that you deposited
• Pay your utility bills
• Open a standing order via the Transfer option as a repeated payment and a direct debit for your credit card
• View the status of your transactions performed via 1bank channels
• Personalise the app by uploading a picture of your choice or setting up account alias
• View the “Notices” sent by the Bank from time to time, to keep up with our news and much more.
The Bank of Cyprus Mobile Application is offered free of charge, however 1bank Commission & Charges may apply for your transactions.
In case you don’t have 1bank credentials, please visit http://www.bankofcyprus.com.cy/en-gb/retail/ebankingnew/application-form/apply/ to find out more or contact us on 800 00 800 or +357 22 128000 if calling from abroad, Monday to Friday between 07:45 and 18:00, Saturday and Sunday between 09:00 and 17:00.
IMPORTANT TO KNOW
• To have access to the full range of features and the latest enhancements, please ensure that you have the latest version of the Bank of Cyprus App Installed on your device and Notifications are enabled
• The Bank of Cyprus App is offered in Greek and English
• In case you forgot your credentials, please visit http://www.bankofcyprus.com.cy/home-gr/Internet-Banking_gr/1bank/forgot_your_passcode/ and learn how you can retrieve them.
SECURITY
Bank of Cyprus will never ask you for any personal details through emails, pop-up windows and banners.
If you receive an email or other electronic communication asking you to enter or confirm your Βank of Cyprus personal details, please do not reply as it may be fraudulent. Please forward any suspicious emails to: abuse@bankofcyprus.com
If you think you may have revealed your personal details please contact us immediately.

bluejetty:00076732:ios.description:
Invoice Maker is the easiest way to send professional invoices and estimates to your customers. Perfect for small business owners, contractors or freelancers, Invoice Maker is a fast, easy and affordable mobile invoicing solution. Create a professional invoice in seconds and collect payments with ease. 
WHY INVOICE MAKER?
- Create personalized, professional invoices in seconds
- Customize invoice fields like quantity, rate, and item number
- Track your income with built-in billing reporting
- Access dozens of languages and over 150 currency symbols and currency formats
- Add business logos, images, signatures or personalized terms of business
- Add saved items to your invoice and country specific sales taxes
- Set up new clients from your phone contact list with ease
- Copy and re-use old or existing invoices
- Send Proforma invoices 
- Use the barcode scanner for simplified item management
- Send invoices and receipts via Email, Text and WhatsApp or print as a PDF
- Unlimited cloud storage for invoices and receipts
FAST PAYMENTS
Get notified when your estimate or invoice has been read. With built-in reminders and AI-based auto-tagging system, users can keep track of Receivables, Due and Overdue invoices easily. Send payment reminders to customers directly from the app and say goodbye to payment chasing.
IMPROVED CASH FLOW
Track invoices by customer, category or payment status and access reports and payment records all within the app. 
MULTIPLE PAYMENT METHODS
Receive instant payments either on or offline. Get paid online through Apple Pay, PayPal and Stripe or use debit and credit cards, cheques and cash.
MASTER LISTS, TEMPLATES, & DUPLICATES
Use customer Master Lists or Invoice Templates to save time and prevent errors. Duplicate invoices using the 'Quick Copy' option.
RISK FREE SECURITY 
Generate invoices in offline mode or access data without an internet connection. If your phone is lost, stolen, or breaks, all data will be available when you download the invoice app again. 
For suggestions & support, find us at http://help.invoicecreateur.com/ or email support@invoicecreateur.com.
Ready to get started? The free version of Invoice Maker is available on iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch. A monthly subscription starts at $2.99 USD per week, $6.99 USD per month for unlimited invoices on your mobile device. An annual subscription starts at $49.99 USD per year for unlimited invoices on your mobile device.
Subscriptions automatically renew and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time from your iTunes account settings. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Privacy policy: https://invoicecreateur.com/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00069156:ios.summary: Immerse yourself in a world of armored tank battles. Choose from a wide range of more than 60 famous tanks of the major combatants. Pick the best tank and blast your way across the battlefield. Defeat your enemies with force and strategic d
bluejetty:00069156:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in a world of armored tank battles. Choose from a wide range of more than 60 famous tanks of the major combatants. Pick the best tank and blast your way across the battlefield. Defeat your enemies with force and strategic decisions! And lead your legion on a glorious road to victory!
Real Tank War On Mobile 
Choose real tanks from Russian, US, German and many other classic tanks in history. Tank Legions delivers the most intense free-to-play 7v7 tank battles on mobile. From Pacific battle zone to African desert, Europe to Russian snow battlefield, compete on these enormous and detailed battlegrounds varying in size, terrain, day/night cycles and dynamic weather, master each battlefield's secrets to create your own strategic approach to win.
Depth and Variety
Unlock new tanks and upgrade them according to your strategic goals. Light tank, medium tank, heavy tank and tank destroyer, each with unique characteristics. Assign crew members like captain, driver, gunner and loader, activate exclusive skills to better perform on the battlefield. Offers automatic and manual controls that will be appreciated by novices and hardcore gamers alike.
15v15 Fast and Furious
Dynamic 15v15 battles and nonstop action in different modes: 7v7 Skirmish, Scramble and 7v7 Ranked Matches, 15v15 grand battle. Choose from exciting event mode: Free for All, Protect the Flag, Last Man Standing and Last Team Standing. There is always something for everyone! Be a lone wolf soldier or play with a Legion and defeat the enemies when duty calls!
Upgrade and Customization
A well-developed progression system Research vehicles from Tier I tanks to monstrous Tier V machines. Change guns, set equipment, wear camouflage—tune your vehicle to match your play-style! Upgrade components and modules to max out your tanks strategically to make it deadly iron force. Customize your tanks with cool camouflages and pattern designs for a competitive edge. 
Join Legion and Dominate in Empire War
Create legions and invite like-minded friends to join, and ranked up in legion championship. Battle for your legions honor in Empire War and dominate territories to earn rich rewards for your legion. Join in Hero Pass season event for huge exclusive rewards.
【“Ana's Offer” Subscription terms】
1. Subscription Price and Period
You can subscribe to the “Ana's Offer” in the game. The price is $2.99 and it lasts for 30 days. New users can subscribe to the offer for $0.99/month for the first 2 months.
2. Subscription Contents
Users can enjoy special privileges during the subscription period:
① Get daily bonus for 30 days;
② Crew XP bonus from battle +20%;
③ Gold rewards from battle +20%;
④ Commander XP bonus from battle +20%;
3. Auto-renewing Subscriptions
• The Apple App Store auto-renews subscriptions and payment is confirmed by your iTunes Account directly. Users will need to manually disable auto-renewal in their iTunes/Apple ID management settings. Charges will be made 24 hours before the end of each subscription period, and confirmed and paid via their iTunes Account. In order to cancel subscription, you need to disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the one month subscription ends. If you fail to cancel auto-renewal before that time, then subscription will be extended automatically.
4. Cancel the subscription
If you would like to cancel a subscription, please go to "Settings" on your iOS Device –> select "iTunes Store and App Store" –> tap on "Apple ID", and then select "View Apple ID" to get into your "Account Settings", then tap "Subscriptions" –> "Management", and select “Tank Legion”, then unsubscribe.

Privacy Policy: http://volvapps.com/V3/policy.html
Visit our official site at http://www.volvapps.com

bluejetty:00184975:ios.summary: Breakthrough DTS Play-Fi(R) technology powers simple, great-sounding whole-home wireless audio systems for smartphones and tablets. You can stream your favorite tunes over Wi-Fi right from the Play-Fi app to speakers from DTS Play-Fi produc
bluejetty:00184975:ios.description:
Breakthrough DTS Play-Fi(R) technology powers simple, great-sounding whole-home wireless audio systems for smartphones and tablets. You can stream your favorite tunes over Wi-Fi right from the Play-Fi app to speakers from DTS Play-Fi product partners. It's a huge step up from Bluetooth - the audio quality and reliability are outstanding, and you can enjoy music from your phone in one room, or all your rooms.
The "Hi-Fi over Wi-Fi" listening experience is just a touch away, thanks to this handy app. Choose a speaker, choose a song, and your favorite tunes are streaming all through the house.
The app offers built-in streaming options: stream from worldwide music services; use AM/FM and Internet radio, connect to DLNA servers, or play anything from your device's music library, including your iTunes playlists. The app automatically organizes and indexes the music for you.
The app also handles set-up for your speakers, and gives you full control of volume and speaker selection. Choose one, set up speaker groups, or stream to all of them at once. Manage speaker groups for Spotify Connect, too.
IMPORTANT NOTE: If you have a Play-Fi product from Polk Audio, Definitive Technology or Phorus, please search for and download the custom Play-Fi app for your audio brand.
Please also note that the Play-Fi app is companion software to audio products enabled with Play-Fi technology. It is not intended as a stand-alone audio player.

bluejetty:00078812:ios.description:
ABOUT THIS APP
The Freedive & Apnea Training App allows you to perform a variety of breathing exercises from the comfort of your home. Whether you're looking to improve lung health, boost athletic performance, or enhance freediving skills, personalized plans are tailored to your goals and fitness level.
FOR WHO
Suitable for all levels, from beginners to experts in each of these categories:
· Wellness Seekers: Enhance lung health and reduce stress with gentle breathing exercises.
· Athletes: Boost stamina and lung capacity for better sports performance.
· Surfers: Increase breath-hold times for safer surfing.
· Recreational Freedivers: Improve underwater skills and endurance.
· Spearfishers: Enhance underwater endurance and safety.
· Competitive Freedivers: Achieve peak performance with advanced techniques.
HOW IT WORKS
Personalized training plans adapt to your fitness level, goals, and progress. Each day, receive a workout recommendation, ensuring continuous improvement by tracking performance and adjusting difficulty. 
Otherwise, you can train on your own. All workouts are free and without limitations.
WORKOUT TYPES
Various workout types are available, each with unique benefits:
· CO2 Tables: Improve tolerance to high carbon dioxide levels, enhancing breath-hold times.
· O2 Tables: Boost oxygen efficiency, increasing endurance and stamina.
· Square Tables: Promote steady breathing patterns and control.
· Rectangle Tables: Focus on long breath-holds and recovery times.
OTHER FEATURES
· Book a Mentorship Session: Schedule a session with a freediving instructor to ask questions and resolve doubts.
· Contextual Interfaces and Graphics: Master the basics and learn how to maximize body capabilities.
· Workout History: Track all past workouts.
· Progress Chart: Monitor breath-holding capacity evolution over time.
Join +15,000 users and start your journey to better lung health and peak performance.

bluejetty:00123349:ios.summary:

The foods listed can be helpful to reduce Acid Reflux / GERD symptoms (bad breath, chest pain, vo
bluejetty:00123349:ios.description:
Acid reflux diet and food choice helper tool to make identification of good and bad foods for Acid Reflux / GERD / heartburn symptoms easier.
The foods listed can be helpful to reduce Acid Reflux / GERD symptoms (bad breath, chest pain, vomiting, breathing problems, dysphagia, gas etc) for people with Acid Reflux / GERD / heartburn.
Features include:
- Comprehensive list of foods and whether they are Good, Bad, Or Neutral for Acid Reflux and heartburn.
- Search by food and beverage.
- Lookup by food category.
- General Acid Reflux, Acid Reflux Diet and heartburn info, such as common symptoms ( heartburn, chest pain, bad breath, breathing problems, dysphagia, vomiting etc.) and causes.
Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), also known as acid reflux, or chronic heartburn, is a long term condition where stomach contents come back up into the esophagus resulting in either symptoms or complications. 
Come common symptoms include the taste of acid in the back of the mouth, heartburn, bad breath, chest pain, vomiting, breathing problems, dysphagia, gas, and wearing away of the teeth. Complications include esophagitis, esophageal strictures, and Barrett's esophagus.
Risk factors include obesity, pregnancy, smoking, hiatus hernia, and taking certain medicines. Medications involved include antihistamines, calcium channel blockers, antidepressants, and sleeping medication. It is due to poor closure of the lower esophageal sphincter (the junction between the stomach and the esophagus). Diagnosis among those who do not improve with simpler measures may involve gastroscopy, upper GI series, esophageal pH monitoring, or esophageal manometry.
Treatment is typically via lifestyle changes, medications, and sometimes surgery. Lifestyle changes include not lying down for three hours after eating, losing weight, avoiding certain foods, and stopping smoking. Medications include antacid, H2 receptor blockers, proton pump inhibitors, and prokinetics.
remedies: chewing gum, licorice, aloe, slippery elm, apple cider vinegar
causes: alcohol, chocolate, fried foods (e.g. french fries), mint, onions, garlic, tomatoes
DISCLAIMER:
We do not perform any testing ourselves. All compiled data should be used as guidelines not as basis of fact. Consult your physician before beginning any new diet. This general information is not intended to diagnose any medical condition or to replace the advice of your healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00023793:ios.description:
A simple and elegant clock with a focus on displaying the time in the most pleasing and readable way possible. There's a dark mode, with the ability to lower the brightness so that the time is only just readable, ideal for use at night as a bedside clock. During the day, the light mode with full and vibrant colours can be used to keep track of the time while you work. 
As well as customising the clock with a selection of colours and brightness levels, you can choose to display or hide the date, seconds, use the 12 or 24 hour clock, and of course toggle between night and day mode. The layout of the clock intelligently adjusts to make the best use of the screen whether your device is in portrait or landscape. Bed Time also includes a set of calming sounds - such as rain, ocean waves, a burning fire, etc - to help you drift off to sleep.
Bed Time is designed with simplicity in mind - just tap the screen and a small selection of controls will be displayed - or alternatively you can use simple gestures:
• Swipe left and right to cycle through a selection of colours
• Swipe up and down to adjust the brightness
• Pinch and zoom to show or hide the date and the seconds
• Long press to switch between 4 different styles
 • Dark mode with a coloured background
 • Dark mode with a black background
 • Light mode with coloured background
 • Light mode with a white background
• Elegant in both portrait and landscape
The Bed Time app is designed to be used in conjunction with a stand on your bedside table or desk.

Use guided sessions, a simple timer, and daily quotes to build a calming routine.
Why Chakra Meditation Balancing?
• INTERACTIVE CHAKRAS: Simply tap each of the 7 chakras—from the Root to the Crown—to activate and align your energy centers. Each chakra has its own beautiful New Age music to foster harmony and balance.
• CUSTOMIZABLE SOUNDSCAPES: Create your perfect ambient sound for deep meditation. Layer calming nature sounds like waterfalls, wind, or gentle rain over our melodies. Add the pure resonance of Tibetan singing bowls to craft your unique auditory oasis.
• MEDITATION TIMER: Track your practice and stay consistent. Measure your meditation sessions to help you stay focused on your mindfulness journey and watch your progress unfold.
**UNLOCK CHAKRA PLUS FOR A DEEPER PRACTICE**
Gain exclusive access to a world of transformative wellness tools:
• AI-POWERED GUIDED MEDITATIONS: Dive into an expanding library of guided sessions for specific goals like:
- Deep Sleep & Insomnia Relief
- Anxiety & Stress Reduction
- Improving Focus & Concentration
- Cultivating Gratitude & Self-Love
• BREATHING EXERCISES: Master powerful breathing techniques (pranayama) designed to bring you instant calm, relieve stress in moments, and heighten your mindfulness.
• 24/7 RELAXING MUSIC STREAM: Need to unwind? Tune into a continuous stream of serene music, perfectly crafted for meditation, yoga, study, or simply relaxing your mind and body.
• LEARN THE 7 CHAKRAS: Deepen your spiritual knowledge with our comprehensive learning center. Explore the symbolism, colors, affirmations, and spiritual attributes of each chakra to gain a profound understanding of your energy body.

bluejetty:00021961:ios.description:
Add watermark as text, image, or QR code to your multiple photos or videos easily.
A watermark is an essential design feature that protects your brand and photographs online. You can now quickly establish one with just a few taps to protect your brand, photos, media, or any other content. It's ideal for photographers, entrepreneurs, artists, editors, designers and a variety of other purposes.
The Add Watermark offers everything you need to create a watermark that is entirely yours, whether you want to protect your copyright or show off ownership of your photographs. It's simple to use, and you can share your ideas directly from the app.
Add Watermark app has tons of features specially designed to both protect copyrights and let content creators easily and quickly create beautiful watermarks at once. You can create lots of designs with Add Watermark, you can even create blend overlay photos!
TEXT WATERMARK
Create text watermarks with opacity, color and font options. Features;
- Add Text to Photos & Videos
- Text size is changeable.
- Text color is changeable.
- Text's stroke color is changeable. 
- Text is rotatable.
You can use those features to create logos, brand flyers, posters, banners. QR WATERMARK
Unify your works with an automatic QR code creator and watermark with QR Code.
IMAGE WATERMARK
You can add and blend your brand logos or other content with other formats such as .jpeg, .png, etc.
Features - Add Logos to Photos
- Logo or image size is changeable.
- Multiple logos can be added to the same poster or photo. - Logo or image is rotatable.
BEAUTIFUL TEXT COLORS
We have chosen simple and mostly used text colors and added them to the user interface.
IMAGE, TEXT, QR CODE WATERMARK TRANSPARENCY
You can easily adjust the opacity of each watermark on your photos.
EASY STAMP ADJUSTMENT
Rotate, Scale and Translate with easy hand gestures. Add multiple images, texts or QR code watermarks and adjust each stamp or mark separately.
Usage Instructions:
- First, choose your photos and videos.
- Tap on the watermark to edit and customize.
- Tap + to add another watermark
- See how your watermarked images look like.
- Tap save button to save all images to your library.
Watermark Pro Subscription
Access all features of Watermark with Watermark Pro. Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan. 
- Terms of use: https://www.rayinformatics.com/terms
- Privacy policy: https://www.rayinformatics.com/privacy
 CONTACT
- Visit rayinformatics.com/contact for support and feedback.

bluejetty:00028862:ios.description:
Welcome to TriPeaks Solitaire Deluxe® 2, the enchanting card game developed by the renowned creators at Murka. Dive into a mesmerizing world filled with breathtaking vistas, inventive gameplay, and an array of solitaire puzzles designed to keep you entertained for hours on end.
In this extraordinary mobile game, you'll encounter a fresh twist on the classic solitaire experience. Mobile Deluxe Solitaire Tripeaks combines the traditional solitaire rules with the intriguing tripeaks mechanics. Can you master the art of clearing cards to reach the pinnacle of success?
Embark on a journey through a diverse range of captivating locations. Each environment offers its own set of distinctive challenges, from the serene beauty of tropical islands to the mysterious allure of ancient temples. Prepare to be enthralled by visually stunning backgrounds that enhance your solitaire adventure.
To aid you on your quest, utilize an arsenal of boosters and power-ups strategically. These valuable resources will prove indispensable when facing the most demanding levels. Exercise your wit and tactical prowess as you clear cards, conquer peaks, and triumph in style.
Don't miss out on the daily challenges that will push your solitaire skills to the limit. Completing these challenges not only demonstrates your expertise but also rewards you with enticing prizes, unlocking exciting new content along the way.
Connect with friends and fellow solitaire enthusiasts, competing on leaderboards for the coveted top spot. Showcase your skills and earn well-deserved bragging rights as the Solitaire Tripeaks champion.
With hundreds of levels and frequent updates, Mobile Deluxe Solitaire Tripeaks guarantees an endless source of amusement. Whether you're a solitaire novice or a seasoned pro, there's always a fresh challenge to conquer.
Immerse yourself in the game's exquisite graphics and harmonious soundscapes, creating a soothing and enjoyable gaming experience suitable for players of all ages.
Mobile Deluxe Solitaire Tripeaks offers the convenience of playing anytime, anywhere on your mobile device. Whether you're on your daily commute or relaxing at home, this game is your perfect companion for unwinding.
Join millions of players worldwide and experience the addictive and visually striking world of Mobile Deluxe Solitaire Tripeaks. Download the game now and embark on an unforgettable solitaire journey crafted by Murka's expert game developers. Explore, strategize, and conquer the peaks in this tripeaks solitaire extravaganza!

bluejetty:00061749:ios.name: Teo Mobile Softphone
bluejetty:00061749:ios.summary: Teo Mobile Softphone for iOS is a SIP-based VoIP softphone for the iPhone and iPad that uses Wi-Fi and mobile network connections to make and receive calls with the Teo Unified Communications platform. You can conference, split or swap mult
bluejetty:00061749:ios.description:
Teo Mobile Softphone for iOS is a SIP-based VoIP softphone for the iPhone and iPad that uses Wi-Fi and mobile network connections to make and receive calls with the Teo Unified Communications platform. You can conference, split or swap multiple voice calls, as well as transfer calls, using the same contacts you already have in your iPhone. Access all the capabilities of your Teo UC from anywhere.
Phone Features
• Call display and voicemail indicators
• Speakerphone
• Mute and hold functions
• Call history – list of received, missed and dialed calls
• Contact List and Contact Favorites synchronized with iPhone contacts
• Ringtones and contact avatars
• Custom wallpaper
• Multiple call support: swap between two active calls, merge/split calls, transfer calls
• Call recording
• Call forwarding
• Custom dial plan support
• Standard audio codecs: G.711, G.722, SILK-NB, SILK-HD 
• RFC 2833 DTMF dialing
• VPN support
Presence Features
• View and update your Teo UC Presence status to control presence-base call routing
• Monitor the presence status of other Teo UC users in your personal Buddy List
• Your presence status may be viewed by other Teo UC users within your system
Instant Messaging Features
• Send and receive text messages in real-time
• See when your contacts are available
Advanced Features
• Network Traversal: application managed, server managed or user specified; Global IP Support; STUN & ICE
• Media Efficiency and Quality: Noise Reduction, Echo Cancellation, and VAD (Voice Activity Detection)
• QoS (Quality of Service): ToS Marking and DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point)
• Security and Encryption via TLS and SRTP
• DNS SRV record lookups
• Call quality statistics
HD Video Features
• Uses the forward or rear-facing camera on your iPhone or iPod touch to make high-definition video calls
• Picture-in-picture view lets you see how you look to the person you’re calling
• H.264 and VP8 codec support
Accessories
The following optional accessories are supported:
• Headset with microphone (including Bluetooth): Uses the ear-piece and microphone on the headset.
• Headphones (no microphone): Uses the ear-piece on the headphone and the built-in microphone on the iPhone.
** IMPORTANT NOTICE **
Teo Softphone for iPhone is a standalone softphone application and is not a VoIP service. A Teo Unified Communications system is required to make calls. Some mobile network operators may prohibit or restrict the use of VoIP functionality over their network and may also impose additional fees or other charges in connection with VoIP. You must learn and abide by your cellular carrier's network restrictions. Teo will not be held liable for any charges, fees or liability imposed by your carrier for use of VoIP over 3G or 4G carrier networks.

bluejetty:00145974:ios.summary:

Our AI scans live ad and sales data across the web and surfaces 1–
bluejetty:00145974:ios.description:
Dropshipping+ is the AI-powered winning product finder that hands you a fresh set of products to sell every single day — no more endless scrolling for something that works.
Our AI scans live ad and sales data across the web and surfaces 1–4 hand-picked winning products daily, each one vetted before it reaches you. Whether you're launching your first store or scaling an established dropshipping business, Dropshipping+ turns product research from guesswork into a fast, data-driven routine.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Get 2–4 AI-picked winning products every day
• Spy on the real Facebook ads running for each product
• Visit the live competitor store selling it
• Source instantly with direct AliExpress, Alibaba, Amazon and eBay links
• Run the numbers with a built-in profit calculator
AI WINNING PRODUCTS
Stop hunting and start selling. Our AI engine pulls from live advertising and sales signals to surface products that are already converting. Browse by niche, sort by newest, and filter by date to zero in on the right product. Every product shows its price, cost and margin at a glance, so you understand the opportunity before you commit.
FACEBOOK AD SPY
Open the real Facebook ads running for each product and copy the hooks, creatives and angles that already convert — instead of burning ad budget testing from scratch.
COMPETITOR STORE SPY
Visit the live shop selling each product to study its pricing, product page and offer, then build a better version for your own store.
INSTANT SOURCING
Every product comes with direct links to suppliers on AliExpress, Alibaba, Amazon and eBay. Check pricing, compare shipping and order samples in seconds — sourcing that used to take hours now takes a tap.
PROFIT CALCULATOR
Know your numbers before you risk a dollar. Plug in your product cost, selling price, fees and funnel rates to instantly see break-even and target ROAS, cost per purchase, cost per add-to-cart and more.
Whether you dropship on Shopify, TikTok Shop or your own store, Dropshipping+ gives you the winning products, ad intelligence and profit tools to grow your dropshipping business. Download Dropshipping+ and find your next winning product today.
Premium unlocks every supplier and competitor link plus the latest daily finds.
—
Dropshipping+ offers an auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://www.dropshippingplus.io/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.dropshippingplus.io/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00114211:ios.description:
[Game Features]
Even a rookie skull can become the Skull King! In Skull Up, you will rise from the bottom to the throne: collect over 60 Skellies to form your unique teams, enjoy idle management with abundant rewards, and unlock multiple adventures. Come and unleash the power of the undead and evolve from a nobody into the Skull King!
[Endless Fun, Underworld Adventures]
A rookie skull uncovered hidden treasures! In Skull Up, you can amass massive resources through management gameplay, or defeat mighty enemies with smart strategies. Join a guild and fight alongside your bone buddies! More content await—nonstop excitement guaranteed!
[Diverse Skellies, Boundless Power]
Gather various Skellies during your path to becoming the King! During this adventure, you will encounter over 60 unique Skellies with distinct looks and abilities. With diverse designs, they can be switched between human and skull forms, who are your strongest bone allies!
[Easy Progression, Loss-Free Growth]
Power up your companions without pressure: The loss-free progress system allows you to upgrade any Skelly—the resources can be fully refunded. Experiment freely, optimize your team, and achieve rapid power spikes with no investment wasted.
[Free Combinations, Smart Strategies]
Level up nonstop and show the king’s edge! Unlock your strategic potential and assemble a bone-powered team. Whether breaking defenses or providing support, every Skelly hides unique strengths— deploy them wisely!
[Idle Management, Effortless Rewards]
Future king, this undead castle is yours! Assign skull workers to smelt, log, and mine—gain massive EXP and valuable resources even while offline and level up with ease! With an idle strategy system, victory comes effortlessly!
