bluejetty:00043777:ios.description:
Microsoft MyHub is available to Microsoft employees and vendors.
Navigate your campus life from one place with this simple, personalized experience of Microsoft MyHub. MyHub is an app that brings together the tools and services Microsoft Employees use every day. It gives you time back so you can focus on achieving more at Microsoft.
DISCOVER
A meditation and relaxation space on campus? Yes, please. Find this delightful space, priceless pieces from the Microsoft art collection, game rooms ­­­­and other amenities in the Discover feature!
GET DIRECTIONS
You never leave home without your maps app, right? Now get wayfinding help while you’re at the office. Find people and places and get directions to them. There is even live turn by turn directions in some buildings.
DINING
Those long lines at the cafés are getting scary. Skip the queue and use the order ahead option in the Café feature! Check menus, pay in advance and even create orders for different stations.
SHUTTLE & CONNECTOR
Avoid the tangled web of roads on your next trip to the office. Use MyHub to book a Shuttle or Connector journey so you can travel to and around campus with confidence.
BOOK A SPACE
When you're at the office, you can use MyHub to find and book a conference room or workspace on the go with the Book a space feature. 
PARKING
You'll be able to register your vehicles, find the right type of spot you need, and even find your car with the Parking feature.
GET MAINTENANCE
Have you noticed a mess or damage in your workspace or a conference room? When you're at the office, you can use MyHub to make a facility request.

bluejetty:00161695:ios.summary:
Find gas stations near you and discover fuel prices before you fill up.
Gas Prices Near You helps drivers find nearby gas stations, explore fuel prices on a map, and quickly compare stations around their current location or destination.
F
bluejetty:00161695:ios.description:
Find gas stations near you and discover fuel prices before you fill up.
Gas Prices Near You helps drivers find nearby gas stations, explore fuel prices on a map, and quickly compare stations around their current location or destination.
FIND GAS STATIONS NEAR YOU
Use your location to discover nearby gas stations with an easy-to-browse list and interactive map. Search for stations, explore nearby options, and view station details in one place.
COMPARE FUEL PRICES
Check available fuel prices at nearby stations and compare your options before you stop to refuel.
Price availability and coverage may vary by location.
EXPLORE ON THE MAP
See gas stations around you on the map and easily understand where they are located. Switch between map and list views to find the station that works best for your trip.
SEARCH AND DISCOVER
Search for gas stations and browse stations by location. Whether you're looking for fuel around town or planning a longer drive, Gas Prices Near You makes it easier to find your next stop.
HELP KEEP PRICES UP TO DATE
Fuel prices can change quickly. When you notice a price that is different from what is shown, you can report an updated price and help improve the information available to other drivers.
REPORT INCORRECT INFORMATION
See something that doesn't look right? You can report incorrect station information and help keep the database more accurate.
CURRENT COVERAGE
Gas price and station information is currently available in selected areas of:
• United States
• Canada
• Australia
• Taiwan
• Germany
Coverage and available fuel price information vary by region and station.
BUILT FOR DRIVERS
Gas Prices Near You is designed to make finding fuel simple:
• Find nearby gas stations
• Search for stations by location
• Browse stations in a list or on a map
• View available fuel prices
• Compare nearby stations
• Submit updated fuel prices
• Report incorrect station information
• Explore stations while traveling
Prices and station information may change over time. User-submitted information may require verification and may not always reflect the current price at the station.
Gas Prices Near You — find a station, check the price, and get back on the road.

Now you can listen to your notes as a podcast! Scan your notes and listen to them on the go. Using the time-tested Feynman technique, the app accelerates your learning and helps you retain knowledge longer. But it’s more than just memorization — it’s about true comprehension. You'll gain the skills to clearly explain concepts, tackle challenging problems, and leave last-minute cramming behind. With smart follow-up prompts, our AI ensures you can simplify even the toughest subjects into clear and manageable ideas. This Einstein Ai companion app will help you tackle the most challenging problems across all tests and subjects. Using the latest AI models, the app will give you accurate, step-by-step answers so that you will know how to solve similar problems. Don't be disadvantaged against other students. Download the app today!

► INSTANT AND ACCURATE SOLUTIONS FOR EVERY QUESTION
Yolk Ai uses advanced Ai models to solve your question in a few seconds. Capture any problem from your test preparation and you will know how to solve similar problems on the real test.

Every question solved will be saved to your personal notebooks, making it easy to review and reinforce key concepts. Ai will analyze your notebook and recommend additional questions for you to study to make sure you have a full understanding of the concepts that will be asked on the test.

- Math
- Biology
- Physics
- Chemistry
- Computer Science
- History
- Econ
- English
- More coming soon!

- Math Word problems

- Unlimited Answers & Explanations

bluejetty:00149461:ios.description:
What Hand Are They Playing?
Your friend has exposed some tiles, now guess the hand they are playing. Singles and pairs rules are optional.
Guess and Check
Tap a tile in the lower 3 rows to complete the exposed hand. Continue guessing until you expose the complete pattern. Some tiles will be played already. The missing tiles will not be in the hidden pattern. 
Random Patterns
Patterns are selected randomly out of all of the possible combinations for the 2021 NMJL card, except for concealed hands. Also the hand FFFF 2222 0000 21 is not used.
Jokers
Jokers are used in quints only. 
Points
Points start at 10 and count down for each missed tile. Since more than one pattern is often possible getting 10s will involve some luck, but try for the highest score possible. 
This is not the American MahJong Practice app 
For American MahJong Practice go to https://apps.apple.com/app/id1458051621 on the App Store. 
Support
Contact support@eightbam.com for questions and include screenshots if possible.

bluejetty:00015879:ios.description:
You've studied. You've practiced. But the moment to actually speak still feels miles away. Promova is the language learning app that changes that.
Promova is built for today’s minds, busy adults who want real progress, not just another streak to maintain. Whatever your goal, holding your own in a conversation, nailing a job interview in a new language, or finally feeling like yourself when you speak, Promova adapts to you. Your goals, your schedule, your starting point.
Trusted by 25M+ learners across 190+ countries. Rated 4.6 on the App Store. 13 languages. Built with a board of 16 language experts. 93% of users say Promova helped them reach their language learning goals.
WHY LEARNERS STAY
• Speak sooner. AI conversation practice in 80+ real-life scenarios, available whenever you are.
• Progress that fits you. Adaptive learning paths adjust to your level, goals, and how you learn.
• Everything in one place: vocabulary, grammar, listening, speaking, reading, writing. No more juggling apps.
• Accessible by design. Dyslexia Mode, white noise for focus, built for diverse learning styles and neurotypes.
KEY FEATURES
AI TUTOR
Your AI tutor is ready 24/7 — no booking, no waiting. Practice speaking in a voice call format that feels like the real thing and get instant feedback on your grammar, vocabulary, and fluency. The more you use it, the more natural it feels.
ROLE-PLAY & CONVERSATION
Practice 80+ real-life scenarios: job interviews, travel, casual small talk, business meetings, medical visits. Build the vocabulary and confidence you actually need in situations that feel like real life. 80% of learners say they feel less nervous speaking.
SPEECH & PRONUNCIATION ANALYSIS
Say it out loud and get real-time feedback on your pronunciation, so you know what to improve and can track your progress.
GRAMMAR & WRITING
Structured lessons that explain the "why" behind every rule. Writing practice built around real-life tasks, emails, messages, everyday exchanges, so what you learn goes straight to use.
LISTENING & READING
Bite-sized audio and video lessons to sharpen your ear for real speech. Reading exercises from everyday content — news, stories, dialogues — at the level that fits where you are right now.
TV SHOWS
Learn with shows in your target language. Real speech, real culture, the vocabulary that actually comes up in conversation. 77% of Promova users improved their listening comprehension.
VOCABULARY & FLASHCARDS
Spaced repetition flashcards that surface the right words at the right time. 400+ topic areas — from daily life to Business English and industry-specific vocabulary.
Download Promova and start where you are. Say it anyway.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Q: What languages can I learn with Promova?
A: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Ukrainian, ASL, and more — 13 languages in total.
Q: Is Promova good for complete beginners?
A: Yes — a short level check when you sign up builds your path from exactly where you are. No experience needed.
Q: Can I practice speaking even if I feel nervous?
A: That’s what Promova is for. Practice with the AI tutor, voice conversations with instant feedback, no judgment, no pressure.
Q: Does Promova work for people with dyslexia or ADHD?
A: Yes, Promova includes Dyslexia Mode, white noise for focus, and is designed for diverse learning styles and neurotypes.
PROMOVA PREMIUM
Free to download. Premium unlocks full access to all courses, AI features, and 12+ languages.
• Monthly or annual plan available
• Free trial available for new subscribers
• Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date
Terms: https://promova.com/terms/terms-and-conditions
Privacy: https://promova.com/terms/privacy-policy
Support: http://support.promova.com/

bluejetty:00131346:ios.description:
Your companion for easy charging on the go! The Electrify America app makes electric vehicle (EV) charging simple with access to the largest open Hyper-Fast charging network in the U.S. Use it to find nearby charging stations, manage your charging sessions, and more — all right from your phone. Compatible with CarPlay.
Public Charging
Charge in as little as 30 minutes with Electrify America’s Hyper-Fast chargers. The Electrify America app helps you locate stations, start charging, and keep track of your sessions. 
Key Features in the App:
- Find an Electrify America charging station
- Get directions to the nearest station
- Become an Electrify America Pass or Pass+ member to access member benefits
- Take advantage of charging benefits
With a Free Electrify America Pass Membership, You Can:
- See real-time charger availability and get notified when a charger opens up
- Pay contact-free through the app
- Favorite your go-to charging stations for easy access
- Start and stop charging right from your phone
- Track your charging status while you shop or dine nearby
- Get notified when your EV reaches your desired state of charge
- View your charging history and get receipts emailed directly to you
Upgrade to Pass+ for only $7 per month and save about 25% on charging while still enjoying all the benefits listed above.
Electrify America’s powerful DC fast charging stations support all CCS (SAE Combo) and CHAdeMO-compatible EVs. You can also use the app to find Electrify America’s Level 2 chargers (with J1772 connectors). 
Electrify America supports 14+ major automakers and is compatible with most EVs on the road today, including popular models like Volkswagen ID.4, Ford Mustang Mach-E, and BMW i4.
Plug&Charge:
Electrify America offers Plug&Charge at all our DC fast chargers for a seamless charging experience. Simply plug in, and the charger communicates with your EV to handle the rest. Plug&Charge is only available for capable EVs. To find out if your EV is Plug&Charge capable, please contact your vehicle's manufacturer, look at your vehicle's owner's manual for more information, or visit our Plug&Charge page here: https://www.electrifyamerica.com/plug-and-charge/
Happy charging!

WHAT YOU GET WITH NUMISNAP 
▶ Scan a coin to instantly identify its value with AI 
▶ Get detailed numismatic info and coin price estimates
▶ Discover a coin’s history, material, and market value
▶ Change or adjust the coin's issue year and grade
▶ Save coins to a personalized collection in the app
KEY NUMISNAP FEATURES
▶ Get an AI coin expert in your pocket 
No need to visit currency collectors in their office. Instead, NumiSnap uses the power of AI to inspect your coin within seconds. The app will quickly reveal your coin’s issuer, year, type, and even get a numismatic catalog reference. All without leaving your home.

bluejetty:00173175:ios.description:
Dominate the Streets in Rope Hero: Mafia City Wars! Step into an intense action game where your mission is to restore order to a city ruled by crime. Fight against the notorious Shifters gang, capture territories, and become the ultimate blue hero.
Heroic Powers and Combat
Unleash your rope hero abilities to swing across the city, climb towering buildings, and fight crime. Use your super strength and agility to take down enemies and defend the streets.
Superhero Action Game Features:
Open-World Exploration: Navigate a massive 3D city filled with missions, challenges, and secrets. Explore rooftops, alleys, and crime hotspots in a dynamic environment. Engage in hidden mini-games and discover valuable loot across the city.
Intense Combat: Fight crime, defeat mafia bosses and other dangerous enemies. Use your trusty super rope, powerful weapons, and superpowers to dominate every encounter. Engage in tactical combat and territory battles to reclaim the city.
Heroic Missions and Duties: Take on exciting quests that test your skills and strategy. From rescuing hostages to fighting crime lords and confronting district bosses, every mission delivers nonstop action.
Weapon Arsenal: Unlock and upgrade a variety of weapons, from classic guns to futuristic blasters. Equip melee weapons, rocket launchers, or even a tank to dominate every challenge and customize your hero's loadout.
District Capture Mode: Reclaim Mafia City one district at a time. Defeat Shifters gang leaders, secure territories, and expand your influence to restore peace. Every victory unlocks new challenges and exclusive rewards.
Arena Challenge: Test your endurance in the Zombie Arena. Battle waves of undead enemies and face the robotic boss to prove your strength as the ultimate protector. The more you fight - the more you get!
Hero Customization: Unlock unique outfits and gear to personalize your hero. Create a signature look that makes you stand out as Mafia City’s savior. Don’t forget to upgrade your superpowers, whether you prefer more damage, agility or better armor!
The Ultimate Action Adventure
Rope Hero: Mafia City Wars delivers nonstop thrills with its mix of exploration, combat, and diverse gameplay elements. Battle enemies, complete missions, and reclaim the city in this unforgettable action game.
Game Highlights:
Stunning Graphics: Explore a detailed city brought to life with realistic effects.
Responsive Controls: Enjoy smooth gameplay that keeps you in control.
Endless Challenges: From district battles to survival arenas, the action never stops.
Become the Hero Mafia City Deserves
Download Rope Hero: Mafia City Wars today and step into an exciting world of action. Swing into danger, defeat your enemies, and reclaim the city as its ultimate hero!

Whether you need a vocal remover for practice, a music separator for remixing, or a stem splitter to study a track — Stem handles it all. Import any song and our AI instantly separates it into individual stems: vocals, drums, bass, guitar and piano. Clean, precise, fast.

→ Singers: use the voice isolation to study melody, pitch and phrasing
→ Guitarists: isolate the guitar track and learn every riff note by note
→ Bassists: use bass isolation to lock in with the original groove
→ Drummers: strip everything down to the drum stem and practice along
→ DJs & Producers: extract clean stems for remixes, edits and live sets
VOCAL REMOVER & KARAOKE
Remove vocals from any song to create your own karaoke version, back yourself with a full band, or practice without the distraction of the original singer. Our AI voice remover delivers cleaner vocal isolation than any other stem splitter on the market.
STEM SPLITTER FEATURES
→ AI vocal remover — isolate or remove vocals instantly
→ Music separator — split any track into stems
→ Voice isolation — clean, precise, no bleed
→ Instrument separator — vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano
→ Audio splitter — export each stem individually
→ Vocal isolation for singers and music practice
→ Remove vocals to make instrumental versions
→ Isolate vocals from any song in seconds
HOW IT WORKS
1.⁠ ⁠Import any song — from your library, Files or streaming
2.⁠ ⁠Tap Split — our AI vocal remover goes to work
3.⁠ ⁠Stems are ready in seconds
4.⁠ ⁠Play, mute, solo or export any track
WHY STEM

bluejetty:00070685:ios.name: Brotherhood - Last Outlaws
bluejetty:00070685:ios.summary:
THE STORY.
These are troubled times in San Verde. Various gangs and criminal organizations are fighting for power in the city. You are serving your last days in prison when the Mara del Diablo (MD-13) raid your brothers in their clubhouse.
bluejetty:00070685:ios.description:
THE STORY.
These are troubled times in San Verde. Various gangs and criminal organizations are fighting for power in the city. You are serving your last days in prison when the Mara del Diablo (MD-13) raid your brothers in their clubhouse. It is the end of the Bloody Roads MC. Almost all the members were killed, injured or fled town during the attack. Back in freedom, you can either bury your head in the sand or build something new with the last remaining members.
Now it's up to you to show what you're made of. Are you a leader? Do you have what it takes to become a legend?
MANAGE YOUR CREW, START A MOTORCYCLE CLUB AND RULE THE CITY!
Customize the look of your player avatar and create the coolest outlaw biker ever! 
Your territory with the clubhouse is located in a typical American urban area and has a variety of expandable buildings. Take care of your business and ensure a constant cash flow. Train and improve your men. Get the resources you need for upgrades and build a biker empire that will last. But be careful! Dreaded motorcycle clubs like the Crazy Lobos MC challenge you in an exciting story mode. Rise to the challenge and rule the city!
You can team up with other players to form a motorcycle club (MC) and create your own cool MC logo. You can assign ranks and tasks to your brothers and sisters. Decide on a strategy when you go to war against an opposing club and become the most respected MC in town!
BUILD YOUR CREW AND COLLECT BIKER CHARACTERS
You need a good crew! Brotherhood - Last Outlaws offers various authentic characters to join your motorcycle club. Collect the characters in the exciting story mode. Upgrade and train them to make them stronger and equip them with different weapons to show your opponents who is in charge in San Verde.
COLLECT WEAPONS AND ITEMS
You'll have more than 20 weapons of different types and qualities at your disposal. A shotgun or maybe you prefer the assault rifle? The choice is yours, and you are free to equip your motorcycle club characters in the best possible way! Complete your collection through PVE and PVP content and go hunting for the coolest and strongest weapons.
EXCITING STRATEGY GAMEPLAY
Brotherhood - Last Outlaws offers a simple, fun and sometimes quite challenging strategy gameplay. It all comes down to your skill, as you decide which character and weapons to use. Find the perfect setup to push back your opponents, defeat them and move up in the rankings. 
JOIN A GLOBAL COMMUNITY
Play with thousands of players from all over the world. Make friends, have someone to talk to about bikes, tactics or mechanics, and fight alongside other players in exciting and action-packed PVP battles.

bluejetty:00042309:ios.description:
Playlog is your all-in-one solution for capturing, sharing, and reliving life's most memorable moments with friends and family.
Whether you're hosting a party, on a group vacation, or celebrating a milestone, Playlog makes it easy to collaborate on shared photo albums — ensuring no moment is missed and everyone's perspective is included.
CAPTURE & SHARE MEMORIES
• Effortless Sharing – Sharing special moments is as simple as snapping a photo. Instantly upload pictures to shared albums, allowing friends and family to join in on the fun.
• All-in-One Organization – Tired of hunting through different apps for scattered photos? Keep all your memories organized in one place, ensuring your best moments are never lost.
• Original Quality – View and download all your photos and videos in the exact quality they were taken.
• Unlimited Albums – Create as many albums as you need, with 2GB of free storage per album.
COLLABORATE IN REAL-TIME
• Instant Collaboration – Real-time uploads let everyone contribute without limits.
• Easy Sharing Options – Share albums via QR code, URL, or in-app invites for seamless collaboration.
• Live Updates – Get notified as new photos are added, keeping you in the loop.
ORGANIZE & RELIVE
• Prompts – Use Prompts to help organize media or remind others what to upload. Created an album for Hiking? Create Prompts such as "The views along the way" or "Group photos at the top".
• Interactive Engagement – Engage with your shared albums by reacting to photos or commenting on them by tagging each other.
DESIGNED FOR LIFE'S MOMENTS
• From birthday parties and weddings to holidays and everyday moments, Playlog is designed for all of life's events.
• Planning something big? Collect everyone's photos in one place and relive the experience from every angle.
PRIVACY & CONTROL
• Privacy First – Full control over who can view and contribute to each album, ensuring your memories are shared only with those you trust.
• Album Management – Assign admin roles or transfer album ownership – customize your level of control with ease.
GET STARTED – Ready to create and share unforgettable albums with your loved ones? Download Playlog today and turn every moment into a collaborative memory that lasts!
ProAlbums are available for one-time purchase.
Playlog+ is available as a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. 
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. For more information, see our terms of service or privacy policy.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://playlog.com/privacy

bluejetty:00082720:ios.description:
Heart Rate — Your Personal Health Tracker
Your heart health is the foundation of your overall well-being, and staying on top of it is the key to a healthier, more active life. Heart Rate is a simple, intuitive, and powerful app designed to monitor your pulse, analyze health data, and support smarter lifestyle decisions.
Why Heart Rate Matters
Your pulse speaks volumes about your health. By regularly tracking it, you can detect changes early and gain a deeper understanding of your body. Whether you're managing blood pressure, aiming to lose weight, or just staying informed, Heart Rate is the perfect companion.
Features That Work for You
• Daily Pulse Measurement with the Camera. Just place your finger on the camera to get started — no special devices needed.
• Blood Pressure Tracking. Log your readings to monitor trends and spot crucial changes.
• Symptom Journal and Wellness Tracking. Record how you feel to uncover connections between symptoms and activity.

Whether you have one rental or one hundred, Lodgify keeps your day running while you are not at your desk.

Lodgify is a hosting platform for independent hosts and property managers. We help hosts run their business, grow direct bookings and manage every guest from booking to checkout — without the overhead of stitching tools together.

bluejetty:00071223:ios.name: Fire Hero 2D: Space Shooter
bluejetty:00071223:ios.summary:
Fire Hero 2D — Space Shooter is a minimalistic arcade scrolling shooter where your brave spaceship has to break deep into the endless galaxy shooting through alien blocks. An exciting challenge, isn’t it?
This action shooting game will pu
bluejetty:00071223:ios.description:
Fire Hero 2D — Space Shooter is a minimalistic arcade scrolling shooter where your brave spaceship has to break deep into the endless galaxy shooting through alien blocks. An exciting challenge, isn’t it?
This action shooting game will put your reaction, dexterity, and concentration to the test. Strain your wits to progress constantly from level to level in the bullet hell. 
Your enemies in the game are represented by dangerous space invaders looking as multicolored square blocks with numbers flying at you. The color of these blocks depends on the number on them, which will help you to understand faster how much effort it takes to destroy them — the bigger the number on a block, the harder it will be for you to crush it.
At the end of each level your ship will face a super-boss and you will have to work really hard to defeat it. Be ready for a massive galaxy attack!
Upgrade the appearance of your space shuttle, add more guns, increase their power and a rate of fire, use blasters and add satellite ships as assistants in a battle against a squad of enemies to become the invulnerable space runner. Do not forget to set the magnetic shield, so that you will not end your galaxy mission after the first clash.
However, you will not be able to install all the improvements at once: each time during the fight you will be offered to choose one of three options. Choose wisely in order to overcome future difficulties and to attack the enemy more efficiently. 
The game may seem simple but don’t relax — the complexity will rise with each level. The further you go, the stronger the alien squares on the levels and the more powerful are the galactic bosses. A real test of attention and reaction speed awaits. How far can you go, buddy?
Try not just fly through galaxy obstacles smashing a cube in each range with your gun, but to destroy as many cubes on your way as you can in order to get bonus points. Shoot ‘em all! 
The points you earn will allow you not only to upgrade your weapons but also to change your rocket skin. The game offers skins for any astronaut’s taste - all of different colors and shapes.
What else will definitely not leave you indifferent to our galaxy shooter? 
- this game is a new classic — it refers to old school Space Invaders, or Galaga-like shooting games and other retro scrolling shooters as well as to 1945 air force (airplane) games and galaxy shooters but also presents new exclusive mechanics and modern 3D graphics;
- you can control your spaceship just with one finger;
- you will surely appreciate the well-designed gameplay;
- you may endlessly run through the galactic dust into the depth of the Space — as long as you have enough strength and patience. Set your own record! 
Well, hero, are you looking forward to preventing a massive attack at the Universe? Then get your guns ready, launch the shuttle and break through the walls of treacherous alien blocks. Enjoy this arcade game both online and offline.
Good luck, brave space runner!

bluejetty:00134058:ios.description:
RusDate — знакомства для русскоговорящих людей по всему миру. 
Теперь найти человека с похожим менталитетом стало легко. Это же так здорово, когда понимают ваши шутки, уважают традиции и ценности — без каких-либо объяснений. А взаимная любовь к драникам, селедке под шубой и борщу - дорогого стоит.
Мы объединяем пользователей из стран СНГ — России, Беларуси и других стран — а также русскоговорящих, живущих в США, Германии, Израиле, Канаде, Великобритании и других странах.
Наше главное отличие:
- Сообщество русскоговорящих по всему миру — знакомства в СНГ, Беларуси и за рубежом.
- Люди с близкими ценностями и культурой — понимание без языкового барьера и ментальных различий.
- Подробные анкеты — важные параметры, цели и взгляды видны сразу, чтобы понять, подходите ли вы друг другу.
- Умные алгоритмы подбора — c заполненными опросами, приложение позволяет видеть анкеты с похожими интересами и мировоззрением.
Пусть ваша анкета станет заметной:
- Выделение профиля с помощью анимации из фото — привлекает больше внимания в поиске и делает анкету живой и динамичной.
- Подброс анкеты в поиске — станьте заметнее и получите больше лайков и сообщений.
- Выделение среди других пользователей — ваш профиль отображается ярче и чаще попадается в поле зрения.
Больше общения — больше шансов найти того человека, который подойдет именно вам:
- Яркие виртуальные подарки — покажут ваш интерес и симпатию.
- Бесплатные монеты за активность — за активность в приложении можно получить бонусы для подарков и улучшения профиля.
- Умный ассистент с фразами для начала беседы — больше не нужно ломать голову над первым сообщением, получите готовые варианты, которые повышают шанс на ответ.
Приватность под контролем:
- Режим «Невидимка» — оставайтесь незаметными в поиске и посещая анкеты пользователей.
- Проверка фото и анкет модераторами — тщательная модерация всех профилей, благодаря чему остаются только настоящие анкеты.
- Верификация профилей в 4 этапа — уверенность в том, что общение происходит с настоящими людьми.
Удобный поиск:
- Знакомства здесь и сейчас — возможность видеть пользователей даже в соседнем доме и находить тех, кто доступен для общения онлайн
- Фильтр по целям знакомства — отображение только тех анкет, где цели совпадают с вашими, чтобы быстрее находить подходящих людей
- Фильтр по критериям поиска - настройка критериев по поиску: рост, вес, какое образование, привычки, знак зодиака и другое. 
RusDate — познакомиться просто! 
Если у вас есть вопросы/пожелания по нашему приложению знакомств, пожалуйста, отправьте их нам на мэйл info@datesupport.net и мы с радостью вам ответим!
Условия использования: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Политика конфиденциальности: https://rusdate.net/privacy
В приложении доступны подписки. Стоимость, срок действия и условия отображаются до совершения покупки.

bluejetty:00070481:ios.description:
Solitaire by MobilityWare is the ORIGINAL maker of Solitaire free for iPad and iPhone. After more than 10 years on the App Store we are STILL improving our card game with fun new features. Make sure to try out our unique Daily Challenges!
The addictive game you’ve been playing on your computer for years now goes wherever you do. Whether you know it as Patience, Klondike, or just Solitaire, this popular game is one of the best games around.
== How to Play ==
Tap or drag cards to arrange them in descending order with alternating colors. When you can, move cards up to the foundation to sort all of the suits from Ace to King. You can draw one card at a time for a more relaxing game, or draw three for a challenge to train your brain!
== Features == 
- Daily Challenges: Earn crowns & trophies by solving each day’s new challenge
- Levels & Titles: Earn points every time you play to level up and achieve new titles
- Winning Deals: Play deals where you know there is at least one winning solution
- Stickers: Send cute reaction stickers to your friends through iMessage
- Customization: Change your background, card backs and card faces for a personalized experience
- Show Me How To Win: Improve your strategy by using the “Show Me How To Win” feature
- Leaderboards & Statistics: See how you stack up against other players, or try to beat your own high score
- Custom Settings: Play right or left-handed, portrait or landscape, multiple scoring styles, and adjust hands to draw-1 or draw-3
- Unlimited hints and Undos
== More Fun Card Games from MobilityWare ==
MobilityWare makes the best card games on the App Store. Try some of our other games:
- Spider Solitaire
- Freecell

Surrounded by majestic lakes, marvellous vineyards and magnificent views, the golf course is carved into the mountainside providing breathtaking vistas on every hole. Designed by golf legend Freddy Couples, the course optimizes the natural beauty of the area while maintaining a professional edge that can challenge even the most seasoned golfer.
The welcoming and friendly area of Vernon is the perfect place for a relaxing getaway or a holiday with the family. From boating, to hiking to biking and exploring, the Okanagan provides unending adventures.

Each hole is distinct in its character with dramatic elevated tees and breathtaking views of Okanagan Lake on 12 of our 18 holes.

bluejetty:00022441:ios.name: PlayTally: Apple Music Stats
bluejetty:00022441:ios.summary:
PlayTally is the ultimate music companion that takes your listening experience to the next level.
REAL-TIME REPLAY
Now you have the power to relive your favorite songs anytime, not just on a yearly basis. PlayTally generates lists in real-
bluejetty:00022441:ios.description:
PlayTally is the ultimate music companion that takes your listening experience to the next level.
REAL-TIME REPLAY
Now you have the power to relive your favorite songs anytime, not just on a yearly basis. PlayTally generates lists in real-time, ensuring you're always up to date with your music trends. Choose any date range and discover your top tracks for that specific period. Plus, you can easily mark tracks like white noise and sleep sounds to keep them out of your Trends list.
TRACK YOUR HISTORY
Track your music history effortlessly by syncing PlayTally data across multiple devices through iCloud Music Library. you can even track additional Apple Music devices. Take a trip down memory lane and see what you were jamming to on any given day. Plus, create personalized playlists from your music history.
EARN AWARDS
As you dive deeper into your music journey, PlayTally rewards you with badges for your dedication and growing music collection. It's like earning activity awards for your ears!
SEE YOUR STATS
Explore your music collection like never before with PlayTally's advanced statistics and charts. Easily sort and browse through large libraries based on your listening habits. Gain valuable insights into your music preferences over time and share your most impressive stats with friends and followers.
COMPLETELY AD-FREE.
No distractions, no interruptions. PlayTally is completely ad-free and seamlessly integrates with your Apple Music. No extra accounts, signups, or subscriptions required.
PRIVACY FIRST
Your privacy is our priority – your data stays on your device and personal iCloud storage, and you have the option to delete it whenever you want. If you wish, you can also export and backup your data in CSV format. You're in control.
NO VIBE-CODING
PlayTally is developed by an independent developer. No AI has been used in it's development.
—
TIPS FOR BEST PERFORMANCE
For optimal performance, make sure PlayTally regularly scans your music library. Create a convenient automated shortcut to open PlayTally daily or weekly, ensuring your data is always up to date and accurate.
NOTE: Because PlayTally tracks its own data, it cannot reconstruct playback history from before it was installed.

Looking for a calm daily triangle puzzle? Nodes is a relaxing vertex puzzle where you connect dots, form triangles, and reveal beautiful low-poly art.
Play a new hand-crafted puzzle every day and enjoy a simple visual logic game designed for focus, calm, and unwind moments. Each puzzle blends satisfying dot connections, triangle strategy, and artistic reveals into a peaceful daily ritual.

bluejetty:00165818:ios.description:
Swipe to move the buses and clear the jam!
Twist through traffic, unlock every route, and escape the chaos! Outsmart tricky puzzles, think fast, and prove you’re the ultimate traffic master.
How To Play
Tap to move buses through narrow lanes and guide them toward the bus escape route.
Find the best path to help each bus break free from traffic and master your bus escape strategy.
No time limit – enjoy relaxing bus escape 3D gameplay or challenge yourself to find the quickest route.
Unlock endless levels, new buses, and fun bus escape scenarios as you progress through the jammed streets.
Game Feature
Navigate Bus Tracks: Align passengers with their color-coded seats to clear the level. Solve intricate puzzles by moving cars and freeing up the bus escape path.
Bus Escape Puzzles: Think, plan, and solve exciting challenges to create the perfect bus escape route through traffic jams.
Diverse Challenges: From small lots to massive parking areas, face increasingly complex bus escape puzzles that keep your brain active.
Strategic Gameplay: Think ahead, move quickly, and use clever tactics to find the best bus escape route for every jam.
Immersive Design: Stunning visuals, ASMR effects, and fluid animations make every bus escape level enjoyable and stress-free.
Offline Mode: Play bus escape puzzles anytime, anywhere – no internet required!
Boosters & Power-ups
Unlock powerful boosters to clear tricky bus escape paths and overcome obstacles.
From lane-clearing tools to move rewinders, every power-up helps you perfect your bus escape strategy and master the puzzle.
Can you guide every bus through the chaos and find the way to freedom?
For support or suggestions, email us at gamewayfu@wayfustudio.com.

Enjoy free fitness programs and other at-home workouts with master instructor Jenny Ford. Jenny is a certified group fitness instructor who creates total body workouts that engage the whole plane of the body. Workouts are typically 30-minute cardio sessions always with options to pump up the heart rate. Step Aerobics, Barre, Yoga, Walking, Weight Trainings, Core, and more. - FITNESS App: Apple Watch integrates with Apple's Fitness App, and workouts contribute to your daily goals. View stats, share your activity, and get those Activity Rings!
- Use your Watch as a Remote: Play, stop, & rewind videos without interrupting workouts.
- Install using iPhone: Install app on iPhone, open Watch app, select "Show on Apple Watch".

bluejetty:00080479:ios.description:
Paris 1965. 
Two thieves venture on a heist to steal a precious diamond. This should be a simple job. 
But someone is following them. 
Midnight Girl is a casual 2D point-and-click adventure game that takes place in France during the Sixties. The story, mood, and style of the game are inspired by the city of Paris, Belgian comics and heist films from the Sixties. 
The late teen tomboy Monique enjoys life as a cat burglar in Paris. She ends up in jail after a heist gone wrong, and here she meets an enigmatic prisoner and fellow thief. The prisoner knows of precious diamond - stored in a secret underground vault in the heart of Paris. They agree to try and steal the diamond together, and this leads our heroes on a quest through a catholic monastery, a Parisian metro station and the Catacombs.

bluejetty:00174918:ios.description:
First developed in 2008, 12 Steps Companion was the world’s first recovery app. It is a reader, sobriety tracker, and recovery toolkit.
The reader covers the first 164 pages of Alcoholics Anonymous, plus more than 60 personal stories, the original forewords, and the appendices from the First and Second Editions. Dark mode, highlighting, adjustable type, a concordance search, and a built-in dictionary are included.
Also available: 12 Steps Speakers, for talks recorded by members around the world.
KEY FEATURES
UNIVERSAL • Built for iPhone and iPad • Cloud-themed design and a quiet, discrete home-screen icon
SOBRIETY CALCULATOR & WIDGETS • Sobriety length on the launch screen • Home-screen widgets with years, months, days, and hours
THE READER • Dark mode • Highlight and unhighlight text • Adjustable font size • Full-screen reading in portrait or landscape • First 164 pages, plus 60+ stories from the 1st and 2nd editions • Original forewords and appendices • Page numbers and quick page jump • Tap any word to define it • Collapsible index • Return to a bookmark from any note
SEARCH • Full concordance • Results highlighted in place
PRAYERS & PROMISES • Morning and night prayers • Prayers from the Twelve Steps • Prayer of St. Francis • Promises collected from the text
NOTES • Highlight a passage and attach a note • Share via Messages, Mail, and other apps • App attribution is added when you share
CONTACTS • U.S. central offices, areas, districts, and answering services • Tap to call, email, or open a website • Maps and directions • Add your own contacts
SUPPORT Questions or feedback: www.deanhuff.com
Only stories from the 1st and 2nd editions are included • This app is available to U.S. customers only
Not affiliated with AA World Services, Inc. Alcoholics Anonymous and The Big Book are registered trademarks of AA World Services, Inc. Please support A.A. by purchasing a printed copy from your local central office.

bluejetty:00096907:ios.description:
Welcome to Jigsort®: Solitaire Fun, a relaxing picture puzzle game where every card helps reveal a beautiful image.
In Jigsort®, each puzzle begins with scattered picture cards. Your goal is to observe the details, sort the cards into the right places, and gradually complete the full picture. With simple controls, satisfying progress, and colorful artwork, Jigsort® offers a calm and enjoyable puzzle experience for players who love visual challenges.
Whether you want a quiet break, a daily puzzle routine, or a casual way to keep your mind active, Jigsort® gives you a fresh and relaxing way to play.
A Fresh Picture Puzzle Experience
Jigsort® combines the satisfaction of completing pictures with the simple fun of card-based sorting.
Instead of placing traditional puzzle pieces, you arrange picture cards that each contain part of a larger image. As you move the cards, connect visual clues, and find the correct order, the picture slowly comes together.
Every completed puzzle gives you a rewarding moment of discovery.
Easy to Learn, Satisfying to Play
The rules are simple: look carefully, move the cards, and complete the image.
Jigsort® is designed to be easy to understand from the first level. Smooth controls make each move feel natural, while later puzzles bring more detail and challenge for players who enjoy observation-based gameplay.
You can play at your own pace, without pressure or complicated mechanics.
Reveal Beautiful Images
Explore a wide variety of picture themes and visual styles.
You may discover relaxing landscapes, cute animals, colorful flowers, tasty food, peaceful travel scenes, seasonal pictures, and everyday moments. Each puzzle brings a new image to reveal and a new scene to complete.
The more you play, the more beautiful pictures you can enjoy.
Relaxing Gameplay for Any Moment
Jigsort® is made for calm, satisfying play.
Take a short break during the day, relax in the evening, or enjoy a longer puzzle session whenever you want. The game is designed to feel peaceful and rewarding, making it easy to return again and again.
No rush. No stress. Just focus on the image, sort the cards, and enjoy the feeling of completion.
Daily Challenges
Come back each day for new puzzle goals.
Daily challenges give you fresh reasons to play, test your observation skills, and continue discovering new pictures. Whether you complete one puzzle or spend more time exploring, there is always something enjoyable waiting for you.
Build Your Picture Collection
Every completed puzzle adds to your sense of progress.
As you continue playing, you can discover more scenes, complete more visual challenges, and enjoy a growing collection of picture-based puzzles. Each image is a small achievement, making every session feel rewarding.
Helpful and Comfortable Gameplay
Jigsort® is designed to be friendly for all skill levels.
If a puzzle feels tricky, helpful features are available when needed. You can take your time, think through each move, and enjoy the process without feeling stuck.
The experience is smooth, intuitive, and suitable for both casual players and puzzle fans.
Features
• Relaxing picture puzzle gameplay
• Simple card sorting controls
• Beautiful images to reveal
• Daily challenges and fresh goals
• A variety of picture themes
• Observation-based puzzle solving
• Helpful hints when needed
• Smooth and satisfying progression
• Calm gameplay for short or long sessions
Why Players Enjoy Jigsort®
Jigsort® is easy to start, relaxing to play, and rewarding to complete.
Each level offers a clear goal: sort the picture cards and reveal the full image. The gameplay is simple, but every puzzle encourages focus, patience, and visual thinking.
From the first move to the final completed picture, Jigsort® gives you a satisfying puzzle journey filled with color, detail, and discovery.

In Jigsort®, each puzzle begins with scattered picture cards. Your goal is to observe the details, sort the cards into the right places, and gradually complete the full picture. With simple controls, satisfying progress, and colorful artwork, Jigsort® offers a calm and enjoyable puzzle experience for players who love visual challenges.

Whether you want a quiet break, a daily puzzle routine, or a casual way to keep your mind active, Jigsort® gives you a fresh and relaxing way to play.

A Fresh Picture Puzzle Experience

Jigsort® combines the satisfaction of completing pictures with the simple fun of card-based sorting.

Instead of placing traditional puzzle pieces, you arrange picture cards that each contain part of a larger image. As you move the cards, connect visual clues, and find the correct order, the picture slowly comes together.

Every completed puzzle gives you a rewarding moment of discovery.

Easy to Learn, Satisfying to Play

The rules are simple: look carefully, move the cards, and complete the image.

Jigsort® is designed to be easy to understand from the first level. Smooth controls make each move feel natural, while later puzzles bring more detail and challenge for players who enjoy observation-based gameplay.

You can play at your own pace, without pressure or complicated mechanics.

Reveal Beautiful Images

Explore a wide variety of picture themes and visual styles.

You may discover relaxing landscapes, cute animals, colorful flowers, tasty food, peaceful travel scenes, seasonal pictures, and everyday moments. Each puzzle brings a new image to reveal and a new scene to complete.

The more you play, the more beautiful pictures you can enjoy.

Relaxing Gameplay for Any Moment

Jigsort® is made for calm, satisfying play.

Take a short break during the day, relax in the evening, or enjoy a longer puzzle session whenever you want. The game is designed to feel peaceful and rewarding, making it easy to return again and again.

No rush. No stress. Just focus on the image, sort the cards, and enjoy the feeling of completion.

Daily Challenges

Come back each day for new puzzle goals.

Daily challenges give you fresh reasons to play, test your observation skills, and continue discovering new pictures. Whether you complete one puzzle or spend more time exploring, there is always something enjoyable waiting for you.

Build Your Picture Collection

Every completed puzzle adds to your sense of progress.

As you continue playing, you can discover more scenes, complete more visual challenges, and enjoy a growing collection of picture-based puzzles. Each image is a small achievement, making every session feel rewarding.

Helpful and Comfortable Gameplay

Jigsort® is designed to be friendly for all skill levels.

If a puzzle feels tricky, helpful features are available when needed. You can take your time, think through each move, and enjoy the process without feeling stuck.

The experience is smooth, intuitive, and suitable for both casual players and puzzle fans.

Features

• Relaxing picture puzzle gameplay
• Simple card sorting controls
• Beautiful images to reveal
• Daily challenges and fresh goals
• A variety of picture themes
• Observation-based puzzle solving
• Helpful hints when needed
• Smooth and satisfying progression
• Calm gameplay for short or long sessions

Why Players Enjoy Jigsort®

Jigsort® is easy to start, relaxing to play, and rewarding to complete.

Each level offers a clear goal: sort the picture cards and reveal the full image. The gameplay is simple, but every puzzle encourages focus, patience, and visual thinking.

From the first move to the final completed picture, Jigsort® gives you a satisfying puzzle journey filled with color, detail, and discovery.

bluejetty:00180531:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00180531:ios.description:
Say goodbye to paperwork and hello to saving time and getting back to what matters.
GeoNext is job management software that has everything you need, from job scheduling and tracking to invoices and quotes, without being difficult to use. It takes the load off from admin work and allows you to get things done while on the go. 
But the most important part of GeoNext is you! That’s why we have free training and onboarding and 24/7 customer support with real people. We want GeoNext to work with your business, so we guide you every step of the way and let you learn at your own pace.
GeoNext’s features include:
* Job Scheduling - create and assign jobs in real-time
* GeoNext Scheduling - create and assign jobs based on a worker’s location
* Offline Mode - create/edit jobs without phone coverage
* Billables - track any material or time your team spends on jobs buy for jobs
* Maps - easily find the location of a job and never end up at the wrong place again
* Navigation - arrive at jobs on-time, every time with route optimisation from your navigation apps
* Job Statuses - see the status of a job in real-time from start to end
* Job Notes - attach notes, images, signatures and barcodes to a job for easy storage and sharing
* Photo Capture - take and store photos for a job
* Sign-on glass - capture signatures directly on your device
* Site Log - automatically share notes
* Team Management - assign roles to your team such as Admin, Team Leader, Staff and Subcontractor
* Privacy - restrict visibility of private information and keep your details safe
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
GeoNext offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription. The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.
GeoNext's Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy: https://geoworkforcesolutions.com/privacy-policy-terms-conditions

bluejetty:00036186:ios.description:
In the ever-evolving world of communication, our app emerges as your invaluable companion, preserving the precious moments and crucial details that shape your personal and professional life. This comprehensive call recording solution transforms your smartphone into a trusted vault, safeguarding your conversations with unparalleled reliability.
Whether you're a busy entrepreneur finalizing important deals, a diligent customer service agent handling sensitive inquiries, or simply someone who values the ability to review and reference past conversations, Call Recorder is your indispensable tool. With just a tap, this app discreetly captures the audio of your incoming and outgoing calls, ensuring you never miss a vital piece of information or lose track of essential details.
But Call Recorder is more than just a recording device – it's a powerful assistant that streamlines your workflow and enhances your productivity.
Safeguard your professional interactions, protect your legal rights, and preserve the precious memories of your personal communications. Call Recorder offers unparalleled peace of mind, empowering you to focus on the moment while knowing your conversations are securely stored for future reference.
Premium Subscription:
Weekly subscription
Monthly subscription
Annual subscription
Use our premium features: All Recording Function and Save History Calling.
All subscriptions may include a 3-day trial. Your iTunes account will be charged after purchase confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions and auto-renewal settings easily in Account Settings.
Your privacy is our top priority. 
* Privacy and Support:
Review our privacy policy:https://www.caserevore.info/CallRecorderVoiceRecord_PrivacyPolicy.html
Check our Terms of Use to understand how we protect your data:https://www.caserevore.info/CallRecorderVoiceRecord_TermsOfUse.html
For assistance, contact our support service:calikkfurknn7932@hotmail.com
Disclaimer: Please note that the use of call recording functionality must comply with all applicable laws and regulations in your area. It is your responsibility to ensure that you have obtained the necessary permissions and consents before recording any conversations.
Experience the confidence that comes with having a trusted call recording companion at your fingertips. Call Recorder – your voice, your story, preserved with unwavering reliability.

bluejetty:00069552:ios.description:
Dos means Two. Dos is the follow up to the classic card game Uno. Are you ready to have fun?
The evergreen, classic UNO card game now has a new best friend, DOS.
This game is a must have for all the fans of the popular game Uno.
The objective of the game is to be the first to get rid of all your cards, and when there are two cards to go, don't forget to shout "Dos!”
In this fun game, two is more important than one and numbers are king! To start, there are two piles in the middle, and on each player’s turn they can play on both piles with either one or two cards. In a fun twist, if a player has two cards that add up to the number of the card in the center pile, they are able to put down both cards.
Dos is a race to get rid of your cards before your opponents do. And in a fun twist, now when you’re down to two cards, don’t forget to shout "Dos".
There are two ways you can match a face up card in Dos game:
First a player can play a card that exactly matches the number on one of the faces up cards (single number match).
Otherwise a player can play two cards that add up to one of the face up cards (double number match).
The basic premise of the Dos game is to play cards from your hand by matching the number of the last played card.
Simply bored? You are in for an overload of fun with Dos Classic card game.
Trust us – like Uno, Dos Classic is a real blast!
Download Dos today for hours of fun!!
*** Dos Uno Classic Features***
1. Play with Friends or Others around the Globe.
2. 2, 3, 4 Player Mode .
3. Achievements and Leaderboard.
4. Create Private Room and Invite Friends and Family.
5. Play with players across the world.
6. Get Free coins by Spin wheel.
7. Fast-paced, competitive and fun - for free!
8. Rules of the game is explained in great detail in the ‘Settings’ section.
Don't forget to Rate and Review our game Dos Classic so that we can make it better!
Share the Dos game with your friends!
Enjoy Dos!

bluejetty:00157129:ios.summary: Now CPI makes it just as easy for you to stay connected to what really matters most: your home and family. With the NEW inTouch App from CPI Security, CPI customers can monitor and control their home or business security system through iPho
bluejetty:00157129:ios.description:
Now CPI makes it just as easy for you to stay connected to what really matters most: your home and family. With the NEW inTouch App from CPI Security, CPI customers can monitor and control their home or business security system through iPhone and iPod touch!
With the inTouch App you can -
* Arm and disarm your CPI Security System.
* See what doors and windows are open in real time.
* Be notified when the system is armed or disarmed.
Great for school-age children!
* Access a 30 day event history.
* Access CPI Night Guard enabled devices.
Email and Text notifications –
With the inTouch service you can set up email and text notifications to come to your iPhone or iPod touch in real time –
- when an alarm event occurs - fire, water leak, intrusion, or medical panic
- when a specific user arms or disarms the system
- when someone opens a door or window
- if you left a door or window open
- if you forgot to arm the system
- if your safe, gun or liquor cabinet is opened
- if someone attempts to login to your inTouch account
and more!
*Functionality depends on the level of inTouch service you have subscribed to. A CPI inTouch user login and password are required to log into this app. Visit www.cpisecurity.com/intouch to learn more or to sign up for service.

bluejetty:00169565:ios.name: Screw Challenge: Nuts & Bolts
bluejetty:00169565:ios.summary: Do you love hard screw pin puzzles and metal materials? If the answer is yes, so Screw Challenge: Nuts and Bolts game is so fit for you. This game is the combination of strategic thinking to solve nuts and bolts screw puzzle with the satisf
bluejetty:00169565:ios.description:
Do you love hard screw pin puzzles and metal materials? If the answer is yes, so Screw Challenge: Nuts and Bolts game is so fit for you. This game is the combination of strategic thinking to solve nuts and bolts screw puzzle with the satisfying clinks of metal. The challenge lies in deciding to remove screw to which position first and later because there’s no undo button.
Exciting Features of Screw Challenge: Nuts and Bolts
- Sequential Strategy: You have to think before play or you might fail a lot of time. The number of holes is intentionally smaller than the nuts, demanding precision in choosing which screw moves first and later.
- Time Strict Levels: Feel the rush. In hard levels, time is your adversary. Removing screw swiftly under the pressure of a strict time limit is one of the most challenging part in nuts and bolts screw puzzle.
- Unlimited Levels: Creativity knows no bounds. With unlimited levels, each session offers a fresh and invigorating challenge with different arrangements of the metals.
- Improve Your Logic: this screw pin puzzle isn't just a game. It's an immersive experience designed to captivate and challenge your intellect when each move carries a lot of calculation and strategy. Let’s see can you become a screw master? 
- Sensory Rich Atmosphere: ASMR sound of metal accompanies every move, enhancing the tactile satisfaction as you navigate the nuts and bolts screw puzzle.
- Intriguing Background: Meticulously crafted background with interesting characters from interesting Art work, cartoon, etc. You can see various types of art like frogs, and pumpkins, flowers... converted to screw nut puzzle.
- Irreversible Moves: No undo button here. Embrace the challenge – every move is irreversible, adding a thrilling risk element to your decisions.
Steps to win the game:
- Screw challenge requires you remove screw strategically to release wood and metal items, navigating the intricate screw pin puzzle.
- No undo button here. Embrace the challenge – every move is irreversible, adding a thrilling risk element to your decisions.
- Strategically deploy free boosters to overcome challenges and master screw pin puzzle.
- Join daily challenges to acquire more boosters which will help you overcome hard levels.
Get ready to elevate your gatherings and let the party charades begin!
Privacy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1U2mluYGBHW26YAOoqWz

bluejetty:00120710:ios.description:
"Learning Transport" is a fun educational game for kids of early preschool age. With the help of this game little children will get acquainted with various machinery and transport, which people have invented for different purposes. 
Main features:
1) Children will learn emergency transport, agricultural machinery, construction machinery, and military vehicles.
2) There are 15 vehicles for learning in the game: 
● rescue transport - an ambulance, a fire engine, a police car, a helicopter, a lifeboat;
● special machinery - a crane, an excavator, a tractor, an asphalt roller, a harvester; 
● military vehicles - a T-34 tank, an armored vehicle, a bomber, an anti-aircraft weapon, a warship.

bluejetty:00155008:ios.summary: A FESAN INTELIGÊNCIA EM CONDOMÍNIOS foi fundada com o propósito exclusivo de oferecer aos seus clientes maior dinamismo, tecnologia e soluções eficientes no cotidiano de condomínios residenciais, comerciais, logisticos e associações de mora
bluejetty:00155008:ios.description:
A FESAN INTELIGÊNCIA EM CONDOMÍNIOS foi fundada com o propósito exclusivo de oferecer aos seus clientes maior dinamismo, tecnologia e soluções eficientes no cotidiano de condomínios residenciais, comerciais, logisticos e associações de moradores em loteamentos fechados.
Contamos com profissionais altamente qualificados e dedicados, com mais de uma década de experiência no mercado, buscando sempre o atendimento de forma personalizada, valorizando o contato direto com o cliente.
Tanto pelo site da FESAN quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Com a FESAN, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para fesan@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00187645:ios.description:
Gemini is a secure platform for buying, selling, storing, staking, and earning crypto, and for making predictions on real-world outcomes. Trusted by millions worldwide, Gemini is built for users who demand deep liquidity, strong security, and a reliable trading experience. Founded in 2014 by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, Gemini is licensed and regulated in all 50 states.
EARN CRYPTO, NOT POINTS WITH THE GEMINI CREDIT CARD®
The Gemini Credit Card® is available in multiple colors including The Solana Edition credit card in gradient, the Bitcoin Credit Card™ in orange or the XRP Edition credit card in blue. Earn SOL, bitcoin, XRP or one of 50+ other crypto rewards with every card tap:
• 4% back on gas, EV charging, transit & rideshares¹
• 3% back on dining
• 2% back on groceries
• 1% back on everything else
No annual fee credit card². Choose from 50+ cryptocurrencies to earn your rewards. The Gemini Mastercard® is issued by WebBank.
GEMINI PREDICTIONS
Trade on real-world outcomes with Gemini Predictions, a prediction market available in all 50 states. Gemini Predictions offers event contracts that are simple yes or no questions on future events.
ADVANCED TRADING
Upgrade your Gemini crypto trading experience:
• Real-time charts & order books
• 300+ trading pairs (availability varies by region)
• Pro order types: limit & stop, immediate-or-cancel, fill-or-kill, maker-or-cancel
EASY BUYING & RECURRING BUYS
Buy crypto instantly or set up recurring crypto buys to invest — like a 401(k), IRA or savings plan. No need to time the market. Link your bank account & start building your crypto portfolio. Bitcoin, ether, solana, XRP & more.
PRICE ALERTS
Set custom alerts & get notified when a crypto token hit your target price. Never miss a market move.
SUPPORTED ASSETS
Trade a wide range of popular and emerging digital crypto assets including tokens, memecoins & stablecoins:
Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), ZCash (ZEC), Tether (USDT), XRP, Solana (SOL), USD Coin (USDC), Dogecoin (DOGE), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Litecoin (LTC), PEPE (PEPE), Bonk (BONK) & more.
GEMINI STAKING
Put your crypto to work. Stake supported assets including Ethereum (ETH) & Solana (SOL) in just a few taps & earn rewards directly in the app. For US customers only excluding New York.
GEMINI REFERRAL PROGRAM
$50 for you, $50 for your friends. Share the best referral offer in crypto & get $50 when you invite a friend to Gemini & they trade $100 USD.
SECURITY & PROTECTION
Gemini is a regulated cryptocurrency exchange, wallet & custodian. Gemini is a New York trust company that is subject to the capital reserve requirements, cybersecurity requirements & banking compliance standards set forth by the New York Department of Financial Services & the New York Banking Law. All customer funds held on Gemini are held 1:1 and available for withdrawal at any time. Trust Is Our Product™. Our crypto storage system & wallet have been built by industry-leading security experts. We require two-factor authentication (2FA) for every account. You can secure the Gemini mobile app with a passcode and/or biometrics. We look forward to earning your trust.
SUPPORT, ANYTIME
Need help? Our customer support team is just an email away support@gemini.com
All forms of investments carry risks, including the risk of losing all of the invested amount. Such activities may not be suitable for everyone.
The Bitcoin Credit Card™ is a trademark of Gemini used in connection with the Gemini Credit Card®, which is issued by WebBank.

²For more information regarding fees, interest, and other cost information, see Rates & Fees: gemini.com/legal/cardholder-agreement.

bluejetty:00186755:ios.name: Desmos Scientific Calculator
bluejetty:00186755:ios.summary: Move beyond arithmetic with the Desmos scientific calculator! In addition to the basic operations, take advantage of a variety of built-in functions for exploring trigonometry, statistics, combinatorics, and more. Or, define and evaluate yo
bluejetty:00186755:ios.description:
Move beyond arithmetic with the Desmos scientific calculator! In addition to the basic operations, take advantage of a variety of built-in functions for exploring trigonometry, statistics, combinatorics, and more. Or, define and evaluate your own functions -- all for free.
At Desmos, we imagine a world of universal math literacy where math is accessible and enjoyable for all students. To that end, we’ve built a simple yet powerful scientific calculator that runs on the same blazingly fast math engine as our next-generation graphing calculator, but with a more streamlined set of features, for those times when you just don’t need a graph. It’s intuitive, beautiful, and completely free.
Features:
Arithmetic: In addition to the basic operations, the scientific calculator also supports exponentiation, radicals, absolute value, logarithms, rounding, and percentages.
Trigonometry: Evaluate the fundamental trigonometric functions and their inverses, using either radians or degrees for angle measure.
Statistics: Compute the mean and standard deviation (sample or population) of a list of data.
Combinatorics: Count combinations and permutations and calculate factorials.
Other features:
- Works offline, no internet connection required.
- Create and evaluate your own functions using familiar function notation.
- Assign values to variables for later use.
- View multiple expressions at once. Unlike many scientific calculators, all of your previous work remains visible on the screen.
- The “ans” key always holds the value of your last computation so that you never have to remember or copy a result. If you change an earlier expression, the “ans” value updates automatically.
- Did we mention it’s free?

bluejetty:00116378:ios.description:
Learn languages with Language Reactor using Active Recall and Spaced Repetition in context.
Learn a new word just to forget it minutes later?
The problem isn’t you—it’s passive recall. By seeing translations too quickly, your brain never truly locks in new vocabulary. 
Our app flips the process: you try recalling words first, then check the translation. This active recall approach cements vocabulary into your long-term memory. Ready to stop forgetting and start mastering? Install now!
Features include:
- Active Recall: Promotes deeper memory retention by requiring you to recall words and phrases rather than passively recognizing them.
- Adaptive Learning: Starts with full translations and gradually shifts to giving hints like the first letter of a word, catering to your learning progress.
- Seamless Integration: Works intuitively with text and audio on various websites, providing a fluid learning experience without switching contexts.
- Customizable Settings: Allows you to adjust the difficulty level and choose which aspects of language learning to focus on.
To get started, navigate to any webpage and click on unfamiliar words or listen to dialogues. The extension will facilitate your learning process without interrupting your browsing experience.
We support 100+ languages and reader with Voice Aloud Reader and more...
We are constantly improving our tools based on user feedback. Please feel free to reach out if you have suggestions or need support. We're excited to be part of your language learning journey!

Single Ride

Happy riding!

bluejetty:00119813:ios.description:
Enjoy the iKnow! experience on your phone or tablet!
All your iKnow! study progress is automatically synched across devices, so you can study in the way that best matches your needs and lifestyle.
“Japanese, Chinese, and English”
Official courses are offered for studying Japanese, Chinese, and SAT English. The Japanese courses cover the 6,000 most commonly used words in Japanese. The Chinese courses cover the 2,000 most commonly used words in spoken Chinese and over 1,200 words commonly used in newspapers and magazines. (All Chinese courses are available in both Traditional and Simplified Chinese.) All words have sample sentences and audio.
“The iKnow! Learning Engine”
iKnow! presents items in a spaced rehearsal pattern optimized for efficient learning. iKnow! adapts to differences in learning speeds and item difficulty, constantly measuring memory and predicting performance across all of your items. iKnow! does this by tracking your performance and then predicting your optimal review time on an item-by-item basis.
All you have to do is push the study button, and iKnow! tells you what to learn.
＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊
Features:
- Five study modes: iKnow!, Rapid Choice, Self Check, Sentence Trainer, and Listening.
- iKnow!: Master words and phrases with our patented learning algorithms.
- Rapid Choice: Fast-paced quizzing and review.
- Self Check: Judge yourself on what you know and how well. 
- Sentence Trainer: Master sentence patterns by listening and then dictating.
- Listening: Listen to content on the go. You can slow down and loop any audio.
- Study progress synched across supported devices.

The National Bank of Indianapolis App gives you all the functions of Online Banking to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
The National Bank of Indianapolis App allows you to perform a wide variety of online banking activities, such as:
Checking balances and viewing transactions
Setting up transaction and balance alerts
Making payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Turn off your debit card if you’ve lost or misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find banking centers and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices.
To take advantage of the convenience and simplicity of The National Bank of Indianapolis App, you must be enrolled as a National Bank of Indianapolis Online Banking user. If you currently use our Online Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and log in with the same Online Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00187672:ios.description:
Your choices, your story, your episode: Love, Rock, and Surf!
Is It Love? Adam is an interactive story in English.
Like in TV sitcoms, new episodes (chapters) are regularly released. 
You can download this interactive love game for free. Will you find Love? Will you manage to seduce the drummer of a rock band?
Story:
You've been living in New York City for several months now working for the mysterious Ryan Carter, on one of the floors of the Carter Corporation building; a huge glass skyscraper overlooking Manhattan.
Your life has always gone pretty smoothly. You have a stable job, your friends are loyal, your life, in general, is quiet and calm, but it lacks that little bit of freedom, that whiff of adventure. One person will come along and change it all, he will take you beyond your greatest expectations. Adam, a young drummer in a rock band that's rising to fame, will catch your attention and haunt your dreams. Adam is a free spirit, determined and ideological, he will take you on a hot and salty ride between the ocean, wild concerts, and his darker secrets...
The question is... are you ready to take the risk?
Strong points:
- Live a true love story.
- It's your game: Your choices influence the story.
- A 100% in English
- Learn to surf
- Get involved to defend and protect the planet
An Otome is a visual novel type game in which you are the heroine about to live true romance (a love story) with possible twists (Love, seduction, betrayal, marriage...).
Download this fun, rock, flirting game, if you:
- Like turbulent love stories.
- Watch romantic films, action movies or musicals.
- Want to live a love story with a drummer who's mad about surf.
- Discover a new interactive game in English
Follow us:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/isitlovegames/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/isitlovegames
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weareisitlovegames/
Got any problems or questions?
Contact our in-game support team by clicking on Menu and then Support.
Our story:
1492 Studio is based in Montpellier, France. It was co-founded in 2014 by Claire and Thibaud Zamora, two entrepreneurs with over twenty years’ experience in the freemium game industry. Acquired by Ubisoft in 2018, the studio has forged ahead in creating interactive stories in the form of visual novels, further enriching the content of their "Is It Love?" series. With a total of fourteen mobile applications with more than 60 million downloads to date, 1492 Studio designs games that take players on a journey through worlds that are rich in intrigue, suspense and, of course, romance. The studio continues to provide live games by creating additional content and keeping in touch with a strong and active fan base while working on upcoming projects.

bluejetty:00093563:ios.description:
学习英语一点都不难。任何一个学好了英语的人都会发现，只要听够一定量的材料，阅读够一定量的材料，练习一定量时间对话一定可以轻轻松松的学会英语。
那么为什么英语还是中国人的老大难问题呢？因为不知道读什么。因为读的时候挫折感太大。读小学英语课本每个单词都认识没有意思。但是读新闻，真的找本英文书看，不会的单词太多太挫折，一个词一个词的去查去发音太麻烦了。
英语轻松读就是我们针对已经有一定英语阅读能力的人群推出的阅读辅助工具。
你只需要简单的选择你的大致英语词汇水平（事后随时可修改），我们就可以在新闻正文里面自动给你可能不理解的词语加上短注释来提示你。这样即使一篇新闻你有一半以上的生词，你仍旧可以非常快速轻松的阅读它。
*小窍门，你不需要马上牢牢记住那些生词。你只要多阅读，用这个app，你可以轻松的积累你对真实世界英语的词汇量，语感和理解。记住，一切只跟你曝光的词汇量有关系。
即使有些词系统没有自动标出，你也直接点击任何一个单词，哪里不会点哪里，你都不需要单独买个点读机……
细节功能太多，我们随便列举一些：
- 聚合各种主流新闻媒体的新闻
- 自动辅助阅读
- 点击查词，自动发声
- 支持黑夜模式
- 热门列表
- 阅读历史
- 稍后阅读
- 生词表
- 已知单词自动隐藏提示
- 可以针对Safari浏览的英文页面打开阅读辅助功能

– 您将以您当地的货币按iTunes规定的现行汇率进行收费。
– 付款将于确认购买时从iTunes帐户中扣除。
– 在有效的订阅期间，不允许取消目前的订阅。
– 除非在当期结束前至少24小时关闭自动更新，否则订阅将自动更新。
– 订阅由你的iTunes帐户管理，购买后可在帐户设定中关闭自动续订。

Add a touch of class for FREE to your next poker tournament. This simple poker clock allows you to easily setup your blind structure and worry more about your cards over keeping track of the blinds.

• Show blinds, antes, and breaks
• Two sound choices and vibrate for iPhone
• Quickly add to or edit your blind structure
• Pause at level end option
• Option to keep system awake

• Global Chip Color Display
• Background Colors

• Hand Timer
• Average Stack View
• No Ads

We are known to address problems right away so please contact us directly if you see anything wrong. We have tested and used this App to run over 100 tournaments ourselves. We know you will agree that this is the most solid poker timer on the iOS market.
