bluejetty:00177495:ios.description:
Practice Questions | Detailed Progress Tracking | Custom Study Sessions | Explanations | References
The TherapyEd Mobile App is your best streamlined mobile companion to help you pass your NPTE, PTA, and SLP PRAXIS exams. Each Study-Pack contains hundreds of comprehensive practice questions with detailed explanations integrated to the TherapyEd review & study guides. You can generate custom study sessions based on your mastery and filter by core domains, categories, and reasoning strategies. Additionally, you can track your progress and know where to improve next in real-time as you answer questions.
This app is only the beginning, and TherapyEd will be continuously adding additional questions and learning modes such as flashcards in the coming months. Take advantage of the early-bird pricing now and lock in all future content upgrades for free!
### EXAMS INCLUDED
- NPTE (600 questions)
- PTA Exam (450 questions)
- SLP PRAXIS (400 questions)
### CONTENT FEATURES
- Sharpen knowledge with hundreds of comprehensive questions
- Follows TherapyEd’s comprehensive review & study guides per exam
- Questions similar to what you’ll see on test day
- Track your progress and pinpoint where to improve
### STUDY FEATURES
- Generate custom study sessions by topic and knowledge level
- Each question comes with explanations, topic breakdown, and references
- Detailed study progress and insights across all major topic areas
- Keep track of your test day with the calendar countdown
### PREMIUM FEATURES
- Access all questions within your chosen Study-Pack
- Unlimited studying for 12 months
### COMING SOON
- Offline mode
- Flashcards
- Dynamic study schedule
### ABOUT THE APP
The TherapyEd app is powered by Memorang, an advanced AI learning platform developed by MIT engineers and physicians to make advanced learning simpler for any subject. Learn more at https://memorang.com/partners
### DISCLAIMERS
Each Study-Pack subscription contains restricted, premium content that requires an in-app purchase in order to access it for a limited period of time (e.g. 12 months). When this period expires, you will lose access as TherapyEd does not support auto-renewal. If you wish to extend your access (e.g. you moved your exam date), you can add time via additional in-app purchases, Also, please note that (as of July 2022) there is a significant overlap between the questions contained in the app and the books, but we are working to add more unique content to the app as quickly as we can.

bluejetty:00137633:ios.description:
【Story Series】
The "mime" content experienced by the players of the previous game, as well as some stories and characters hidden in the corners, are reflected in this game.
Added dialogue plot and task system.
The main task will be the main task, and a brand-new story of a brave man embarking on an adventure will be carried out.
【Character Appearance】
Players no longer view the world in first person! Players can now see the appearance of their character and the equipment they wear.
Correspondingly, while the appearance of the equipment can be worn on the body, there should also be a [transformation] system, right?
【Gameplay】
——Equipment can be matched freely, and various genres can be matched through the different skills of each piece of equipment.
——The formation threshold is low, the difficulty of obtaining equipment is extremely simple, and powerful dark gold equipment may burst out at any time.
——Optimized affix system, many affix collocations are waiting for players to swipe, and burst out the equipment that suits them.
【Core battle】
The same combat mode as the previous game, but a series of drastic modifications have been made on the basis of the previous game.
- The actions of players and monsters are now confirmed by a visible action bar. When the action bar is full, it will automatically attack normally.
——Added a new category of "general attack skills". According to different effects, this type of skill will be triggered when the general attack attacks, and it comes with many special effects.
【Super job transfer】
Modifications have been made on the basis of the previous single character single skill tree.
In the process of upgrading, players can change jobs! Every time you change jobs, you can learn more different skills!
【Original Rune Words】
On ordinary quality equipment, after a certain combination of inlaid runes is completed, this equipment can obtain a lot of rune language attributes! White equipment is not necessarily inferior to dark gold equipment.
More game systems are waiting for players to experience in the game!

bluejetty:00180772:ios.summary: Transform your kitchen with delicious air fryer recipes that save time and deliver crispy, healthy meals your whole family will love. Whether you're cooking for weeknight dinners or planning the perfect Mother's Day brunch, discover hundred
bluejetty:00180772:ios.description:
Transform your kitchen with delicious air fryer recipes that save time and deliver crispy, healthy meals your whole family will love. Whether you're cooking for weeknight dinners or planning the perfect Mother's Day brunch, discover hundreds of easy-to-follow recipes designed for your air fryer.
Key Features That Make Cooking Effortless:
Hundreds of Tested Recipes - Browse breakfast favorites, satisfying lunches, hearty dinners, and irresistible desserts. Each recipe includes precise temperature settings, cooking times, and ingredient lists for guaranteed success.
Healthy Eating Made Easy - Cut up to 75% of the oil while keeping all the flavor and crispiness you crave. Perfect for keto, vegan, vegetarian, low-carb, and family-friendly meal plans.
Smart Meal Planning - Weekly meal plans take the guesswork out of grocery shopping and dinner prep. Plan ahead or find quick 20-minute meals when you're short on time.
Step-by-Step Instructions - Clear, detailed directions guide you through every recipe. Never wonder about timing, temperature, or technique again.
Personalized Collections - Save your favorite recipes, create custom cookbooks, and build your go-to meal rotation. Mark recipes you want to try and track what your family loves most.
Dietary Filters - Quickly find recipes that match your nutritional needs. Filter by keto, paleo, gluten-free, dairy-free, vegan, vegetarian, and more.
Shopping Lists - Automatically generate grocery lists from your selected recipes. Add, edit, and check off items as you shop for ultimate convenience.
Nutritional Information - Make informed choices with complete nutrition facts for every recipe, including calories, protein, carbs, and fat content.
Cooking Timer Integration - Built-in timers sync with each recipe step, sending notifications so you never overcook or undercook your meals.
Photo Guides - Visual step-by-step photos help you master new techniques and know exactly what your dish should look like at each stage.
Perfect for Every Home Cook:
Whether you're new to air frying or a seasoned pro, our recipes cater to all skill levels. Busy parents find quick family dinners. Health-conscious individuals discover nutritious alternatives to fried favorites. Anyone looking to simplify cooking while eating better will find exactly what they need.
From crispy bacon and tender salmon to roasted Brussels sprouts and chocolate lava cakes, explore the full potential of your air fryer. Learn time-saving techniques, master temperature control, and discover ingredient combinations that deliver restaurant-quality results at home.
What Makes Us Different:
Every recipe in our collection is specifically developed for air fryer cooking—not adapted from conventional oven methods. This means accurate timing, proper temperatures, and techniques that account for air fryer circulation patterns. You get consistently excellent results because our recipes are designed for how air fryers actually work.
Start Your Healthy Cooking Journey:
Download now and discover how easy it is to prepare delicious, nutritious meals that satisfy your cravings without the guilt. Whether you're cooking for one, feeding a family, or hosting Mother's Day brunch, you'll find inspiration for every occasion.
Make every meal memorable with recipes that are simple to follow, healthy to eat, and impossible to resist. Your air fryer is about to become your favorite kitchen tool.

bluejetty:00141894:ios.summary: Stay creative and connected from anywhere with the LANDR Mobile App, built for music and content creators. Collaborate, master, distribute, and share your music seamlessly—even when you're away from your DAW. Release your tracks to 150+ str
bluejetty:00141894:ios.description:
Stay creative and connected from anywhere with the LANDR Mobile App, built for music and content creators. Collaborate, master, distribute, and share your music seamlessly—even when you're away from your DAW. Release your tracks to 150+ streaming platforms like Spotify, and monitor their performance with real-time streaming metrics. Access powerful messaging and creative tools directly from your mobile device.
MASTER
Upload a song or beat and get polished, studio-quality audio mastering. Get release-ready, shareable audio with the music industry’s best AI mastering service, trusted by top audio engineers and major labels.
RELEASE
Distribute your music to over 150 streaming services and digital stores including Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon, YouTube Music, TikTok, Instagram and more. Release unlimited music and keep 100% of your royalties.
TRACK PERFORMANCE
Stay on top of your LANDR Distribution releases with in-depth analytics for a real-time snapshot of your streaming performance, including royalty earnings.
ENHANCE & CREATE
Harness the power of LANDR Stems, our AI-driven stem splitter tool powered by Audioshake. Separate tracks into individual stems, including vocals, drums, and bass, or create distinct instrumentals with precision. LANDR Stems can be used as a vocal remover or to isolate vocals. Our stem separator helps you refine your music to the exact parts you need, directly within the app.
MESSAGE
Collaborate with messaging made for music makers. Share secure audio and video messages securely and collaborate with the ability to leave timestamped text comments directly on your tracks.
PLAY
Hear your mix or master outside of the studio. Play songs from your LANDR library on any Bluetooth or AirPlay-enabled device. 
SHARE
Share a new song, creative project, or studio master with contacts to quickly get in-depth feedback. Make the music you share private or define viewing and downloading privileges. Share Promolinks to promote your releases on social media and make it easy for fans to discover your music.
TOP LANDR MOBILE APP FEATURES FOR MUSIC CREATORS:
- Free cloud storage for your music
- Master songs or albums instantly for a professional sound
- Remove or isolate vocals, drums, bass or instrumentals from any track
- Music distribution to 150+ streaming platforms
- Real-time streaming data for released tracks
- Timestamped track comments for precise feedback
- High-resolution DAW audio for video chats
- Bluetooth & AirPlay compatibility
- Tablet compatibility
Message collaborators, master audio, listen, and share music from anywhere with LANDR. Take every song and studio project with you everywhere with the app made specifically for music and content creators.
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00139900:ios.description:
Get awesome iOS theme icon packs from independent artists!
No more Shortcuts! 
Download now and enjoy aesthetic icons, animate widgets and live wallpapers with One-Click!
1st iOS Theme Platform that connects artists and users.
Key features:
■ No more shortcuts! 
Tired of creating icons one by one through shortcuts? 
Handy helps you link and install icons with One-Click. Most of the themes are pre-linked by the artists and no more linking required.
■ Manage themes all in one place!
Want to organize all your themes?
Handy have you covered. All themes you own will be stored in your folder with previews. Changing themes never become this easy. 
■ Be creative!
Try to create your own theme?
Handy provides a tool to help you organize your icons, widgets and wallpapers. You can generate Live Wallpapers from videos or any of your Live Photos. 
■ Easy sharing!

Handy can generate a share link for your theme or your portfolio. All your friends can see your amazing designs from the link. 
■ Make money!
Creativity should be valued!
Handy helps you sell your themes all over the world. Set your own price and get paid with your local currency.
Make your phone feels like yours!

You will get a special access to the handy server that helps you install and manage icons with native experience.
For widget offers steps tracking, we need your permission to use HealthKit and access your health data. It is only needed for those widgets and will ask the permission only when you installing those widgets.

bluejetty:00021442:ios.description:
Instant access to the latest evidence-based guidance for healthcare professionals.
Updated daily, BMJ Best Practice provides healthcare professionals with the latest evidence-based clinical decision support information. It's available offline, which means clinical decision support can be accessed anytime, anywhere.
This app can be downloaded by those who have access to the BMJ Best Practice website, and have already set-up a username and password.
Don’t have a subscription? Download the app and access a free 7 day trial.
The app provides:
- Fast access to the latest guidance on diagnosis, prognosis, treatment and prevention
- 500+ patient leaflets
- 250+ medical calculators
- Guidance videos on common clinical procedures
- Automatic CME/CPD activity tracking
Your feedback helps to inform future developments. 
At BMJ, we have a user-centered product development process, which means that we enhance the product based on what our customers, and our users tell us they need and want. As a result, we have introduced features such as ‘night mode’ and patient leaflets to the app.
If you have a question or want to provide feedback, please contact us at support@bmj.com. Thank you!

Stream directly from your phone with professional tools, including landscape and vertical layouts, facecam, overlays, and real-time intera
bluejetty:00022704:ios.description:
Live Now is a mobile-first live streaming app built for mobile game streaming and live sports events.
Stream directly from your phone with professional tools, including landscape and vertical layouts, facecam, overlays, and real-time interaction. Live Now also supports sports live streaming with dynamic scoreboards and instant replay, all without a desktop setup.
Top Features
• Mobile Game Streaming
- Vertical & Landscape Layouts – Stream mobile games in landscape for standard gameplay, with optional vertical layouts optimized for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Reels.
- Facecam & Floating Chat – Show your reactions and interact with viewers in real time while streaming.
- Privacy Protection – Shield mode prevents accidental exposure of passwords or sensitive information during gameplay.
• Sports Live Streaming
- Instant Replay & Scoreboards (Sports Only) – Replay key moments such as goals, fouls, and highlight plays during live sports streams. Customize real-time scoreboards for football, basketball, hockey, baseball, tennis, billiards, and snooker.
- Professional Overlays – Add match overlays and live information to deliver a broadcast-style sports streaming experience.
• Multistreaming & Platform Support
- Simulcast Live – Stream simultaneously to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, TikTok, Twitter, LinkedIn, and any RTMP server.
- Platform Integration – Schedule, create, and manage live streams for YouTube, Facebook, and Twitch directly from your phone.
• Recording & Creator Tools
- Screen Recording & High-Quality Capture – Record gameplay, tutorials, or app demos up to 1080p, 60 FPS, and 12 Mbps.
- Music & Sound Effects – Enhance streams with background music or live sound effects.
- Logos & Frames – Brand your stream with custom logos, watermarks, and frames.
- Camera Stabilizer & Shield Mode – Keep streams smooth and secure.
- Wireless Transfer & World Time Overlay – Transfer recordings via Wi-Fi and display multiple time zones during live streams.
- Works with Accsoon SeeMo: Connect your DSLR camera directly to your phone for live video input.
Live Now helps creators stream mobile games professionally and cover sports events with broadcast-style features — all from a single mobile device.
• Disclaimer for Live Now app:
* All recording activities must comply with the Terms of Service of the content-providing platforms.
* If you intend to record any content for any purpose other than personal use, please obtain PERMISSION from the content owner first.
* We cannot be held responsible for any infringement of intellectual property rights resulting from unauthorized recording.
• Terms of Subscription:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Setting after purchase. As soon as you purchase your subscription, any unused portion or period of the free trial period will be forfeited.
◆ Privacy Policy: https://livenow.one/privacy-policy/
◆ Terms of Use: https://livenow.one/terms-of-use/
If you have any feedback, please feel free to contact us at support@nabiapp.com

bluejetty:00183917:ios.description:
We are excited to introduce a web version to LDS tithing report. We wanted to make it more convenient for those that don’t want to use just their mobile device. You can add your income and donations on the web from anywhere and it will automatically sync across all devices. With increased font size and ease of use from your desktop or laptop, it will add more flexibility to keep things organized. 
Here is the link for the new web dashboard https://portal.ldstithingreport.com
We hope you enjoy this new feature with all the current features still available. We look forward to you input for future upgrades.
The all New LDS tithing report is here and better than ever. We now have an all New Web Version to add to your convenience. This app makes it easy to keep track of your tithing and donations for single users and family’s. The New login is now available to all users to ensure data is always secure and available across multiple devices and users now. This new version of LDS Tithing Report is better and more reliable than before. We still have the same great features of the Basic package and Premium package with a few fun extras. 
Great for single users - 
Basic Plan Features - 2 weeks free then $3.99 a year
- Login - Use same account and data across multiple devices & users
- Record income
- Option to auto record Income - Weekly, Bimonthly and Monthly
- Track donations
- Link to pay donations online
- Customize your income, users, reminders and categories
- 4 users’ max
- Be reminded to pay tithing
- Export features for taxes and your personal records
- Option to add own currency - Top 10 currency’s
- All New Web Version
And now we have our new and improved plan….
Perfect for family’s and couples.
Premium Plan (includes Basic Plan & features below) Features - 2 weeks free then $1.49 a month
- Unlimited Users
- Unlimited Categories
- Users will have a color option to distinguish their own info 
- Each User will see their income and donations on report page
- Filters available on income and donation (sort by user, date and more)
- Option to add own currency - Top 20 currency's
- Widgets 
- All New Web Version
Whatever plan you choose you are on the right path to keep track of your tithing and donations. We offer options to keep track with reoccurring features, which allows you to add your income once and set it too automatic. And that’s just the beginning. This app reminds you when to pay tithing, choose different users and their income and donations, choose your currency, login so you always have your income and donation data with you. The features go on and on. Try it out for free for 2 weeks (Basic plan and Premium Plan).
Try it today. You'll love it.
**LDS Tithing Report does NOT pay your tithing for you. We do however provide a link, in the donation box, to the LDS church’s website so you can pay your tithing securely. We do NOT ask for personal information or banking details. This app only helps members of the church keep track of their income, donations, reminders, and much more. You pay your tithing online on the LDS church’s secure website.
In order to use the app please subscribe for LDS Tithing Report one year Subscription or new monthly subscription. 
Subscription price for basic plan is $3.99 per 12 months. which will be auto renewing within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. In order to stop the services turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Subscription price for premium plan is $1.49 per month. which will be auto renewing within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. In order to stop the services turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
By paying the subscription you are agreeing to Terms of use.
Terms of use https://www.ldstithingreport.com/terms-of-use

### Welcome to **Fort Defenders**! 
In this epic defense battle, you are the last line of defense, protecting your home and keeping your fortress safe! In this medieval world, enemies are relentless, and your task is to use every resource to build the strongest defense and stop endless waves of attackers.
### Game Features:
** Build Powerful Defenses**
Construct defense towers, ironclad walls, laser turrets, catapults, and more to create an impenetrable stronghold.
** Synthesize Elite Soldiers**
Synthesize and upgrade archers, cavalry, mages, and other units to form the ultimate army to fend off invaders.

The enemy is closing in, and your only hope is to rely on your defenses and elite troops to hold the final line. Every battle tests your strategy and decision-making skills.
** Strategic Decisions Matter**
Every fight is a strategic challenge. Deciding which soldiers to synthesize and what defensive structures to build could be the key to your survival.
** Enemies Grow Stronger**
As you progress, enemies become more powerful. New enemy types and attack strategies will challenge your defensive tactics, requiring you to constantly upgrade and adapt.
---
### Ideal for Players Who:
- Enjoy strategic defense games
- Love tower defense and unit synthesis gameplay
- Are passionate about medieval themes and extreme defense challenges
- Want to test their decision-making skills in intense battles!

bluejetty:00040063:ios.name: Back2Back: 2 Player Co-op Game
bluejetty:00040063:ios.summary: Discover Back 2 Back, the ultimate cooperative game for two players! Perfect for those who loved games for couples like It Takes Two, Split Fiction and Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, Back2Back offers you an unforgettable duo gaming exper
bluejetty:00040063:ios.description:
Discover Back 2 Back, the ultimate cooperative game for two players! Perfect for those who loved games for couples like It Takes Two, Split Fiction and Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, Back2Back offers you an unforgettable duo gaming experience.
A game exclusively for two players
Back 2 Back is a mobile game that is played exclusively by two players, each on their own phone! This racing game will test your cooperation and reflexes. As a duo, you will have to navigate through complex and perilous situations if you want to go as far as possible. Of all the couple games like It Takes Two, Back 2 Back is the best to test your synchronization. Only the most skilled among you can claim victory!
Drive, shoot, survive!
Welcome to the ultimate experience in couple games, where your partnership is the key to success. In this thrilling adventure, you and your partner must work as a team to navigate through challenges. One player takes the wheel, mastering the art of speed and agility, while the other provides cover, shooting down enemies to clear the path. This isn't just any game; it's one of those couples games that brings you closer, testing your communication and coordination. Swap roles, share the thrill, and experience the joy of victory together. Perfect for couples looking to bond and enjoy quality time, this game is your go-to for fun and connection!
Switch roles to go further
In the Back2Back video game, you will need to use a unique mechanic to get out of the most tense situations: the Switch! Indeed, some robots can only be destroyed by one of the two players. Become the shooter instead of the driver, and vice versa! Switch roles to maximize your chances of survival in this ruthless, robot-infested universe. In this racing game, boredom is impossible! Your reflexes will be put to the test, and you will have to switch from the trigger to the wheel in no time.
Communication, trust & complicity!
Back2Back is the perfect game to play as a couple or with a friend and test your synergy and complicity! Without communication, there is no redemption. To escape the various enemies, you will need to communicate to go as far as possible. Discover or rediscover your partner's talents and experience a unique sharing experience. Strengthen your bonds and your relationship by pushing your limits to infinity! Only the best duos can hope to succeed in this two-player racing game.
Easy to handle and a gameplay with multiple challenges
Whether you are an expert or a novice in shooting games or racing games, it doesn't matter! Back 2 Back offers you a tailored experience. Indeed, the difficulty increases as you progress in this two-player game, with more obstacles and enemies to face! This car game is very easy to handle and uses gyroscope controls for an immersive and dynamic adventure. But the most skillful players among you will not be left out! Try to go as far as possible to achieve the highest scores and become a master in the art of taking down killer robots!
A constantly evolving mobile game

listings.description:
Discover Back 2 Back, the ultimate cooperative game for two players! Perfect for those who loved games for couples like It Takes Two, Split Fiction and Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, Back2Back offers you an unforgettable duo gaming experience.

A game exclusively for two players
Back 2 Back is a mobile game that is played exclusively by two players, each on their own phone! This racing game will test your cooperation and reflexes. As a duo, you will have to navigate through complex and perilous situations if you want to go as far as possible. Of all the couple games like It Takes Two, Back 2 Back is the best to test your synchronization. Only the most skilled among you can claim victory!

Drive, shoot, survive!
Welcome to the ultimate experience in couple games, where your partnership is the key to success. In this thrilling adventure, you and your partner must work as a team to navigate through challenges. One player takes the wheel, mastering the art of speed and agility, while the other provides cover, shooting down enemies to clear the path. This isn't just any game; it's one of those couples games that brings you closer, testing your communication and coordination. Swap roles, share the thrill, and experience the joy of victory together. Perfect for couples looking to bond and enjoy quality time, this game is your go-to for fun and connection!

Switch roles to go further
In the Back2Back video game, you will need to use a unique mechanic to get out of the most tense situations: the Switch! Indeed, some robots can only be destroyed by one of the two players. Become the shooter instead of the driver, and vice versa! Switch roles to maximize your chances of survival in this ruthless, robot-infested universe. In this racing game, boredom is impossible! Your reflexes will be put to the test, and you will have to switch from the trigger to the wheel in no time.

Communication, trust & complicity!
Back2Back is the perfect game to play as a couple or with a friend and test your synergy and complicity! Without communication, there is no redemption. To escape the various enemies, you will need to communicate to go as far as possible. Discover or rediscover your partner's talents and experience a unique sharing experience. Strengthen your bonds and your relationship by pushing your limits to infinity! Only the best duos can hope to succeed in this two-player racing game.

Easy to handle and a gameplay with multiple challenges
Whether you are an expert or a novice in shooting games or racing games, it doesn't matter! Back 2 Back offers you a tailored experience. Indeed, the difficulty increases as you progress in this two-player game, with more obstacles and enemies to face! This car game is very easy to handle and uses gyroscope controls for an immersive and dynamic adventure. But the most skillful players among you will not be left out! Try to go as far as possible to achieve the highest scores and become a master in the art of taking down killer robots!
 
A constantly evolving mobile game
Back2Back is one of the two-player games that will revolutionize your moments of sharing as a couple or with a friend. Many new features are already in preparation in our studio to offer you an unforgettable duo gaming experience! Your feedback is welcome! Get the latest IELTS Exam test questions and get your desired IELTS band at the exam.
#2. Accurate AI Scoring Engine
IELTS Success App reproduces the British Council official IELTS score guide to make sure you get accurate and reliable mock test results. 
Get insights on your IELTS Speaking skills such as content, pronunciation, oral fluency as well as grammar, spelling mistakes and vocabulary for your IELTS writing exercises.
#3. Extra IELTS General Material
Become a real IELTS master with all our IELTS prep app, tools and tutorials. Be ready for exam after reading all tips and tricks from our experts on our blog. We enable IELTS test takers to master all IELTS exam techniques of all question types. Prepare and practice English with clear guidelines and suggestions.
Key Highlights:
• Practice the latest exam prediction questions.
• IELTS General and Academic Writing tasks.
• AI machine grading for accurate test results.
• Sectional scored mock test to assess your communicative skills.
• Audio recordings to practice your IELTS listening.
• Instant Ai speech and IELTS essays analysis!
• Ability to record your speech to dramatically increase your speaking practice score.
• Get instant feedback and an estimated score for your IELTS Speaking practice.
• Study exam memories and latest repeated questions
• Real interactive exercises to get familiar with the real exam.
• Get instant results after each IELTS Reading exam question.
• Suitable for both IELTS Academic and General training exam tests.
• Detailed dashboard to identify your strengths and weaknesses.
• Dark mode to study at night!
• Quick study with thousands of students from Australia, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, India, China or Nigeria!
Why choose IELTS Success? 
• We make IELTS preparation lessons and English learning easy.
• We help you pass the exam quick and score a perfect band 9!
• We help every IELTS test taker to shorten their IELTS study.
• We give you the tools to get a Band 8 and get 20 points for Australian Permanent Residency (PR).
• We offer quick study for your IELTS prep.
• We assist you to score a band 7 and go to uni.

The IELTS Success Team

bluejetty:00141469:ios.name: Charades for Kids & Family
bluejetty:00141469:ios.summary:
The Perfect Charades Game for Kids and Families!
Charades and forehead charades have always been among the best games for laughter, creativity, and connection. They’re fun, lively, and get everyone moving and acting! Especially for young c
bluejetty:00141469:ios.description:
The Perfect Charades Game for Kids and Families!
Charades and forehead charades have always been among the best games for laughter, creativity, and connection. They’re fun, lively, and get everyone moving and acting! Especially for young children, charades are a wonderful way to build confidence, develop social skills, and encourage self-expression in an engaging, interactive way. Kids love the chance to be silly, make others guess, and cheer for friends and family—charades are perfect for playtime that’s full of joy.
A Family-Friendly Game for All Ages!
This app is designed to bring families and friends together, whether it’s kids playing with other kids, kids teaming up with parents, or kids sharing a laugh with teachers, caregivers, and older family members. “Charades for Kids & Family” has simple, kid-friendly gameplay and visual cues so everyone can jump right into the action.
Two Exciting Game Modes: Classic Charades and Forehead Charades
We’ve included two favorite ways to play:
1. Classic Acting Charades – “Act & Guess” Mode
This version lets kids act out charades in classic style, showing off their acting skills! Classic charades include:
- Simple, Kid-Friendly Words: Every word is carefully chosen to be clear and age-appropriate.
- Word Choice Option: For younger players, the easiest decks allow kids to select a word they know so they feel comfortable acting it out.
- Built-In Timer: Adds the thrill of beating the clock, encouraging quick thinking and acting.
- Helpful Pictures and Videos: Younger kids who can’t read can use pictures, and there are over 200 help videos to show the word’s meaning, so kids can feel confident acting it out.
- Fun Decks to Choose From: Includes themes like Animals, Foods, Indoors, Outdoors, Sports and Activities, and many more.
2. Forehead Charades – “Hold & Guess” Mode
This mode brings the excitement of the classic “hold-it-on-your-forehead” style play, perfect for guessing while others act it out. Features include:
- Kid-Friendly Words and Pictures: Words are easy and understandable for all ages, with pictures for younger players.
- Motion-Driven Play: Players can tilt the device upwards to pass or downwards to mark as correct, adding physical interaction to the fun!
- Fallback Button Options: If kids prefer to skip or pass with a tap instead of tilting, they have button options to keep gameplay comfortable.
- Adjustable Timer: Set the timer to match players’ skill levels or add more time for extra laughs.
- Fun Decks for Every Interest: Choose from themes like Animals, Foods, Indoors, Outdoors, and more to keep each round fresh.
Over 500 Photos and 200+ Help Videos!
“Charades for Kids & Family” is packed with content, including over 500 images to help younger kids guess along, and more than 200 video clips demonstrating charade words, so kids have every bit of help they need to understand and act out the words.
This app is designed to make charades fun, accessible, and perfect for every family gathering or playtime session with friends. Get ready for endless fun, laughter, and togetherness with Charades for Kids & Family!
Privacy Policy: https://www.kidscharades.com/privacy_ios.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00023135:ios.description:
Superimpose AI: Your AI-Powered Photo & Video Editing Companion
Take your photo and video editing further with Superimpose AI, a versatile tool for professionals and hobbyists alike. It combines creative tools with AI to help you transform your images and videos.
Core Features:
● Effortless Background Management: Remove and replace backgrounds instantly with AI accuracy.
● AI-Enhanced Creativity: Generate realistic artwork with AI text-to-image tools.
● Advanced Editing Toolkit: Layers, masking, cloning and more, all at your fingertips.
● AI UnCrop & One-Tap Changes: Expand images and change backgrounds effortlessly.
Built-In Video Editor:
● Zoomable Multi-Layer Timeline: Arrange and trim video, image, text, sticker and audio layers with precision, with snapping to keep everything aligned.
● Keyframe Animation: Animate any layer with keyframes and easing curves for smooth, professional motion.
● Speed Control: Speed up or slow down clips, or create dramatic speed ramps.
● Adjustment Layers: Apply effects and color adjustments across multiple layers at once.
● Audio & Voiceover: Add music from your device, browse royalty-free tracks, or record your own voiceover.
● Stickers & GIFs: Search and add animated stickers and GIFs to your videos.
● Stock Video Library: Access royalty-free stock video clips from Pexels and Pixabay.
● Flexible Aspect Ratios: Create for any platform, from Stories and Reels to widescreen.
● High-Quality Export: Export your creations as videos or images with customizable options.
Artistic Freedom:
● Multiple layers and blending modes for complex compositions.
● Comprehensive masking tools for precise editing.
● Animate, add effects and turn your photos into videos, all within one app.
Efficient & User-Friendly:
● Non-destructive editing so every change can be undone.
● Organize projects easily, with full undo/redo history.
● Access over a million royalty-free stock photos and videos.
Discover the joy of artistic expression with Superimpose AI, where your imagination meets our technology.
Terms of use: http://superimposeapp.com/terms-of-use.html
Privacy policy: http://superimposeapp.com/privacy2.html

bluejetty:00146850:ios.description:
Get the best riding experience in Ontario with Ride OFTR, exclusive app for exploring and navigating trails across Ontario.
This isn’t just any trail riding app — as the official app of the Ontario Federation of Trail Riders, Ride OFTR provides you with the most up-to-date trail information out there. Nothing else updates you faster or more accurately.
Plus, with Ride OFTR as your trail companion, you help build a stronger community of off-road motorcycle riders, clubs, and volunteers across Ontario — giving you even more reasons to enjoy the ride.
Take Ride OFTR for a spin, with all standard features — free to download and use.
Unlock all features for less than your average coffee.
TOP FEATURES
Works offline or online: Access OFTR’s official trail maps, track your position and distances, spot POIs, and find nearby services like food, accommodation, and gas — even in remote areas.
Receive trail updates with the most up-to-date trail status and conditions available anywhere.
Personalize your ride: Plan itineraries, save favourite trails, record your journey, and share with friends.
Stay connected securely: Share your location only with riders you select, and get notified about club events, exclusive offers, and trail riding community initiatives.
Manage multiple motorcycles: Log different vehicles, keep notes, and track distances covered for each.
GOOD TO KNOW 
• Using your smartphone’s GPS and location sharing continuously may drain your battery faster. PRO TIP: Maximize battery life by disabling these features when not needed.

Key Features:
--Intelligent Script Generati
bluejetty:00136113:ios.description:
Unleash the power of cutting-edge artificial intelligence with our AI Script Writer & Generator app! Elevate your creative process and effortlessly craft compelling scripts for your projects.
Key Features:
--Intelligent Script Generation:
 Let our advanced AI script generator spark your creativity. From brainstorming ideas to crafting dialogue, experience a seamless script-writing journey.
--Script Writer's Hub:
 Dive into a world of limitless possibilities with our Script Writer's Hub. Access a vast library of prompts, genres, and templates for your scripts.
-- Personalized Script Maker:
 Tailor your scripts to perfection. Our AI adapts to your style, offering personalized suggestions to enhance your unique voice and storytelling approach.
-- Script AI Assistance:
 Need inspiration or stuck on a scene? Our Script AI is your creative companion, providing real-time assistance and generating ideas to break through writer's block.
-- Versatile Script Generator:
 Whether you're writing for film, theater, or YouTube, our versatile script generator adapts to various formats and genres. Explore and experiment with ease.
-- Movie Script Writing:
 - Movie script writing involves crafting a screenplay for a full-length feature film. It includes scene descriptions, dialogue, and stage directions, providing a comprehensive guide for filmmakers to bring the story to life on the big screen.
-- YouTube Video Script Writing:
 - Crafting a script for YouTube videos involves planning engaging and informative content. It includes an introduction, main content, and a conclusion, ensuring the delivery of a clear and compelling message to the audience.
-- Short Film Script Writing:**
 - Short film script writing is a condensed form of storytelling, typically ranging from a few minutes to around 30 minutes. It requires concise and impactful writing to convey a complete narrative within a limited time frame.
-- TikTok Script Writing:
 - Creating content for TikTok involves scripting short, attention-grabbing videos. 
-- Reels Script Writing:
 - Similar to TikTok, creating content for Instagram Reels involves concise scripting for short videos. Reels script writing emphasizes creativity and a quick hook to engage viewers in a short span, making it suitable for Instagram's platform.
-- Screenplay Script:
 - A screenplay script serves as the blueprint for a visual story, whether it's for a movie, TV show, or web series. It includes details like dialogue, actions, and scene descriptions, guiding directors, actors, and the production team in bringing the narrative to the screen.
Why Choose AI Script Writer & Generator?
--Efficiency & Speed:** Boost your productivity with AI-driven script creation, saving time and effort.
--Innovative Ideas: Access a treasure trove of innovative ideas and plot twists to keep your scripts engaging and fresh.

bluejetty:00030183:ios.description:

Fit-Stitch pairs weight tracking with progress photos so you can see the full picture, not just a number.
What it does:
- Track your weight and take progress photos over time
- Tag your snapshots and photos to organize your progress
- Create side-by-side comparisons to spot changes you'd otherwise miss
- Sync across your devices with iCloud — your data goes to your own private account, never ours
- Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID for extra privacy
- Set reminders so you remember to track consistently
Your data stays yours.
Your photos and data live on your device. No accounts, no ads, no data collection. If you turn on iCloud sync, it goes to your own private iCloud — we never see it.

bluejetty:00098823:ios.name: Tile Quest - Triple Match Game
bluejetty:00098823:ios.summary:
Looking for a tile-matching puzzle that's easy to pick up and fun to explore? Welcome to Tile Quest - Triple Match, a casual puzzle game that combines colorful tiles, satisfying matches, and a relaxing atmosphere.
Tap three identical tiles
bluejetty:00098823:ios.description:
Looking for a tile-matching puzzle that's easy to pick up and fun to explore? Welcome to Tile Quest - Triple Match, a casual puzzle game that combines colorful tiles, satisfying matches, and a relaxing atmosphere.
Tap three identical tiles to clear them and work your way through the board. Each level offers a different arrangement, with challenges that grow as you progress. Simple rules and intuitive controls make it easy to get started and enjoy a little puzzle-solving time.
FEATURES THAT MAKE EVERY MATCH FUN
EASY TO LEARN
Simply tap three matching tiles to clear them from the board. Intuitive controls make it easy to jump in and start playing.
A VARIETY OF LEVELS
Explore a wide range of tile arrangements and puzzles. Discover new challenges as you progress, from straightforward matches to layouts that take a little more planning.
CHARMING TILE DESIGNS
Enjoy colorful tile sets featuring delicious fruits, sweet treats, adorable animals, and more. Discover different designs as you make your way through the game.
RELAXING VISUAL THEMES
Explore beautifully designed backgrounds inspired by destinations around the world. Enjoy a change of scenery as you progress, with inviting visuals that bring a little getaway to your puzzle time.
HELPFUL BOOSTERS
Need a hand with a tricky puzzle? Use shuffle, undo, or hint to help you find your next move and keep playing.
Whether you have five minutes or a little longer, Tile Quest - Triple Match offers a relaxing way to enjoy a puzzle break. Play offline and take your time exploring each board.
Download Tile Quest - Triple Match and unwind, one match at a time.

bluejetty:00031648:ios.description:
Get hooked on at-home workouts with Charlee Atkins and Le Sweat TV. Enjoy our easy-to-follow, smart, and effective workout classes designed to help you get in the best shape of your life, all from the comfort of your own home.
Select workout videos by modality or participate in one of the Le Sweat challenges. Videos are sorted by body part (abs, booty, arms) and range from 5 to 45 minutes. Le Sweat challenges can help jumpstart your fitness routine, prepare you for an upcoming event, help destress, or motivate you for your favorite season.
See why PopSugar, Women's Health, Men's Health, Cosmopolitan, Well + Good, and many others have featured Le Sweat workouts and Charlee Atkins as their go-to trainer. Join today for 7 days of unlimited classes for FREE!
Type of workouts offered:
- HIIT
- Cardio
- Strength
- Mobility/Stretch
- Yoga for Athletes
- No-Jumping and Low-Impact
- Beginner-Friendly
- Step Cardio
- Pregnancy-Safe Workouts
- Plus more!
Inside the app, you'll also find videos organized by equipment. From bands to dumbbells to bodyweight only, Le Sweat has you covered with every type of workout that will leave you feeling healthy and accomplished.
IN-APP FEATURES
- Stream videos from anywhere in the world
- Download classes for offline viewing
- Create playlists featuring your favorite workouts
- Track and schedule your workouts using our in-app calendar
- Looking for inspo? Follow our weekly guide with recommended classes
- Engage with the global Le Sweat community right in the app! Ask questions, give feedback, leave comments, or even find a friend to sweat with.
Are you ready to Le Sweat? Yes or yes? Take control of your fitness and download Le Sweat TV today!
To access all features and content, you can subscribe to Le Sweat TV monthly, quarterly, or yearly with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In-app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
*All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
For more information see our:
-Terms of Service: https://le-sweat.com/tou/
-Privacy Policy: https://le-sweat.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00099789:ios.description:
Card Match Start Solitaire Journey Now!
Tripeaks Solitaire - Pyramid Solitaire – a fresh twist on the classic solitaire puzzle!
Relax or challenge yourself with hundreds of fun card levels, wild cards, and daily rewards.
Play offline anytime, spin the wheel, and unlock treasures in this addictive card adventure!
 How to Play
- You will be surprised to know that playing Tripeaks Solitaire is very simple yet addictive:
- It starts with a set of cards that are arranged in a three-peak formation.
- Collect playing cards which are in a pyramid shape in either ascending or descending order to clear the board. For example, you can play a three/3 after a 4 or 2.
- You can also use a wild card when you’re stuck and wish to keep your streak going on!
- Unlock exciting treasures to explore new areas and progress through stunning levels filled with puzzles.
- The goal is to clear all the cards and achieve the highest score while enjoying a relaxing journey.
- Check your journey with our amazing leaderboard.
- It’s very easy to learn, but it gives you endless opportunities to test your strategy and patience.
 What’s New
- Excited card animations for smoother gameplay with different twists
- Enhanced graphics with brighter colors and new card styles
- Added exciting daily challenges and rewards with bonus coins
- New background themes for a more personalized experience
- play with a seamless harvest journey
Want to check your luck? Spin the wheel and grab exciting rewards!
In our Solitaire Tripeaks Card Match, get 1 free spin every day to try out your luck and win coins, rewards, and more surprises that make your gaming journey more thrilling and relaxing. For the first time in history, you will experience relaxation and thrill at the same time! It will add an extra layer of fun and give you daily opportunities to collect unbelievable treasures that keep the excitement going beyond just the casual cards games.
You can experience our Tri peaks solitaire Associations card puzzle game anytime, anywhere as it has “no wifi games” feature and also you can play it as an offline game.
 Features
- Turned Classic Solitaire with a Twist – As a refreshing take on the beloved Tri Peaks Solitaire card games.
- A Fun Card Match Gameplay – Playing cards game in ascending or descending order to master every card match.
- Relax and Relieve Stress – With our simple rules and calming visuals, it's the perfect relaxing game.
- Challenging Levels – Enjoy hundreds of puzzles that test your focus and card strategy.
- Wild Cards & Boosters – Use power-ups to beat tricky stages and collect coins to keep the fun going.
- Rewards & Surprises – Spin wheels, collect coins, and unlock treasures as you progress.
- Beautiful Areas to Build as per your choice – Build and unlock new zones, from typical islands to luxury rooms.
- Offline Games No Wifi.
Solitaire Tripeak is more than just a casual card match game. It can be your personal escape into a world of puzzles, rewards, and endless fun. Whether you have a few minutes to spare or want to immerse yourself for hours, this stress-free game promises extreme relaxation, excitement, and an unending rewarding challenge. You can become a master of the pyramid 3 challenge by matching three perfect moves simultaneously for ultimate victory.
Ready to take on the tri peaks tiki game challenge?
Download Tripeak Solitarity today and start your card-matching journey now!

• SUPERSETS & MULTISETS
• ACCESS TO All PAID built-in training plans
• Stylish palette of colors to style your programs. Aesthetics in everything!
Thanks for choosing GymJoy!

bluejetty:00179121:ios.description:
Spooky Wars is an epic game mixing tower defense (TD) and strategy mechanics with action elements.
Your objective is to lead your army of spooky legends to victory. You build a deck, assemble your troops and build your castle to crush your enemies. Save your troops! Save your castle! Save the Kingdom!
A fast pacing strategy game where you have to think fast! Choose your strategy and clash with your enemies in this exciting war game. Designed for tower defense lovers, but enhanced with a lot of strategy, Spooky Wars is the card battle game you have been looking for.
Collect and upgrade more than 50 cards to strengthen your army and fortify your castle. Join forces with spooky legends like Frankenstein, Dracula, Werewolf and many more. Arm your castle with powerful weapons from Bombards and Crossbows up to mighty Lasers and Teslas.
Enter the arena and clash with your opponents in epic battles for glory and victory. Build the strongest deck and crush your enemies. On the battlefield, what matters is strategy and action.
The enemy is racing to your castle. Don't let them destroy your kingdom!
Features
- Collect more than 50 cards to upgrade your spooky troops and castle
- Play in 6 different battlegrounds
- Play Quests in 3 different game modes
- Play with your friends and compete in local and global leaderboards.
- Clash with your enemies and become the best player in the world
- Gather your army and fight for glory
- Command and control your units in battle
- Addicting strategy and action gameplay
- PvP (Player vs Player combats) coming soon with online multiplayer (Real Time, not turn by turn)
- Free game: play on your phone and tablet
- Strategy duelling game
Ready to start? Play this epic card game now for free!

bluejetty:00121440:ios.description:
At City Experiences, our promise to you is memories that last a lifetime and feelings that bring a smile to your face for years to come. We cherish every new person who joins us on one of our yachts, and are thrilled to welcome back customers who return year after year. Come onboard with us and enjoy the wind in your hair, the salty, fresh smell of the ocean all around you, and stunning coastal views. 
Our mobile application allows you to easily search our events across the country, purchase a ticket, download your tickets to get scanned at the yachts, and get live chat support for common questions about our amazing experiences. 
BOOK EXPERIENCES
Go on local experiences in one of our multitude of cities, whether it's for multiple days or just a morning brunch. Explore the Statue of Liberty, Niagara Falls, Alcatraz, or any of our incredible cruises. 
DOWNLOAD YOUR TICKETS 
Simply enter the confirmation number into our app in order to store your tickets. When entering your confirmation number we send you push notifications as it gets closer to event time with helpful tips. 
SUPPORT
Via the app you can get support for your cruise purchase, whether just a simple question or a complex question for the big cruise day.

Now you can seamlessly sync your book with the app, ensuring consistency across your meals. Update now to enjoy personalized meal plans, workout tracking, recipes, and more. Achieve your goals with ease and stay motivated on your path to wellness. 
Beyond Body is a personalized, customizable wellness plan designed to help you reach your healthy weight and wellness goals in the easiest, safest way possible.
A Beyond Body meal plan includes +1000 delicious, easy-to-make recipes that are created from the ingredients you love. Beyond Body is not a restrictive diet. Instead of making you feel deprived, it offers a full variety of nutritious food that will keep you full and satisfied while maintaining healthy weight loss.
By teaching you healthy eating habits, Beyond Body aims to provide you with sustainable, long-term results. We don’t want you to feel miserable. We want to give you a diet you’ll willingly stick to in the long run!
What’s really exceptional about Beyond Body, is that it changes simultaneously with your body. When you start losing weight, your body’s needs adjust – with that in mind, we’ll also adjust your meal plan to ensure your body gets all the macronutrients and calories it needs.
Additionally, to accelerate your metabolism and boost your results, you’ll be able to add a personalized workout plan that offers simple, yet very effective exercise routines. These routines won’t require additional equipment, so you can easily complete them at the comfort of your home.
We believe that every person deserves to live the best life possible. Therefore, we made sure that you would actually enjoy this diet without feeling too restricted or forced to eat the foods you don’t like.
We work to ensure your successful transition into a healthier lifestyle and guide you along the way with 24/7 support.
Try it out today and get ready for positive, life-changing results!
Our app also integrates with HealthKit to track your steps data and calories burned.
Disclaimer: check with a doctor before making medical decisions.
Terms and Conditions: https://beyondbody.me/general-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://beyondbody.me/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00161074:ios.summary: OlduBil is a MasterCard licensed prepaid card and mobile application that allows you to perform many financial transactions quickly and easily. Even if you don’t have a bank account, you can shop online and in all workplaces with OlduBil. Y
bluejetty:00161074:ios.description:
OlduBil is a MasterCard licensed prepaid card and mobile application that allows you to perform many financial transactions quickly and easily. Even if you don’t have a bank account, you can shop online and in all workplaces with OlduBil. You can quickly and easily pay your utility bills for free and transfer money 24/7. There are no expenses such as account maintenance fees at OlduBil. With OlduBil, you can withdraw the money in your account whenever you want via banks and PTT ATMs in Turkey. Download the app now to take advantage of OlduBil’s special discounts and cashback benefits!
OlduBil Application and Advantages of OlduBil Card
- Quick and easy account creation.
- Owning a virtual card as soon as you download the application.
- The advantage of getting more discounts and cashbacks on shopping.
- Easely sending and receiving money 24/7 even if you don’t have a bank account.
- Possibility of paying utility bills for free, even in installments.
- Possibility of sending and receiving money 24/7 with QR code.
Create Account in just 1 Minute
You can register to OlduBil in 1 minute with just your name, surname and phone number, and you can start using your virtual card right away.
OlduBil Virtual Card is with you as soon as you register the application!
With your Mastercard licensed prepaid virtual card, you can shop easily and safely online and at all workplaces. You can use your OlduBil card anywhere in the world where Mastercard is valid. If you want, you can request a physical card from within the application or you can obtain your card from contracted sales points.
It’s Easy to Manage Your Account with OlduBil!
From the “My Wallet” tab in the application, you can track your card transactions 24/7 and manage your balance. It is also very easy to transfer money, deposit, pay bills and make QR transactions from this menu!
Earn More Discounts and Cashback on Your Shopping
With your OlduBil prepaid card, you can benefit from numerous advantages and discounts for both yourself and your family. You can get instant cashback with collaborations exclusive to OlduBil. You can track all your account transactions and your current balance from your app. With your OlduBil prepaid card, you can make shopping more advantageous and enjoyable.
Make Money Transfer 24/7 Even If You Don’t Have a Bank Account
With OlduBil, you don’t need a bank account to send and receive money 24/7. By entering the card or phone number of the OlduBil users you want to send money to in the application, you can send money 24/7 and take advantage of the fast and free money transfer.
Spend as much as You Deposit With Your OlduBil Prepaid Card
With your OlduBil prepaid card, you can deposit as much money as you want into your account. Thus, you have complete control of the money in your card.
Pay Bills From Wherever You Are
With OlduBil, you can pay your all utility bills instantly and safely for free, without waiting in queue, and you can even pay your bills in installments.
Easily Send Money to Your Child, Track Their Spending
With OlduBil, you can create a separate account for your child, easily send your child’s pocket money, track your expenses and prevent contact with money.
Make Your Payments With Your OlduBil Contectless Card Without Carrying Money
You can make all your payments with your OlduBil contactless card in a hygienic way.
Deposit and Withdraw Money From Anywhere
You can deposit money on your OlduBil card from your bank account, credit card, all banks and PTT ATMs, and withdraw the money in your account from ATMs.
Download the application, register quickly and easily to take advantage of all these advantages and more with OlduBil prepaid card.

bluejetty:00179225:ios.summary:
Some notes are too personal for a regular notes app.

bluejetty:00179225:ios.description:
Some notes are too personal for a regular notes app.
Safety Note+ gives you a dedicated private space for personal writing, sensitive lists and ideas you want to keep separate. Unlock quickly with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode, organize notes in folders, and choose optional sync or backup when you need it.
PRIVATE ACCESS
• Protect the app with a passcode or supported biometric unlock
• Choose PIN, password or pattern-style access where available
• Return to your notes quickly without mixing them with everyday notes
DECOY AND INTRUDER FEATURES
• Set a decoy password that opens alternate content
• Review supported intruder reports after failed unlock attempts
• Enable only the privacy features that fit your needs
FOLDER-LEVEL PROTECTION
• Add separate protection to selected folders
• Keep personal, journal, work and other private notes organized
• Use folder colors and icons to find important content faster
WRITE AND ORGANIZE
• Create short notes, long-form writing and private lists
• Search, sort, move and copy notes
• Auto-save helps preserve changes as you write
• Choose from available themes
SYNC, BACKUP AND DEVICE CHANGES
• Keep notes on your device for a local-first workflow
• Enable iCloud Sync on supported Apple devices
• Use optional Cloud Backup when available
• Check your backup before changing devices or deleting the app
PRIVACY YOU CAN UNDERSTAND
Face ID and Touch ID are handled by Apple. Safety Note+ does not receive or store your biometric face or fingerprint data. Sync and backup are optional and depend on the services you enable.
Safety Note+ is designed for private notes, personal journals, sensitive lists, confidential ideas and information you prefer to keep separate from a regular notes app.
Some features require an in-app purchase or subscription. Feature availability may vary by device, operating-system version and region.

Website: https://sixbytes.io
Twitter: https://twitter.com/SixbytesApp
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/sixbytesapp
For more information, please refer to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
Terms of service: https://sixbytes.io/products/safety-note/legal/terms
Privacy policy: https://sixbytes.io/products/safety-note/legal/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00100436:ios.description:
Build more muscle and get JACKED with the RP Hypertrophy app, designed by Dr. Mike Israetel. Used by industry experts, pro bodybuilders and thousands of satisfied users to help them get in the best shape of their lives, the app is perfect for anyone who wants to get real results powered by science. 
Not sure what to do at the gym? Not getting the gains you are looking for? The RP Hypertrophy app is like having a coach in your pocket providing you with personalized training recommendations. Focus on upper body, lower body or specific muscle groups with one of over 45 premade training plans or the custom meso builder. 
Why Use the RP Hypertrophy App?
• Progression planned just for you. Know exactly the weight and reps to hit every week for your best growth. Customize your workouts so you can change things on the fly. 
• Personalized recommendations. The app adjusts to your pump, soreness and workload feedback to create the perfect training plan week-by-week. 
• 45+ premade training plans. Including bodypart specialization programs. 
• 250+ technique videos. Not sure how to properly do an exercise? No problem, there’s a video for that. 
• Want to focus on abs and maintain your glutes? Use the powerful Meso Builder and create a workout plan just for you. 
Subscription pricing and terms: 
We offer 3 different subscriptions that provide full access to the app and all its features. You can choose to subscribe monthly, a 6 month term or annually.
If you purchase a RP Hypertrophy native subscription, please note billing and charges are done through your iTunes account and auto-renewed based on your subscription term. At the end of the term, unless auto-renewable subscription is disabled, your subscription will automatically renew in your iTunes account. You will be charged for the regular price of your subscription within 24 hours prior to the end of the current term. Your subscription can be managed or cancelled in your Apple ID Account Settings.
Privacy Policy:
https://rpstrength.com/policies/privacy-policy
Terms of Service:
https://rpstrength.com/policies/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00022108:ios.name: Азбука Учим буквы Алфавит Игры
bluejetty:00022108:ios.summary:
~Наша мечта – чтобы дети любили читать так же сильно, как играть.~
А мечты нужно воплощать в реальность, поэтому мы создали приложение для веселого и захватывающего обучения чтению детей от 4 до 7 лет.
Методика образовательной игры разрабо
bluejetty:00022108:ios.description:
~Наша мечта – чтобы дети любили читать так же сильно, как играть.~
А мечты нужно воплощать в реальность, поэтому мы создали приложение для веселого и захватывающего обучения чтению детей от 4 до 7 лет.
Методика образовательной игры разработана под руководством специалистов в области дошкольного образования. Это объединение всех этапов обучения чтению в одном игровом пространстве. Больше не нужно скачивать множество разных приложений! Наши игры не только помогут научиться читать, но и разовьют мышление, внимание, память и речь ребенка, подготовят ребёнка к школе. 
~Учим звуки и буквы~
Даже если ребенок уже знает буквы - это важный этап для последующего овладения чтением. Ребёнок учится слышать звук в слове (звуковой анализ слова), знакомится с образом буквы, собирая ее из частей и прописывая, и отрабатывает соотношение буквы со звуком.
~Читаем слоги~
Освоив первые звуки и буквы, ребёнок сразу сможет перейти к составлению слогов и слов. В разделе собраны игры на умение услышать слог и найти его, собрать слог из букв, отработку техники слогового чтения, чтение разного типа слогов.
~Слова и предложения~
Все слова и предложения в играх подобраны таким образом, что в них учтен уже пройденный материал. Сложность нарастает постепенно, позволяя ребёнку двигаться пошагово и обретать большую уверенность в своих силах.
~Выбирайте готовые уроки~
Ребёнок может заниматься самостоятельно! Начинайте обучение с уроков, собранных специально для Вашего малыша педагогами. Это не отдельные мини-игры! Это готовые подборки заданий, прохождение которых последовательно формирует навык чтения на базе одной изучаемой буквы. Проходя их, ребёнок шаг за шагом будет учится читать. Добейтесь прогресса, занимаясь каждый день! 
~Система наград и достижений~
Играйте с пользой! Образовательное приложение “Смешарики. Учимся читать” поможет ребенку не только получить новые знания, но и провести время увлекательно и с пользой. Система краткосрочной и долгосрочной мотивации поможет ребенку не потерять интерес к знаниям.
– Сказки, в которые можно еще и играть. Путешествие по страницам сказок и выбор своего героя.
– Аудиоистории про Смешариков. После успешного обучения ребенок будет способен прочитать их самостоятельно.
– Альбомы с наклейками. Расширяем словарный запас. Уникальная коллекция слов, доступных для прочтения
~Статистика~
В образовательном приложении реализован специальный раздел “Статистика”. Благодаря собранной в нём информации, у родителей есть возможность следить за прогрессом ребенка и понимать, как идет освоение материала.
~Приятные бонусы~
– Более 20 развивающих мини-игр, созданных нами в содружестве с опытными психологами и дошкольными педагогами! 
– Красочные иллюстрации и анимации, полностью озвучены персонажи и задания, простой и понятный ребёнку интерфейс.
– Система наград и достижений затягивает ребёнка в процесс обучения и способствует достижению отличных результатов.
– Выбор пола и внешности действующего персонажа сказок, чтобы ребёнок мог выбрать близкий для себя образ.
– И, конечно, Смешарики! Любимые герои мультфильмов станут верными помощниками для ребёнка при обучении чтению.
Играйте с пользой! А мы всегда рады вашей обратной связи, любым отзывам и советам. Напишите нам: mobile-edu@1c.ru

bluejetty:00046877:ios.description:
Think you know your favorite Roblox games inside out? Put your knowledge to the test in this fun and addictive quiz game made specially for Roblox fans.
Start at Level 1 and climb your way up through unlimited levels. Each level brings you 2 exciting questions:
- See an image and skins of a popular game.
- Fill in the missing part of the game’s name (e.g. Adopt ____!).
- Choose from multiple options.
- Get instant feedback on whether you’re correct!

Features:
Endless Levels – No cap, keep playing and leveling up forever.
Fun Game Images – Test your knowledge with visual skins of your favorite Roblox games.
Instant Feedback – Know right away if your answer is correct.
Fun Robux Quiz – Reach milestone levels to be the best.
Easy to Play, Hard to Master – Simple tap-to-answer gameplay, but the challenge never ends!
Whether you’re a casual gamer or a hardcore fan, this quiz will keep you entertained while sharpening your memory. Can you make it to the highest level?

bluejetty:00115321:ios.name: Car Games for Toddlers & Kids!
bluejetty:00115321:ios.developer: Tabloki - relaxing games designed for the family
bluejetty:00115321:ios.summary: Car Games for Toddlers & Kids is a lively driving adventure that blends fun, learning, and creativity for children ages 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and beyond. Designed to spark imagination and develop essential motor skills, this game offers an excitin
bluejetty:00115321:ios.description:
Car Games for Toddlers & Kids is a lively driving adventure that blends fun, learning, and creativity for children ages 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and beyond. Designed to spark imagination and develop essential motor skills, this game offers an exciting world of racing and exploration that little drivers will love. Whether your child dreams of zipping around in a stylish sports car, operating mighty construction vehicles, or simply enjoying a calm ride through the countryside, there’s something here for every young racer.
Choose from four delightful characters—a curious Boy, a cheerful Girl, a friendly Crocodile, or a brave Lion—and steer your way through four immersive environments. Race past glowing skyscrapers in the Futuristic City, soak up the sun on Countryside Roads dotted with rolling hills and cozy cottages, venture deep into a lush Jungle Adventure teeming with wild creatures, or traverse the warm sands of the Safari Desert, complete with camels and tall palm trees. Each themed location presents a colorful, cartoon-inspired setting that captivates children’s attention while encouraging them to learn through play.
Little ones can hop into 18 unique vehicles, each with its own personality and purpose. Let them roar down the track in sporty supercars, drive a reliable SUV for family trips, or pick up passengers with a trusty taxi. For those who love rescue missions, the fire truck, police car, and ambulance are ready to save the day, while a school bus helps transport friends to class. Children will also enjoy operating heavy-duty machines such as a tow truck, garbage truck, and four construction vehicles—a bulldozer, excavator, cement mixer, and dump truck. To add even more variety, there’s a caravan for epic road trips, a monster truck for wild stunts, a tractor for farm life, and an ice cream truck to bring sweet treats to every corner of the map.
As your child collects stars, overcomes playful obstacles, and zooms across different terrains, they’ll develop crucial hand-eye coordination, refine motor skills, and exercise their growing imaginations. In addition, they can personalize each vehicle by painting vibrant colors on the car’s body, choosing eye-catching stickers, and upgrading wheels for enhanced performance. These creative options keep little hands busy and minds engaged, making every ride feel fresh and exciting.
Here are some of the key features that make Car Games for Toddlers & Kids an unforgettable experience:
- Easy, Child-Friendly Controls: Perfect for preschoolers who are just learning to navigate virtual worlds, with intuitive buttons and simple gestures.
- Educational Fun: Boosts reaction speed, problem-solving abilities, and spatial awareness while children play and explore.
- Safe & Family-Friendly: Contains no confusing menus or unsafe content, creating a worry-free environment for parents.
- Offline Play: Enjoy racing adventures anytime, anywhere—no internet or Wi-Fi required.
You can unlock all levels, all new game features and all vehicles, via auto-renewable subscription:
we offer three auto-renewing subscription options: weekly subscription, monthly subscription, annual subscription.
By subscribing you get unlimited access to all contents.
Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account.
You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Your account will be charged according to your plan for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
If you wish to avoid auto-renewal you must turn it off at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current period in your Account Settings.
Privacy policy and Terms of Use Page:
https://bravekidmobilegames.com/privacy-policy
https://bravekidmobilegames.com/terms-and-conditions

Think no more about the long and boring distance between you and your destination! With Turbo, you can order a ride with just one click, get picked up by a nearby driver in no time, and enjoy an affordable trip to your desired destination.

1. Convenience 
2. Affordability 
3. Rewards and offers
4. Availability
5. And, of course, a job opportunity.

The job opportunity is now available! Join as a Turbo driver, register your data, and earn a source of income through your own car and with flexible hours.
--- Keep Moving forward
Turbo is not just a ride but an integrated, convenient, and renewable experience that will move your life for the better!
Contact us at

- Flexible reminders so you don’t miss out

 - View any upcoming leave, plus leave history and balances.
 - Managers can add, edit, approveor decline leave requests for their team.
 - View future leave balances when applying for leave.
Submitting timesheets
 - Enter time and rate per hour.
 - Create multiple time entries for each day.
 - Managers can add, edit, approve or decline time for their team.
 - Remembers the last timesheet entry and prefills the same hours.
 - Copy a previous weeks timesheet to save time.
Labour costing
 - Assign hours worked to different jobs or departments.
ABOUT SMARTLY
We know that payroll can be a headache. So, at Smartly we make it simple for businesses to pay their people on time, accurately and in-line with regulation. Faff-free payroll, happy staff, no headaches. Too easy!

bluejetty:00077319:ios.description:
Discover a universe of fun and learning with our new app! Kids can rescue cute animals, collect unique treasures, and explore new planets all from the comfort of their own Spaceship. This is an exciting game where children can build, restore, and customize their own little corner of the universe.
Experience fantastic animation that kindles children's curiosity and imagination! Choose from six unique claw devices — including a rocket vacuum cleaner, fishing net, electromagnetic gun, metal grapple, frozen gun, and a hilarious sticky tongue — to grab your prize from one of our 30 originally designed twisted eggs.
Hidden within each twisted egg lies a magical surprise. Will it be a cuddly animal, a shiny spaceship, or a new collectible? With a grand total of 360 dolls to collect, the fun never ends!
Journey through delightful landscapes, from the gourmet kingdom filled with delicious chocolate truffles to the undersea world of shiny pearls and colorful shells. Watch out for the tricky squid who sprays ink and the mysterious black hole that takes away coins. But fear not, a friendly spaceship is always ready to rescue you with more riches and goodies.
This game provides a safe and fun environment for children. No third-party advertising, and you can play it without the Internet. Plus, children can unlock more landscape wallpapers, each with its own unique control handle, adding to the new discoveries they make along the way.
Parents, your kids will have a blast, and they won't even realize they're learning. Dive into the magic of our universe and start the machine to collect the dolls now!
About Yateland: Yateland creates apps with educational value that inspire children worldwide to learn through play. We stand by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." To learn more about Yateland and our apps, visit https://yateland.com.
We prioritize user privacy. For information about our privacy practices, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00019527:ios.description:
Whether you’re sleeping, eating, or taking the subway - come play Ulala: Idle Adventure! Ulala is an idle MMORPG, which brings to life the excitement and adventures of the Stone Age in a fun and social way!
Could you ever imagine the Stone Age to be so carefree?
At the edge of the desert, and at the foot of a volcano, there lives a group of happy Ulala and a bunch of little monsters. Ice and fire, thunder and electricity, all intertwine on the wild and vast continent where there's constantly a struggle between peace and action.
This season’s Hunting Horn is about to blow! Ride your little Tyrannosaurus Rex and bring all your friends along to prove yourself to be a top hunter this season in the world of Ulala.
A relaxed RPG?
Want to be the best, but don’t want to spend all of your time constantly playing? Come play Ulala! Here, the easy and addictive gameplay will not distract from your daily life!
Tired of taking painstaking efforts to upgrade your characters? Come to Ulala, where your character and pets are automatically upgraded and infinitely level-up. This brings a whole new concept and gameplay experience to the very idea of MMORPGs. 
Anytime and anywhere, here in the land of Ulala you can team-up and make new friends, even while chatting or enjoying a meal! Playing an RPG has never been so easy!
Team-up with friends and make a name for yourselves! 
In the world of Ulala, you can enjoy all kinds of bonuses and benefits by teaming-up! Relax, and come to the world of Ulala with all of your friends and family!
A vast and versatile gameplay experience
The gameplay is enriched by a very large choice of skills, equipment, skins, and much more!
Collect Epic equipment pieces and Skill Cards to unlock and upgrade powerful skill sets.
Ulala says ‘NO!’ to fixed classes and gameplay styles; presenting thousands of different combinations of skills, equipment, and much more. This allows you to craft and create your own personal class and gameplay style!
Get ready to bring along your favorite pet, and dash off to strike a powerful blow to your enemies!
Never-ending choice of pets
Tyrannosaurus Rex, Triceratops, Sabertooth Tiger, Marmots… Have your choice of your own personal pet, which will level-up and grow along with you on your adventure. Just remember to prepare your delicious recipes and traps! We wish you good luck!
For more information：
Official Website：https://ulala.xdg.com/
Facebook group：https://facebook.com/PlayUlala/
