bluejetty:00063220:ios.name: Caro ™
bluejetty:00063220:ios.summary:
This is the version of Cờ Caro for beginners, very easy to play yet still fun and challenging.
Tic Tac Toe ⑤ (Five in a Row) is a strategic board game also known as Caro in Vietnam, Omok (오목) in Korea, gomokunarabe (五目並べ) in Japan and wuzi
bluejetty:00063220:ios.description:
This is the version of Cờ Caro for beginners, very easy to play yet still fun and challenging.
Tic Tac Toe ⑤ (Five in a Row) is a strategic board game also known as Caro in Vietnam, Omok (오목) in Korea, gomokunarabe (五目並べ) in Japan and wuziqi (五子棋) in China. 
It is the extended version of Tic Tac Toe - you win with 5 pieces in a row instead of 3. The board is 15x15. The game is also sometimes called XO.
Players alternate turns placing X or O on an empty intersection. X makes the first move.
The first player to get an unbroken row of five stones wins the game.
Caro X brings this great game to your iPhone. You can enjoy Caro in family game time, or you can also enjoy the game by playing with the AIs of varying difficulties. Beware that it is very challenging to beat the best AI in this game!
You will also gain experience points by winning against the AIs (+1 for Easy, +3 for Medium, +5 for Hard, and +7 for Expert).
Features:
◆ Undo
◆ Save/load unfinished game
◆ AIs with 4 levels of difficulties
◆ Timer based game
◆ Zoom in and zoom out.
The variation of Five in a Row supported in this game is free-style. A player just needs to make a row of five or more stones to win.

Just like if yo
bluejetty:00015785:ios.description:
Learn Korean, Japanese and Spanish by speaking from the start!
Practice speaking essential expressions in first-person POV scenarios.
===========
• "But I can just learn Spanish, Korean and Japanese by watching Netflix!?”
Just like if you were learning how to swim, you’d go into a pool instead of watching videos of Michael Phelps swimming. You can't learn Korean by listening to NewJeans or speak Spanish by singing Despacito. Don't get us wrong. We love music. But if your goal is to ACTUALLY SPEAK, you have to, well – SPEAK! TEUIDA's first-person POV conversations will get you speaking everyday expressions in real-life scenarios.
• 3 min > 30 min
We believe that 3 minutes of actual speaking will help you more than 30 minutes watching someone else speak (long lecture videos).
Why waste your precious time learning about a language when you can learn by speaking it yourself? Our interactive lessons not only get you to speak with the tutors but gives instant feedback on your pronunciation.
• Overcome fear of speaking
Research shows that one of the greatest barriers to speaking a language is confidence. After all, what's the point of knowing all the grammar rules and verb conjugations if you can't speak when the moment comes? TEUIDA helps you overcome fear of speaking by simulating real-life scenarios but without all the social anxiety. (i.e. Our characters won't throw shade at you for mispronouncing!)
===========
Here’s a list of things that make TEUIDA different:
• Essential expressions:
No more weird, awkward phrases (translated by bots) that no one actually use in real life. (Let's be honest, when was the last time you had to say "I am a boy, you are a woman" in real-life?)
• Effective curriculum:
Once you master our curriculum, you will be able to know the basic vocabularies, grammars and of course, speak to your friends in Korean, Japanese, and Spanish!
• Taught by Bilingual Tutors:
Our crazy selection of fully bilingual tutors not only speak Korean and Japanese but understand where you’re coming from. They know exactly what to teach you because they've been in your shoes!
• AI Pronunciation Analysis:
What's the point of repeating sentences aloud if you can't tell whether you're pronouncing it right? TEUIDA has a convenient voice recognition system that will give instant feedback on your pronunciation.
• Fun, Interactive Stories:
We believe that learning and fun are not mutually exclusive. In fact, learning is most effective when it's fun! You'll find yourself laughing, screaming and at times even cringing with the characters.
• Real-life Scenarios:
Real-life everyday situations! Everything from ordering a drink at the cafe to asking for directions! 
• Culture-specific tips:
A wise man once said that "the person who learns language without learning culture risks becoming a fluent fool". We believe understanding culture is the key to learning language. So we hand-selected each scenario to reflect the culture-specific elements of that specific culture!
So... what are you waiting for? Stop reading and start speaking with TEUIDA!
===========
Please note you will need a TEUIDA Premium plan in order to access all content and exclusive features.
Terms of Use: https://www.teuida.net/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.teuida.net/privacy
===========

Business address: 5th floor, 165, Yeoksam-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
Contact: +82 10-4590-3154

Find thousands of beautiful photos and designs for your Apple Watch's Photos watch face! Don’t settle for the default watch faces and backgrounds—supercharge it! With Watch Faces Lab, it’s like getting a new smart watch every day. Impress your friends with your stunning watch looks!

Key Features:

- Live faces, Watch wallpapers and more;

- Browse collection with thousands of new and popular Watch Faces for Apple Watch；

- New faces every week;

- One-click installation function. Simple and easy to use;

- Battery, date and step counter for your Apple Watch;

- Select favorite watch faces for collection

COMPATIBILITY:

Select your Apple Watch model to hide incompatible watch faces for your specific Watch Series. Please note that Apple Watch Series 3 and older models have restrictions with portrait watch faces and complications. Watch animations are limited to 4 seconds per wrist flick.

HEALTH ACCESS:

The app may require access to your health data, such as steps, heart rate, etc. solely for displaying them on your watch faces. Rest assured, we do not use or store your personal data in any other way.

If you have any issues - please, contact us: yp01watch@gmail.com

Privacy Policy: https://www.watchfacelab.com/privacyPolicy.html

Terms Of Service: https://www.watchfacelab.com/terms_of_service.html

bluejetty:00076352:ios.description:
Roll the Dice and play "Best Games Ever" anytime, anywhere, with friends or family with this new and free app!
Play with characters including Pirate Dad, Pirate Niko, Fairy Adley, Fairy Mom, and even Chuck the Pirate, and explore various games in a unique playstyle based on the physical board game of Best Games Ever!
The Best Games Ever board game is based on the first 5 Family Cartoons from Spacestation Animation.
• Pirate Island
• Sticker Pox
• Hair Salon
• The Floor is Lava
• The Lost Mermaid
Each game is coupled with the characters from the episode, an interactive environment, and different rules for each game creating a brand new experience from the previous Spacestation Apps Games!
Best Games Ever was thought up and made by the people at A for Adley, Spacestation Apps, and Spacestation Animation. Spacestation Animation is a fun YouTube Channel featuring Cartoons that take audio from the YouTube Channel "A for Adley" and uses 3D animation to re-imagine new storylines and exciting adventures with Adley McBride and her whole family.
Best Games Ever includes -
• An experience designed in-house by Spacestation Apps, Spacestation Labs, Spacestation Nebula and A for Adley
• Custom Unique Gameplay from the physical board game that you can play directly on your phone!
• 5 New Games
 • Pirate Island
 • Sticker Pox
 • Hair Salon
 • The Floor is Lava
 • The Lost Mermaid
• Custom Music and Sound Effects
• Maps and Dice that interact with each other create fun surprises
• Beloved Characters from the Spacestation Animation Family Cartoons
• Best of all it is completely FREE to play!!

bluejetty:00091739:ios.description:
Simplify your cleaning routines with the BISSELL Connect App. Did your dog make a mess of breakfast right as you’re heading out the door? Use the app to set a cleaning schedule with your robotic vacuum. Wondering what’s the best way to clean up your cat’s wet or dry mess? Check out our cleaning tips and videos to make the most of your BISSELL device. The BISSELL Connect App gives you the power to manage your connected BISSELL products anytime, anywhere with your smart device, so you can get on with your busy day. 
BISSELL Connect Features 
- See the status of your connected BISSELL products and easily reorder formula, brush rolls, and filters. 
- Analyze your cleaning history. 
- Access helpful tips, videos, and guides to keep your machines cleaning efficiently. 
- Adjust settings from the palm of your hand. 
- Update your cleaning machines and access the latest features and software updates. 
- Start, stop, dock, set modes and schedule cleans for your robotic vacuum right from your phone. 
- View and customize your SpinWave R5 map 
Requirements 
- Any BISSELL connected product 
- 2.4 Ghz Wi-Fi network

bluejetty:00167630:ios.summary: MigraConnect is the best app to track your U.S. immigration cases. Stay updated on your USCIS cases, Immigration Court hearings, Asylum Clock, and FOIA requests, all in one place. Get alerts and full case history so you never miss an import
bluejetty:00167630:ios.description:
MigraConnect is the best app to track your U.S. immigration cases. Stay updated on your USCIS cases, Immigration Court hearings, Asylum Clock, and FOIA requests, all in one place. Get alerts and full case history so you never miss an important update in your immigration journey.
Our app gives you everything you need to stay informed and one step ahead in your U.S. immigration journey.
Key Features:
• USCIS Case Tracking: Get faster, and more reliable case updates.
• Full Case History: View past updates on your case that the USCIS website doesn’t show.
• Immigration Court Information: *Unique feature* Track your immigration court (EOIR) with your alien number.
• Check your Asylum Clock with ease
• Alerts for changes in your USCIS and Court cases directly on your phone
• Access asylum statistics for your Immigration Judge. Check how often has granted or denied asylum!
• FOIA Request Status: Monitor your FOIA requests in real time.
• AI-Powered Next Step Estimation for USCIS cases.
• Easily share case details with Privacy.
• Effortless Case Management: Easily manage and organize all your immigration cases in one place with a user-friendly interface.
• Available in multiple languages, including English and Spanish.
Why Choose Us?
• All-in-One: The only app combining USCIS, FOIA, and Immigration Court updates.
• No annoying ads
• User-Friendly: Simple, fast access to your essential information with the latest technologies.
• Alert notifications to keep you even more informed on your USCIS case and Immigration Court!
Disclaimer: MigraConnect Case Tracker is not affiliated with or endorsed by any U.S. government agency. We do not provide legal advice, as MigraConnect Case Tracker is not a law firm. The information provided in the app is sourced from publicly available USCIS and EOIR websites. We do not guarantee the accuracy of this information, and it should not be used for legal purposes. All data displayed in the app complies with USCIS website policies (https://www.uscis.gov/website-policies) and EOIR website policies (https://www.justice.gov/legalpolicies), which allow for the distribution or copying of public information. By accessing or using this application, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by our terms and conditions https://migraconnect.us/terms/en

bluejetty:00134869:ios.description:
*THIS APPLICATION DOES NOT PROVIDE ANY SERVER SIDE SERVICE*
Pharos Pro is a simple but powerful proxy client.
You can configure which traffics route to proxy servers,Its core value is to provide the most secure proxy, The NEVPNManager API gives Pharos Pro the ability to create and manage a Personal proxy configuration on iOS. 
It can capture all HTTP/HTTPS/TCP traffic from any applications on your device, and redirect to an HTTP/SOCK5 proxy server following highly configurable rules.
# Feature:
Capture all HTTP/HTTPS/TCP traffic from any applications on your device,and redirect to an HTTP/SOCK5 proxy server following highly configurable rules.
- Support protocol : Trojan,Vmess,Https,SS,SS-Simpleobfs,SSR,Trojan-Go,Xray,Hysteria,,Tuic,Anytls,mieru.
- Support policy mode with Clash.Meta config.
- Support Subscribe.
- Support scan QR code.
- Support custom node.
- Support test delay of node.
- Easy to use — just tap the connect button.
- Fast, reliable access to the safety internet.
# What can you do with a proxy client?
- Enhance your online privacy and enable you to safely and anonymously browse the Internet.
- Protect you when using a public WIFI hotspot.
- Allows you to create a secure connection to another network over the Internet.
#Notes:
- Pharos Pro does not provide any server side services. Please setup your own servers.
- Pharos Pro requires to add proxy Configurations to add your own proxy Configuration.
- Pharos Pro is a client side application.No user data will be sent to our severs.More details are listed in https://pharospro.com/privacy-policy.
# Privacy Policy:
* When the user is in normal use, we will not log any logs related to the user.
* Only when the app is crash, we will collect the necessary user connection and crash log.
* Details: https://pharospro.com/privacy-policy

Looking for captivating stories that amplify light? Our movies and entertainment captures storytelling that is true, honest and authentic. Angel’s variety of TV shows, movies, and new releases are handpicked by our biggest supporters, you, our Angel Guild members. We’re taking the power back from Hollywood gatekeepers and giving it to you.

With Angel, you can watch inspiring, award-winning movies and TV —from original series like The Wayfinders and Tuttle Twins to movies like David, Sound of Freedom, King of Kings, and Homestead, plus unique comedy shows like Dry Bar Comedy. New full episodes and titles are added weekly for you to enjoy stand-up comedy specials, TV episodes, and genres including action, drama, and faith movies. Our movies and TV series episodes are meant to raise, inspire, and move us— and deserve to be shared and cherished.

As a member, you get unlimited access to our award-winning, viewer-supported entertainment. Plus, you help shape the future of Angel by voting for new shows and movies, supporting a growing library of stories that break barriers, inspire, uplift, and bring people together.

Angel is home to high-quality, value-driven movies & TV entertainment that you won’t find anywhere else. Our mission is to make impactful storytelling accessible to all—and as an Angel Guild member, you play a key role in bringing these stories to life. 

ANGEL APP MEMBER FEATURES:

ACCESS FULL EPISODES & POPULAR MOVIES
- Exclusive Entertainment: Angel Guild members get early access to new releases, exclusive live streams, movie tickets, merch discounts, and more.
- Watch 750+ movies, TV show episodes, comedy specials, and documentaries.
- Watch inspiring family movies, new releases, and full episodes. Enjoy entertainment made by creators that share the same values as you.
- Free Shows You’ll Love: Enjoy inspiring titles like Dry Bar Comedy, Jungle Beat, Tuttle Twins, The Wingfeather Saga, and more, available to stream now.

SHAPE THE FUTURE OF MOVIE AND TV ENTERTAINMENT
- Fan-Powered Entertainment: Vote for upcoming shows and movies as part of our Angel Guild membership and help shape the future of streaming.
- Full films and episodes: Decide the next show we release and stream—instead of Hollywood executives.
- New releases: Watch and vote on upcoming projects and new releases.
- Share with Friends and Family: Angel Guild members can share movies and tv episodes with friends and family to watch for free.

MOVIES AND TV EPISODES THAT INSPIRE AND UPLIFT
- Be part of a movement that’s changing the industry one movie at a time.
- Your support helps bring more light-filled stories to life and ensures meaningful entertainment reaches the world.
- Shop for merch in the Angel Gift Shop with a 20% discount (premium members).
- Get 2 free movie tickets to every Angel theatrical release (premium members).

Start watching anything for free with sneak peeks of every movie and full access to many of our full episodes. Join the millions of Angel Guild members and get exclusive access to new releases first. 

Stream your favorites, vote for new shows and movies, and be part of a community that matters. Download the app and start streaming full movies, episodes, and new TV for inspiring, light-amplifying entertainment.

Privacy policy: https://www.angel.com/legal/privacy
Video privacy policy: https://www.angel.com/legal/video-privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://www.angel.com/legal/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00165663:ios.name: Líder Lex
bluejetty:00165663:ios.summary:
Lex App – O aplicativo oficial da comunidade Lex

bluejetty:00165663:ios.description:
Lex App – O aplicativo oficial da comunidade Lex
O Lex App é o ambiente oficial da Alexandria para quem atua na comunidade Lex.
Ele reúne, em um só lugar, ferramentas para organizar sua rotina, acompanhar suas atividades, enviar propostas, acessar conteúdos e visualizar sua evolução dentro das funções da comunidade.
Desenvolvido para consultores, coordenadores e gerentes, o app oferece um sistema claro, simples e transparente para apoiar o seu dia a dia.
Criação de propostas de forma prática
Com o Lex App, enviar uma fatura e gerar uma proposta fica rápido e organizado.
Basta adicionar uma foto ou PDF: o app faz a leitura automática dos dados, facilita a revisão e mostra cada etapa do processo.
Acompanhe sua atuação
O app apresenta suas informações principais em um painel intuitivo.
Você encontra:
- propostas enviadas e concluídas
- acompanhamento da sua semana
- recorrência da sua base
- histórico de atividades
- visão clara do seu momento dentro da comunidade
Tudo estruturado para ajudar você a se organizar e entender seu desempenho de forma simples.
Conteúdos, treinamentos e certificações
O Lex App dá acesso à Lex University, um espaço com aulas, trilhas, materiais educativos e certificações oficiais.
Você pode estudar, acompanhar seu progresso e desenvolver novas habilidades diretamente pelo app.
Estrutura de funções organizada
O empreendedor Lex opera com três funções: consultor, coordenador e gerente.
Cada uma tem suas responsabilidades e sua própria visão dentro do app.
- Consultores visualizam suas vendas e clientes.
- Coordenadores acompanham seus consultores.
- Gerentes têm visão consolidada dos coordenadores.
Isso garante clareza, organização e comunicação alinhada com o papel de cada pessoa na comunidade.
Contabilidade digital integrada
A LexC é o serviço de contabilidade digital integrado ao app.
Ela ajuda você a organizar documentos fiscais, acompanhar obrigações do seu CNPJ e manter sua atividade formalizada de maneira simples.
O processo é prático, automatizado e funciona dentro do próprio aplicativo.
Comunicação centralizada
O aplicativo reúne notificações importantes em um único lugar:
- atualizações de propostas
- status de clientes
- avisos operacionais
- orientações da comunidade
- lembretes de metas e atividades
Assim, você se mantém atualizado sem perder informações relevantes.
Por que o Lex App é ideal para sua jornada:
- Interface simples e organizada
- Criação rápida de propostas
- Leitura automática de faturas
- Acompanhamento do seu desempenho
- Treinamentos e certificações integrados
- Estrutura clara de funções
- Contabilidade digital LexC integrada
- Comunicação unificada
- Transparência em todas as etapas
- Tecnologia para apoiar sua jornada no setor de energia renovável
O Lex App foi desenvolvido para oferecer organização, clareza e eficiência no seu dia a dia dentro da comunidade Lex, tudo em um ambiente digital pensado para facilitar seu trabalho e sua evolução. Baixe o app e confira tudo o que o Lex oferece para você, caso tenha dúvidas entrar em contato pelo contato@alexandria.solar

bluejetty:00057819:ios:1.description:
Create, edit, and collaborate on online documents with the Google Docs app.
Work together in real time
• Share documents with your team
• Edit, comment, and add action items in real time
Create anywhere, anytime—even offline
• Capture spontaneous ideas on the fly
• Get things done, even on the go, with offline mode
• Save time and add polish with easy-to-use templates
Edit and share multiple file types
• Open a variety of files, including Microsoft Word files, right in Google Docs
• Frictionless collaboration, no matter which application your teammates use
• Convert and export files seamlessly
Google Docs is part of Google Workspace: where teams of any size can chat, create, and collaborate.
Google Workspace paid subscribers have access to additional Google Docs features, including:
Use Gemini in Docs to quickly draft and edit content
• Draft outlines, blog posts, briefs, and more on the go
• Improve your writing with AI-powered suggestions

bluejetty:00131935:ios.description:
** Your Go-To Pediatric Resource with Updated Drug Formulary ** 
**Exclusive Unbound Medicine bonus features include Prime PubMed and integrated calculators**
HARRIET LANE HANDBOOK
Written by pediatric residents from the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, Harriet Lane Handbook is the authoritative resource for interns, residents, and practitioners. Download this resource to review disease information or search figures, algorithms, tables, and charts. Check medication details in the new, fully-updated drug formulary which provides the standard in pediatric care. Quickly confirm diagnoses across a wide range of pediatric conditions and consult the most recent management recommendations, immunization schedules, procedures, and therapeutic guidelines specific to children. 
FEATURES
• Updated details on hundreds of pediatric conditions in concise outline format. 
• Integrated dosage calculators
• Renowned pediatric drug formulary with dosing, side effects, interactions, special considerations, and more
• Hard to find images, charts, algorithms, and tables
• Management recommendations, immunization schedules, and therapeutic guidelines
• Coverage of dermatology treatments, eczema complications, and lead poisoning
• Advanced search helps you find information quickly 
• Ability to highlight and make notes within any topic
• Reference links to the medical literature through Prime PubMed
• “Favorites” for bookmarking important entries
Prime PubMed Search
Quickly search journal articles from the full PubMed database on your smartphone and tablet. Results contain abstracts, citations, and links to available full text articles that can be read on device and shared with classmates and colleagues. Additionally, Prime contains Grapherence™, an exclusive way to visually explore interrelationships and relevance in the medical literature.
Prime PubMed Journals
Select and follow your favorite journals. Receive instant alerts when new articles publish. 
Editors: Camille C. Anderson, MD, Sunaina Kapoor, MD, MPH and Tiffany E Mark, MD
Formulary updated by updated by Carlton K. K. Lee, PharmD, MPH
Publisher: Elsevier 
Powered by: Unbound Medicine
UPGRADE OPTION
Add Davis’s Drug Guide to your Harriet Lane Handbook app. After purchase, you can easily add a 1-year subscription of the best-selling drug database trusted by thousands of healthcare professionals. Davis’s Drug Guide delivers frequently updated information on over 5,000 trade name and generic drugs. Each monograph, with its focus on safety, includes details on pharmacokinetics, dosing, side effects, interactions, assessment, and more. 
Your Davis’s Drug Guide subscription automatically renews annually unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours prior to the conclusion of your current period. If you choose not to renew, you will continue to have access to the content, but will no longer receive updates. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged the current renewal rate ($39.99) within 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period. This will ensure you receive all updates for the following year. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
Unbound Privacy Policy: www.unboundmedicine.com/privacy
Unbound Terms of Use: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/end_user_license_agreement

bluejetty:00039387:ios.description:
BasicBeauty is a free and easy-to-use tool that helps you to create, practice and stick to beauty routines so that you can feel confident about your appearance.
With BasicBeauty, you can:
* Routines
- Use preset routines for your health, face, hair, body, hands and feet
- Create a custom routine
- Plan your routines flexibly
- Follow the basic skincare guide for your skin type
- Set up or get automatic reminders for your routines
* Products
- Add to the product list and link to your routines
- Track product expiry date
- Set timers for products that require a specific wait time
- Archive products you no longer use, write notes
* Journal
- Add progress photos every day
- Take photos of different angles and body parts
- Log 80+ symptoms and lifestyle choices
- Track changes over time by comparing the before/after photos
* Insights
- Clear overview of the habit formation process
- Figure out which products & skincare routines work for you
- Track how cosmetics, water intake and sleep duration influence your skin condition
*
- You don't need to pay to start building routines
- No sign-ups. Only you see your data
- Ad-free

- Create an unlimited number of routines
- Add an unlimited number of products
- See your skin progress over time from beginning to end
- Get access to more new features the moment it's released

bluejetty:00180726:ios.description:
Ever wanted to keep track of your friends and family who fly Southwest Airlines? Curious about the destinations, aircraft models or speed at which Southwest Airlines planes traverse the skies? Well, your wish just came true! Introducing the Southwest Airlines Flight Radar application - your gateway to the wonders of aviation.
With this application, you can immerse yourself in the world of aviation and even experience what it's like to be a Southwest Airlines pilot, all from the comfort of your smartphone. Think of your device as a handheld radar and each Southwest Airlines flight as an adventure waiting to be explored.
Let's explore some of the incredible features the Southwest Airlines Flight Radar application has to offer:
Global flight tracking: Gain access to a bird's eye view of Southwest Airlines flights worldwide. Whether it's soaring over the Arctic or descending over the Amazon, you can track them all.
Aircraft Insights: Dive deep into the details of Southwest Airlines aircraft. You can discover details such as aircraft model, flight path, current speed, cruising altitude, and origin and destination airports. It's like having an aviation encyclopedia in your pocket.
Real-time flight details: Stay up-to-date with estimated departure and arrival times for all Southwest Airlines flights. Curious about airport weather? You'll find all the information you need right in the app. No need to rush to the airport, it's all at your fingertips.
Tailored information: We know every traveler has a favorite Southwest Airlines aircraft. That's why we've made it easy for you to perform detailed searches. In real time, you can access and monitor the details of the Southwest Airlines aircraft that captures your imagination.
Doesn't it all sound intriguing? Download the Southwest Airlines Flight Radar application and embark on a journey through the skies, getting a glimpse into the world of aviation like you've never seen before.
Prepare to be mesmerized by the sheer scale of Southwest Airlines' global operations. As you watch planes crisscross the globe, you'll be amazed at the information you can access about each flight. It's not just an app, it's your passport to the world of aviation.
Join the thousands of aviation enthusiasts who've already embarked on this exciting journey. Whether you're a frequent flyer, an aviation buff, or just curious about Southwes

bluejetty:00183491:ios.description:
Watermark Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Watermark Bank:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Watermark Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Watermark Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00076299:ios.description:
Features:
- Chess opening tree with game statistics
- The Encyclopedia of Chess Openings (ECO)
- Database of top 100+ grandmasters’ repertoires
- Stockfish chess engine analysis
- Compare ECO, opening tree and engine moves side by side in any position
- Import and export chess openings in PGN format
- Build your own opening repertoire
- Add or edit comments on moves
- Automatically classify any sequence of moves using the ECO system
- Chess opening explorer highlights moves already in your repertoire
- Chess database includes all transpositions
- Interactive trainer to memorize your chess openings and variations
- Train multiple variations at once against random opponent moves from your repertoire
- Set up a starting position for training
- Track your training progress
- Customize chessboard colors and chess pieces
- Supports dark mode
- No ads
- Works completely offline
CHESS OPENING EXPLORER
Search in the Encyclopedia of Chess Openings, browse the chess opening tree, explore the opening repertoires of famous chess grandmasters, or ask the chess engine to find the best moves. Swipe left or right to switch between the exploration features in any position.
BUILD YOUR OPENING REPERTOIRE
Add your favorite opening lines to your repertoire using the chess opening explorer or import your openings in PGN format from other chess programs. You can always edit the names of your openings and organize them in your repertoire.
OPENING TRAINER
A simple and efficient method to memorize variations of openings in your repertoire. You can train either white’s moves or black’s moves only or both. Optionally, you can train all variations at once. The trainer chooses the opponent’s moves randomly from your opening repertoire. Chess Opener tracks your progress and shows your stats.

bluejetty:00095572:ios.description:
Give your cat the healthiest life - one bowl at a time.
Scan any cat food with your camera or upload a picture and instantly find out if it’s good, bad, or harmful for your cat. Our AI considers your cat’s age, breed, allergies, and health conditions to deliver personalized food ratings, ingredient warnings, and better alternatives. Track meals, monitor your cat’s wellness score, and feel confident about every bite they take.
HOW TO USE LEO CAT FOOD SCANNER
1. Select the cat that you will feed in the Scan screen (Optional)
2. Take or upload a picture of the food or food package
3. Read the results, and if the food is appropriate for your cat's personalized needs, log it to your cats food log
For the algorithm to provide you with proper results, the cat's stored allergy and health conditions must be accurate. You can add these during the onboarding or in your cat's details screen. If you are unsure of your cat's allergies or existing health conditions, consult your vet.
Disclaimer: This app is not a substitute for professional veterinary advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your vet for health-related decisions. We are not liable for any harm caused by food choices made using this app.
Scanning food, food analysis and advanced models require an active paid subscription.

– Feels like the most satisfying clicker games experience
– Charming visuals in every work games session
– Unlock worker games potential—your workers game realm awaits
Start Crushing Logs Today!

bluejetty:00164499:ios.name: Forma: Workout Tracker Gym Log
bluejetty:00164499:ios.summary: When developing Forma, I paid special attention to minimalism. As a result, I got a fully functional workout tracker, which works completely offline and has no extra functions at all. The interface is so intuitive that it is impossible to g
bluejetty:00164499:ios.description:
When developing Forma, I paid special attention to minimalism. As a result, I got a fully functional workout tracker, which works completely offline and has no extra functions at all. The interface is so intuitive that it is impossible to get lost. I’ve honestly tried my best to make it nice & simple!
The app is great for both gym and at home workout, because the list of exercises is created by you. Instead of hundreds of preset workout programs (invented by nobody knows who), you form your own database - leave only what is important for you personally. 
‣ Create any exercise: from yoga to strength training.
‣ Customize them: workout with dumbbells, barbells or with your own weight.
‣ Log your results in a few clicks.
‣ Keep track of your progress: stay toned, gain or lose weight. 
Together with other users who regularly write great reviews, we strive to keep the app simple. As a result, as many superfluous elements as possible have been eliminated from the app, but functionality has been retained. However, if you do miss something, you can always contact me directly from the app and I will try to implement your ideas.
The only limitation of the free version is the maximum amount of 8 workouts. You can ignore this limit by deleting old workouts, or remove the restriction completely with a premium subscription at a reasonable price. This kind of support, as well as honest feedback, helps me grow the project. I promise, I do not and will not have any advertising and unnecessary purchases. Everything is extremely transparent. I am using it myself, so I do not want to make another Frankenstein out of the app.
Policy: http://gymtracker.tilda.ws/privacy-policy
Terms and Conditions: http://gymtracker.tilda.ws/terms-of-use
Thank you for reading to the end, so it was not in vain!

bluejetty:00161381:ios.description:
Você é amante das Loterias? Adora fazer uma "fézinha"? Então esse aplicativo é para você!
Com o "Loterias: Resultados e Gerador", você acompanha os últimos resultados dos concursos das Loterias, para todos os jogos:
+Milionária

Lotofácil
Quina
Lotomania
Timemania
Dupla Sena
Dia de Sorte
Super sete
Federal
Loteca
Na seção "Meus Jogos", é possível inserir os seus jogos para conferência automática do sorteio. Basta esperar o resultado do concurso que seu jogo será conferido, mostrando as dezenas acertadas! Será que o seu bilhete será premiado!?
Na seção "Notificações", você pode selecionar as loterias que deseja receber mensagens de notificações. Assim que o resultado de um novo concurso estiver disponível, você receberá uma notificação!
Na seção "Gerador de jogos", você pode gerar jogos para as suas loterias preferidas. Também é possível gerar um jogo recorrente, por meio da "teimosinha". Assim você consegue repetir seu jogo por até 24 concursos!
Na seção "Estatísticas", você pode analisar as estatísticas dos jogos selecionados ou gerados e tomar as melhores decisões em seus jogos. Você pode conferir quantas vezes o jogo selecionado foi premiado em sua série histórica de jogos!
Veja o valor do prêmio de cada sorteio, a data do próximo concurso e compartilhe a imagem do sorteio com seus amigos!
Assista os vídeos dos sorteios, as apurações dos concursos, realizados ao vivo. Mande o vídeo para aquele amigo que vive desconfiando dos jogos da Loteria, para que ele verifique e ateste a transparência e lisura de todos os processos envolvidos!
* Aplicativo de produção independente, sendo exclusivo para consulta dos resultados das loterias. O aplicativo não possui vínculo com empresas que gerenciam loterias, não faz apostas e não representa nenhuma entidade governamental.

bluejetty:00062721:ios.description:
Use your iPhone's compass and gyroscope to find planets, constellations, satellites, and more with crisp, colorful, high-definition Retina graphics that use every pixel of your iPhone or iPad! Hold the universe in your pocket! 
StarMap 3D Plus is the portable star atlas for beginners or advanced astronomers. Use StarMap 3D Plus to find the planets, stars, constellations, star clusters, galaxies, and nebulae visible to you based on your location and time. StarMap 3D will even use the compass to automatically align the map! 
• Real-time positions of 150 artificial satellites, including the International Space Station (ISS), and the Hubble Space Telescope 
• iPad Support 
• Over 100,000 stars, with detailed information for each of them 
• 6,441 deep sky objects, with details such as distance from Earth, diameter, apparent size and orientation, and morphology 
• All 88 modern constellations, with lines based on the outlines from "The Stars: A New Way to See Them" by H.A. Rey 
• MacRobert and Classic constellation lines also available 
• Location-based-services (LBS) / Global Positioning System (GPS) support, or manually enter your longitude and latitude 
• Adjustable date and time of day 
• Also adjust time instantaneously and interactively with the Time Scroll feature 
• Compass support, if present 
• Planetarium Mode for seeing only objects visible to you, or browse the entire celestial sphere 
• 3D Mode for visualizing the universe in three dimensions

bluejetty:00165438:ios.description:
Embark on the Ultimate Idle RPG Adventure!
Discover an immersive fantasy world filled with exciting challenges, breathtaking locations, and endless opportunities to grow stronger. Whether you’re an active player or prefer the idle experience, this game offers something for everyone.
Key Features:
1. Explore a Vast Fantasy World
Travel across multiple unique locations, each brimming with secrets, enemies, and treasures to uncover.
2. Master the Art of Crafting
Craft powerful equipment and consumables through six distinct masteries:
- Alchemy: Brew potions with magical effects
- Cooking: Prepare dishes that empower your character
- Jewelry: Create enchanted accessories
- Smithing: Forge weapons and armor
- Woodworking: Build bows and staves
-Tailoring: Sew garments and light armor
3. Equip and Customize Your Hero
Find and equip powerful gear with unique stats, affixes, and rarities to create the ultimate build.
4. Master Elemental Skills
Learn and upgrade skills from six elemental categories: Water, Fire, Rock, Thunder, Nature, and Dark. Experiment to discover synergies that dominate the battlefield!
5. Join or Create a Guild
Team up with friends or lead your own guild. Build a guild camp, engage in epic battles against rival guilds, and take on enormous beasts for glorious rewards.
6. Real-Time Marketplace
Trade items with other players in a dynamic economy. Buy, sell, and barter your way to success.
7. Build Your Town
Construct a thriving town for your citizens, unlocking permanent boosts to empower your hero on every adventure.
8. Conquer the Mysterious Maze
Dive into an ever-changing maze to uncover rare treasures and rewards.
9. Battle Fearsome Enemies
Face a variety of foes, from dungeon guards to invasion bosses. Only the strongest will survive!
10. Level Up Your Hero
Gain experience, grow stronger, and unlock new abilities as you progress through your journey.
Are you ready to forge your path in this idle RPG adventure? The world is waiting—join the fight now!
Terms of Use: https://warshovel.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00178526:ios.description:
Turn your photos into stunning masterpieces with the most comprehensive AI art studio on the App Store. Featuring over 500 styles from every major art movement, Paintation allows you to stylize, edit, and retouch your images with professional precision—all while keeping your data 100% private.
WHY CHOOSE PAINTATION? Unlike other AI editors, Paintation works entirely offline. Using advanced on-device AI models (TFLite), your photos never leave your phone. Experience lightning-fast style transfer without cloud uploads or privacy risks.
EXPLORE THE HISTORY OF ART Dive into a massive library of 500+ styles categorized by era: • Renaissance, Baroque, Rococo, and Neoclassicism. • Romanticism, Realism, and Impressionism. • Post-Impressionism, Art Nouveau, and Expressionism. • Cubism, Abstract Art, and Surrealism. • Specialized textures and sketch effects (Charcoal, Pencil, Ink).
EDUCATIONAL INTEGRATION Learn as you create! Every style includes an info button linked to WikiArt. Discover the story behind the masterpiece and the artist who inspired your edit.
PROFESSIONAL 4-STAGE WORKFLOW
1. PREPARE: Complete retouching suite before you stylize. • Vanish Tool: Effortlessly remove unwanted objects using AI. • Liquify: Reshape and distort for perfect proportions. • Clone Stamp: Duplicate or repair parts of your image. • Background: Automatic detection and replacement. • Standard Tools: Crop, rotate, brightness, contrast, and sharpen.
2. STYLIZE: Apply high-end style transfers. • Choose from 500+ curated styles or create your own by uploading any reference image to use as a custom style.
3. FILTER: Add the finishing touch. • Apply abstract and color filters including Sepia, Black & White, Threshold, Negative, and specialized OpenCV colormaps.
4. ADJUST: Fine-tune the result. • Precision controls for saturation, hue, smoothness, and vignette to make your artwork pop.
SAVE & SHARE YOUR WAY Export your creations in multiple formats: • High-resolution result image. • Split-view (Original vs. Result). • Art Collage (Original + Style + Result).
KEY FEATURES: • 100% Offline processing – No internet required. • Multi-stage editing: Use your result as a new input. • Selection Category: Quick access to the best-performing styles. • Built-in Vignette and Smoothness tools.
Download Paintation today and start your journey through the history of fine art!
CREDITS are listed on http://paintation.com
Terms of Use: http://paintation.com/terms-of-use-ios.html

bluejetty:00070265:ios.description:
Get ready for the ultimate racing experience in this action packed battle arena race game! Car Eats Car 5 puts you in the driver's seat of a powerful race car. In this dynamic driving game, you'll compete against other opponents as you try to destroy all the cars in the arena. 
A new and exciting race adventure is waiting for you! Car Eats Car games are always story-driven and in this latest episode the plot involves friendship and survival. Save Beetlee's friends and the entire planet from a dangerous alien threat. Enemies and end bosses are ready to challenge your race and fighting skills. Conquer rivals in race battles with missions and show the invaders that you are the real race champion and master of the grid.
RACE EXPLOSIVE BATTLES on a variety of locations and complete missions while being chased by evil cars. It's either you eat them or they eat you, so fire up the nitro and do whatever it takes to stay ahead of the pack.
TWO GAME MODES - Career Mode on the 3D race planet map and Battle Arena PVP Multiplayer. 
FEATURING STUNNING 3D GRAPHICS, Car Eats Car 5 brings the action to life as you drive into each racing challenge on colourful race tracks. 
USE BUTTON OR JOYSTICK CONTROLS to turn the wheel and steer your car towards enemy demolition and sweet victory. 
UNIQUE RACING GAME FEATURES
- Many levels and destructive battles in the arena
- 3D map with bright and unique locations
- Varied tasks and missions
- Animated garage with car show
- Over 10 hungry cars, find the one that suits your play style perfectly
- Upgrades for each car, improving turbo, speed, armour and damage
- Library describing all race characters of the game
- End bosses with unique weapons
- Different types of control, including a joystick
WITH FAST PACED GAMEPLAY AND ENDLESS ACTION, expect to be on the edge of your seat. Each race battle level has tasks to complete. Earn from 1 star to 3 stars per challenge. Step into a 3D racing world and battle the competition in this exciting racing game. 
BUT DON’T LET THE HIGH QUALITY GRAPHICS DISTRACT YOU - those monster cars are hot on your tail, and it's up to you to outwit and outdrive them to emerge victorious. So rev up your engines and get ready to race through the city in this high-octane chase gadi game.
BEETLEE, GATOR, LOCOMACHINA, TANKOMINATOR and other legendary hungry cars are back and now visible from all sides in all their racing glory. Collect rewards and attack opponents on the fury road. Explore the 3D animated Garage to pick the car for each battle mission. Each vehicle has a unique feature that helps you to win the more challenging races. Get into the garage and find the perfect formula to customise your supercar. Special weapons and the right tuning to your race car will help you defeat the dangerous enemies in this kar wala game. Bomb, bite, ram at speed and win!

Survive in this racing game that is a 3D mobile app with all you expect from the best survival racing simulator action game! Welcome to this competition packed car driving and battle arena mobile game! Get excited in 3D race arena battles, fire weapons and use nitro boost bite power to counter attack and eat the enemy. Collect turbo when you hit the gas and damage and destroy one enemy car after the other. Demolition kar wala race mobile gadi game in 3D where you have to take control of monster truck vehicles. 
ENJOY this video racing gadi game that features action and driving kar wala elements. But it's not just about driving and destruction. As you progress through the game, you'll have the opportunity to evolve your car, unlocking a variety of attacks that will help you take out your opponents. From shooting rockets to unleashing a barrage of bullets, you'll have an arsenal of weapons at your disposal as you work to meet the objectives set at the beginning of each battle.

bluejetty:00094533:ios.description:
“This man's voice is so anointed - so relaxing you feel God's peace.”
“One word "anointed." Another two: "thank you,”
“This is the one I will be listening to, because it is truly anointed! Thank you so very much.”
“Oh give thanks for This Anointing that brings peace of God”
“Thank you so much for this anointed compilation of powerful blessed scriptures”
“You are such an anointed vessel bringing comfort to all who hear you. Bless you.”
“Thank you for these morning prayers!! They are so anointed!! This one is my favorite… I felt the presence of God just absolutely envelope as I prayed along with you! Wow, all glory to the Lord”
“Oh and they get better each time! Truly blessed! This one is my favourite. Your voice is surely anointed, may God bless you!”
“thank you Lord for this anointed voice”
The Soakstream App Is full of anointed Bible Verses For Sleep videos, powerful morning Prayer videos and sleep prayer videos, a Prayer Community wall where you can bear each other’s burdens in prayer for one another and lift each other up in prayer as the body of Christ from all the way across the world.
There is a built in journal and a way to completely customize your audio mix and video background to your liking.
If you want the music louder, softer, or off, you can do that. If you want to switch the video background or turn it to a black screen you can do that. You can favorite certain Scriptures and create your own playlist of Scriptures to listen to. Turn on Scripture memory mode if you want to listen to the same verse over and over, and turn it off to get back to the compilation of Scriptures.
We have tailored this app in such a way so that you can listen to the powerful, peaceful Word of God night and day, and customize the how to’s to your liking.
Scripture says that faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the Word of God. So as you listen to these Bible Verses read over you in our Bible Verses for Sleep videos, and prayed over you in our prayer videos, you are building up your faith in our incredible God. You are tearing out the lies that have tried to choke you out from the life God offers. And you are resting in the peace and Truth of Jesus.
You are communing with Him.
His Love. His Joy. His Peace. His Hope. His LIFE. All comes through as we spend time in His Word and in His Presence with Him.
A life of communing with the Father. Listening to what the Holy Spirit says to you as you hear His Word out loud. It arrests your spirit’s attention. Your spirit man comes alive in His Word. And He makes you new in His presence. There is no greater source of life and transformation than the WORD & Spirit of God.
You are a new creation in Christ. The old has gone, the new has come.
His Word is Truth and His Spirit is the Spirit of Truth. Let His Truth, the Only Truth, wash over you. Soak in it. Immerse your heart and home in it. Let Him continue to baptize you in His Word and presence and make you more like Him.
I am so looking forward to having you here with us. Lord bless you fully and deeply in Him, with more and more intimacy in your walk with Him.
Jesus is the treasure. Draw us ever closer Lord!
-Barrett & Jessica Bogan, Soakstream

bluejetty:00154227:ios.description:
A long time ago….
The enemy attacked your peaceful settlement! They stole the most precious thing - your beautiful princess!
You need to save her by destroying enemy bases, solving tricky puzzles and defeating evil enemies with your powerful weapons and quick wits! Make your enemies fly into the air, blow up their bases and crush their buildings with your new super weapon - a powerful cannon!
The game has simple and intuitive controls. 
Find a weak point in the enemy structure, aim, shoot and destroy it! Or just smash it with the powerful projectiles!
But remember! Stickman enemies are very dangerous. They have arrows, spears, swords and even cannons. They will attack you! Evil swordsmen, accurate archers and mighty giants will do their best to interfere with you in the noble cause of saving your treasure.
Enjoy the exciting gameplay and explode enemy bases. Defeat all stickmen!
Use powerful weapons to save your princess!
In addition to the opportunity to show your courage and bravery, the game has:
DESTRUCTION: Pass exciting levels. Enjoy realistic destruction and 2D physics.
DANGEROUS ENEMIES: In this 2D game, the stickman warriors will attack you. Be careful!
POWERFUL ARSENAL: There are 10 awesomely cool cannons available for your character. Each of them has its own unique type of ammunition. There is even a nuke gun for a really big explosion!
SKILLS: In order to cause as much damage as possible on stick opponents, 10 incredibly powerful skills are available.
EQUIPMENT: To protect yourself, use protective equipment kits. Helmets and full body armor are available. Some equipment has unique properties.
SIEGE MECHANISMS: The enemies will try to hit you not only with their weapons, but also with a variety of devices.
GRAPHICS: Excellent and bright graphics perfectly combined with the destructive power of your cannons!
Play for FREE! 
WITHOUT INTERNET! This game can be played without the internet!
Update in progress. Write us your suggestions to improve the gameplay, we read all your comments.
Download Boom Stick now!
Privacy Policy: https://byvgames.com/private-policy.html
TERMS OF USE: https://byvgames.com/terms.php

bluejetty:00185135:ios.description:
Create a squad from 11 classes, add your friends for team play, and test your skills in dynamic arenas or through Battle Royale warfare against online rivals from around the world! 
Prefer to work alone? Then feel free to step into the thrilling solo play campaign as you shoot your way through one dire situation after another to save the world as you launch an attack against a lunatic’s apocalyptic plans. 
11 CLASSES WITH UNIQUE SKILLS 
> Customize and level up any of the 10 classes across solo play and team play modes. 
> Find the playstyle that suits you: Assault, Heavy, Recon, Sniper, Support, Bounty Hunter, Sapper, X1-Morph, Kommander, Marauder or Tracker. 
> Activate class-specific skills by earning and spending Skill Points. 
HIGH-POWERED ONLINE MULTIPLAYER 
> Watch players engaged in live online FPS battles and eSports competitions with all the great graphics you expect in the Spectator mode. 
> Epic guns-a-blazing team play in Squad vs. Squad matches. 
> Drop into Battle Royale mode and fight for survival with up to 70 players. 
> Talk to other players to plan your online multiplayer strategies and coordinate an attack in the Global and Squad Chats. 
> Top the individual and Squad leaderboards as you master your eSports skills. 
> Win free rewards and cool prizes in limited-time events. 
RANK UP 
> Accumulate XP and level up by playing solo play missions, team play matches, and Battle Royale. 
> Unlock higher-tier guns and other weapons by mastering lower-tier guns. 
> Customize the perfect weapon using a host of attachments and jump straight into the free game action. 
INTENSE SOLO PLAY CAMPAIGN 
> Engage in fast-paced story missions where the call will take you from Tokyo to Venice for a variety of first person shooter challenges. > Play the new Spec Ops missions for a real online FPS adrenaline rush. 
> Great graphics, music and voice performances perfectly adapted for a first person shooter game. 
HIGHLY CUSTOMIZABLE CONTROLS 
> Intuitive, highly customizable controls so you can play the game just the way you want. 
 Modern Combat 5 requires an Internet connection. So if you’re ready for the online FPS of your dreams, dive into this unparalleled free game that takes online multiplayer to new heights. Perfect for anyone hungry for solo play first person shooter fun, team play eSports competition, or a thrilling Battle Royale challenge.

St.George: Simple and secure banking at your fingertips.
Open an everyday banking or savings account in 3 minutes.
Make payments
• Make fast and secure payments & transfers or schedule them for the future
• Apple Pay - Pay with your mobile 
• Digital Card† - Boost your card security by using the dynamic CVV on your credit or debit card
• Verify^ - Adding a new payee? We’ll check the account details you’ve entered have been commonly used
Track your spending
• ‘Categories’* - Track your spending habits 
• Set up notifications so you’re notified when your money comes and goes
• Expense Splitter - Paid for a shared expense? Keep track of who’s paid you back
• 24/7 Fraud monitoring detects any unusual purchase activity on your card
Everyday banking tools
• Quick Balance - see your account balance at a glance and transfer money between accounts
• Activate, lock** or cancel your card
• Contact Us from the App to skip security questions~
• ATM & Branch finder – locate your nearest St.George, Bank of Melbourne, BankSA or Westpac ATM or branch
Need Help?
If you are having issues with our app, delete and re-install it. If issues persist please call us on 13 33 30 (8am – 8pm Mon – Sat).

*This tool provides general information and is intended to be a guide only. Available on savings, transactions and credit card accounts.
**Locking your card will temporarily stop new transactions on your card for up to 15 days or until reactivated. The card will automatically reactivate after 15 days if you don’t unlock the card or report the card lost or stolen.
~Standard SMS, call or data charges apply.
Read the Terms & Conditions at stgeorge.com.au before making a decision and consider whether the product or service is right for you. Fees and charges may apply.

bluejetty:00183677:ios.description:
The RCB Go App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact River City Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the RCB Go App, you must be enrolled as an River City Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

All of your personal information is encrypted by Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) software when it's transmitted to us during the checkout process, just as it is on QVC.com. bluejetty:00165715:ios.description:
How many times have you heard from creative people about inspiration? About the spark that makes songs become hits and sit in your head? You hear about it all the time and it begins to seem that writing texts is some kind of magic that is inaccessible to everyone. And it's not fair!
The usual laws have already been violated when software products that allow you to create music were born. At that moment, it became clear that music education is not the only formula for success, and the music industry has only become more diverse as a result. And if our ear is no longer confused by the nature of the sound born with the help of technology, it's time to consider a new approach to writing texts!
Lyncil is an application for writing lyrics based on user preferences. Your ideas, music vision, style will continue to be the basis of the song, and the app will help you find the right form for this. Creativity does not fade into the background - creativity moves to a new level!
Beyonce, Taylor Swift, Justin Bieber and a number of stars are already working with teams of co-authors to create your favorite songs. A song co-written is definitely better than one that will never be released or composed, so use Lyncil and show the world what you can do!
Our app provides a set of features that require a subscription purchase:
1. Enter prompt & select genre - type your thoughts on lyrics you want to get, choose one of six main genres (rock, hip-hop, vocal, folk, heavy metal, K-pop) and get stunning results fastly 
2. Lyrics editing - remove words you don't like, add new lines to your lyrics
3. Favourites - highlight lyrics you like most, get an easy access to them
———

apple-macos:1433648537.description:
Protect your online privacy with Passepartout, a smart VPN client seamlessly integrated with iOS, macOS, iPadOS, and tvOS.
HOW PASSEPARTOUT WORKS
Passepartout includes basic import and connection features. Additional features require an in-app purchase.
INCLUDED FEATURES:
- Support for OpenVPN and WireGuard protocols.
- OpenVPN obfuscation (using --scramble).
- Shortcuts automation for streamlined operations.
- Exclude endpoints for precise control.
OpenVPN support focuses on common options; compression is not supported because it is not secure.
REQUIRES AN IN-APP PURCHASE:
- Support for Apple TV.
- On-demand rules for smart, automated connections.
- iCloud sharing for seamless multi-device use.
- DoH/DoT for secure DNS queries.
- Domain matching for split DNS.
- Export and share profiles.
- Custom routing for advanced configurations.
- Interactive login with support for one-time passwords (OTP).
- Non-VPN profiles (e.g. DNS/Proxy-only setups).
FAMILY SHARING ENABLED
All purchases support Family Sharing, so you can share them with your family members.
PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
Passepartout is built with transparency and privacy in mind:
- See exactly which servers you’re connecting to.
- No ads, trackers, or unnecessary background activities—just the VPN connection you need.
OPEN SOURCE AND COMMUNITY-DRIVEN
Passepartout is open source and constantly evolving with the help of its community. Check out the project on GitHub: https://github.com/partout-io
~
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://partout.io/passepartout/privacy/

WaterKit — making hydration a joyful habit.
Still forgetting to drink water every day? WaterKit uses the simplest approach to help you fall in love with hydration. 23 adorable animated characters drink alongside you — the water level inside each character changes in real time with your progress, and reaching your goal triggers a celebratory animation!
**Key Features**:
• Cross-platform hydration tracking (iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac — full platform support)
• 45 drink types (water, tea, coffee, juice, milk, sports drinks, soup, etc.), with drink management to customize your list, reorder, and personalize icons & colors
• Standalone Apple Watch app + 4 watch face complications
• 13 home screen and lock screen widgets (small/medium/large sizes)
• 45 achievement challenges, 7 categories, 5 rarity tiers (Common → Legendary)
• Historical hydration stats (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly analysis)
• Habit score (0-100 comprehensive assessment) + habit insights (last 7 days of hydration)
• Smart goal recommendations (personalized based on weight, activity, gender)
• 80 notification templates, 5 tone styles (gentle/lively/motivating/humorous/default)
• 19 reminder sounds, smart scene recognition (auto-switches tone by time of day)
• 14 beautiful themes, 28 color sets, dark/light/system modes
• Deep sync with Apple Health (read/write water, caffeine, weight, activity data)
• iCloud sync for real-time cross-device data
• Independent caffeine tracking (weekly/monthly/yearly stats)
• 23 characters display hydration status, switchable progress layouts
• Visual current intake interface, goal-reached celebration animation
• Preset volumes, cup-based logging, customizable drink types
• Unit conversion (ml/oz/L, kg/lb)
• CSV/JSON data export
• Supports 24 languages
Stay healthy, drink more water — with the ultimate hydration tracker: WaterKit.
***Subscription & Purchase Information:
WaterKit offers flexible purchase options to unlock all premium features:
- Lifetime membership: one-time purchase, permanently unlocks all premium features.
- Annual membership: auto-renewing yearly subscription.
- Monthly membership: auto-renewing monthly subscription.
Payment will be charged directly to your iTunes account. Subscriptions auto-renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your iTunes account settings after purchase.
***Legal Information:
Privacy Policy: https://www.waterkit.net/privacy-policy_en.html
Terms of Service (EULA): https://www.waterkit.net/terms_en.html
Note: HealthKit integration is used to read/write water, caffeine, weight, gender, and activity data.
Note: WaterKit is not a medical app. Suggested hydration goals are estimates based on body weight only. For medical purposes or personalized hydration advice, please consult your doctor.
